places.place: EventualWideningInstances.lean: Web.eventually_dense, Web.eventually_neither, Web.eventually_insulated, Web.not_eventually_of_listed, Flow.OpenedByOpened, OwnCondition.disagreement, OwnCondition.not_monotone, LagWitness.lag, MergedWitness.keeps_widening_along_merge, OpeningChain.carried, Saturated.reverses, ClosedCycle.cycle
places.states: The general laws read level paths as runs of `Sequences.process`. Where some path eventually widens l', both eventually widening l' and not doing so are dense, so the reading is neither verifiable nor refutable and can be insulated by a practice fixed by the record. A path whose admissions are listed eventually widens nothing, and `Flow.OpenedByOpened` (provisional) fails where nothing is supported from some step on. The rest are built witnesses: OwnCondition (rising, burst, full), LagWitness, MergedWitness, OpeningChain (relay against one giver), Saturated and ClosedCycle.
places.moves: S: `Web.eventually_dense` (l. 109) and `Web.not_eventually_dense` (l. 116): in `Sequences.process (C → Nat)`, where some path eventually widens l', every run and every h have a run agreeing with it before h that eventually widens l', and one that does not, built by `splice`. This is a law about what continuations from any finite stretch can do. No policy or allowed set beyond the process of all sequences.
places.reading: S: `Web.eventually_neither` (l. 124): eventually widening l' is neither `Verifiable` nor `Refutable` (premise: some path eventually widens l'). `Web.eventually_insulated` (l. 133): some practice V with `ByRecord V` `Insulates` the verdict "eventually widens l'", that is, what is registered in a finite record never decides it. `Web.not_eventually_of_listed` (l. 150): a path whose admissions a list holds (`ListsAdmitted`) eventually widens nothing.
places.share: N: No share and no rule set from one.
places.level: N: No law of running down. B: `OwnCondition.burst` (l. 225) admits formations 0 and 1 at step 0 and nothing after (built). `Flow.OpenedByOpened.not_of_unsupported` (l. 176) has as its premise that nothing is supported from some step on; no return depending on what is left.
places.giving: S: `Flow.OpenedByOpened` (def, l. 169): gains of support recur, and every gain after T is given, on a condition the gainer requires that rises across the step, by a supported formation taking part that itself gained support after T, earlier. So the giver is a formation of the model, not a function. Loss of a giver is not stated. B: `OpeningChain.carried` (l. 538): on one web, with the same levels, the relay (each formation gives the next its unit) is opened by the opened and `oneGiver` (formation 0 gives every unit, never having gained support) is not. `ClosedCycle.opened` (l. 664).
places.cost: B: `ClosedCycle.flow` (l. 619): the active formation `parity t` takes the unit from its own condition and gives it to the other's. By `ClosedCycle.gains_iff` (l. 628) the gain of support across the step is the other formation's, so the giver gives away its own support. No general law of cost was found.
places.multiplying: B: `OpeningChain.relay` (l. 483) with `OpeningChain.gains_iff` (l. 461) and `OpeningChain.supported_iff` (l. 456): formation t gives one unit to condition t + 1, and the supported formations at step t are those up to t, one more each step. Each gain is given by the formation that gained the step before. No general law of number was found.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.OpenedByOpened.not_of_unsupported` (l. 176): where nothing is supported from step T on (a premise), no flow is opened by the opened from any step. B: `OwnCondition.burst_later` (l. 240): the burst admits nothing after step 0, by construction. No point of no return is concluded.
places.both_outcomes: N: No dichotomy of going on and ending for one model. B: contrasts are shown on one web. `OwnCondition.disagreement` (l. 293): the burst widens the rising course up to step 0, the two are mixed, the rising course eventually widens the burst and keeps widening, and the burst keeps widening from no step. `OpeningChain.carried` (l. 538): the same levels, one flow opened by the opened and one not.
places.comparison: S: `Web.eventually_dense` (l. 109) uses `Web.EventuallyWidens.of_agree_left` across spliced runs. B: `OwnCondition.full_eventually_widens_rising` (l. 306). `OwnCondition.not_monotone` (l. 317): full widens rising, rising keeps widening, full keeps widening from no step. `LagWitness.lag` (l. 379): lagging keeps widening and admits, at every later step, every formation travelling admits (`kept_later`, l. 362), yet neither eventually widens the other. `Saturated.reverses` (l. 572): the relay is opened by the opened with rising levels, `still` is opened from no step with full levels, and full widens rising.
places.rank: N: No falling variant or deadline. `Web.stepBound` (l. 141) is a step beyond every listed step, used only in `Web.not_eventually_of_listed` (l. 150).
places.closed_region: B: `ClosedCycle.includes_across` (l. 685): along `passing`, where each formation continues as the other, nothing admitted is lost from 0 on. `ClosedCycle.not_opening` (l. 692): nothing is opened. `ClosedCycle.cycle` (l. 711): opened by the opened with the range kept, and no widening either along passing or by name. N: no general closed-region law.
places.forms_change: B: `OpeningChain.relay_opened` (l. 516): a relay, where each step's gain of support is given by the formation that gained the step before. `ClosedCycle.cycle` (l. 711): two formations alternate support, and the going-on continues while which one is present changes, with no widening. `OwnCondition.rising_keeps_widening` (l. 275): one more formation admitted each step, more after. `LagWitness.lag` (l. 379): travelling admits each formation for one step only (kinds coming and going) while lagging keeps each forever. `MergedWitness.keeps_widening_along_merge` (l. 424): a constant course keeps widening along a merging continuation (re-formation counted as opening), but not by name (`not_keeps_widening_by_name`, l. 437). S: `Flow.OpenedByOpened` (l. 169) as the defined carrier of widening.

places.place: Evolution.lean: price, selected_uniform, Flow.DescendsAt, Flow.unsupported_childless, Flow.selection_within, Flow.TransmitsWithin, Flow.transmitted_supported, Flow.transmitted_within, Flow.transmitted_along, Flow.goal_descends_iff, Drawdown.drawdown, Slack.slack, Unchecked.unchecked
places.states: The general laws are these. Over any parents, offspring lists and amounts, the counting form of Price holds as an identity (`price`). On any flow and web over one kind of relatum, where only active formations give (`Acting`) and activity needs support (`Dependent`), an unsupported formation leaves no descendant, and what is transmitted within δ is bounded by the condition's level at the giving step plus δ, by that level minus what was taken since (`transmitted_within`), and by (i+1)δ of drift along a lineage. A goal passes down every lineage exactly where it passes across each single descent. Drawdown, Slack and Unchecked are built witnesses.
places.moves: N: No choice among steps, policy or allowed set. The flow and the offspring lists `kids` are handed in.
places.reading: N: No observation or class read alike. `carries : Nat → X → Prop` in `Flow.goal_along` (l. 352) is a handed-in predicate, not a reading.
places.share: N: No rule set again from a share. S, as context: `price` (l. 117): offspring total + lowered = parents' amounts weighted by offspring number (`selected`) + raised. `selected_uniform` (l. 131): with k offspring each, the weighted total is k times the parents' total. The account says the selection term proper (covariance) is not stated.
places.level: S: `Flow.transmitted_within` (l. 301): in a balanced flow under Acting, Dependent and TransmitsWithin c δ, a descendant's need at S+n+1, plus everything taken from c over the n steps from S, is at most c's level at S plus everything given since, plus δ. What later descendants can need depends on what activity has left. B: `Drawdown.drawdown` (l. 546): the pool falls from 2 to 1 by the parent's taking (`web.level 1 .pool < web.level 0 .pool`), and the descendant with the parent's need is unsupported at every step from 1 (`same_unsupported`, l. 536).
places.giving: S: `Flow.unsupported_childless` (l. 195): under Acting and Dependent, a formation unsupported at a step leaves no descendant across it. `Flow.never_supported_childless` (l. 200): one never supported leaves none. The giver (parent) is a formation whose support can fail, though support is set by handed-in levels and needs. N: nothing gives to the pool; givers to a condition's level are not modelled.
places.cost: N: No statement charges the doer. B: in `Drawdown.drawdown` (l. 546) the parent's taking lowers the pool on which its same-need descendant depends, so the cost falls on its own offspring, not on the parent.
places.multiplying: S: `Flow.DescendsAt` (def, l. 154): x descends from g across t when g takes part, gives to x, and x comes to stand. `price` (l. 117) counts offspring as weights. The number of offspring is handed in (`kids`), not fixed by a law of the step. B: `Drawdown.descends_same` and `Drawdown.descends_varied` (ll. 528, 531): one parent leaves two descendants across step 0.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.never_supported_childless` (l. 200) has a premise (never supported) and concludes no descendant. B: `Drawdown.same_unsupported` (l. 536): the inheriting descendant is unsupported at every step t ≥ 1, after the pool fell below its need. This is a loss at a low level, concluded only in the built case. N: no general point of no return.
places.both_outcomes: S: `Flow.goal_descends_iff` (l. 364): a goal passes down every lineage whose members keep it until they give, from a carrying founder, exactly when it passes across every single descent from a carrier. This is an exactly-when of keeping a goal, general. B: `Drawdown.drawdown` (l. 546): one descendant is unsupported from its first standing step while the other is supported, active and takes in turn.
places.comparison: N: No law carrying something between two processes or two starts. S, as context, along one lineage: `Flow.goal_along` (l. 352) carries a goal and `Flow.transmitted_along` (l. 315) carries a need bound, from founder to descendants.
places.rank: N: No ending within a bound. `Flow.transmitted_along` (l. 315) and `Flow.transmitted_along_supported` (l. 335) bound need drift upward by (i+1)δ, with δ ≥ 0. `Slack.slack` (l. 612): with δ = 1 a transmitted need can exceed the pool's level at every step.
places.closed_region: S: `Flow.goal_along` (l. 352): with the goal passing across each descent (`passes`) and kept by each member until it gives (`keeps`), from a carrying founder, every member carries it from its first standing step. This is an invariant along descent. `Flow.goal_descends_iff` (l. 364) gives its exact condition.
places.forms_change: S: `Flow.transmitted_along` (l. 315) is stated over a lineage xs 0, xs 1, …, each descending from the last across step ts i: the going-on continues through successive members. B: `Drawdown.drawdown` (l. 546): new relata come to stand, one with the parent's need and one varied (needing less); the parent's activity at step 0 is followed by the varied descendant's at step 1, while the same-need one is never supported. `Unchecked.unchecked` (l. 683): without Dependent, a transmitted need exceeds the level at the giving step.

Nothing went unreached.

places.place: ExchangePremises.lean: withRest_counted, listed_iff_lpo, withRest_embodied_iff, withRest_dissipative_of_gives_nothing, ExchangeRelation.readWeb_dependent, ExchangeRelation.RespondsBelow, ExchangeLaw.relation_responds_iff, ExchangeLaw.contingent, sprouting_not_transmitting, spreading_not_enclosed
places.states: The module settles, for worlds read off an exchange with the rest counted, four remaining premises. The census holds wherever the formations taking part are listed once and a named family closes each step, and listing what exchanges for every flow over Nat is exactly LPO. Embodiment is exactly balance plus exchanging exactly while standing, and giving nothing dissipates. Requirement is read as necessary response over a relation that leaves several exchanges open, and on every run activity then needs support. The general laws sit beside built witnesses (still, responsive, sprouting, spreading) showing that dissipation, embodiment, transmission and enclosure each hold or fail depending on the law.
places.moves: S: `ExchangeRelation` (l. 584) leaves open any number of exchanges across a step under a level history, and `ExchangeRelation.Runs` (l. 610) is a run taking an open exchange at every step. `ExchangeRelation.readWeb_dependent` (l. 623): on every run, for every history and need, the web read with requirement as necessary response is Dependent. `reading_glue` (l. 637): on every run the four tying premises hold with the rest counted. B: `free_unsupported` (l. 656): under the free relation a formation takes a unit each step while some open exchange leaves it idle (possible response).
places.reading: S: `Flow.readOff_census_of_closed` (l. 183): the web read off the exchange has a census where formations are listed once and a family closes each step. `ExchangeRelation.readWeb` (l. 616) and `RespondsBelow` (l. 598): requirement is read as necessary response to a condition falling below a need. `ExchangeLaw.relation_readWeb_requires` (l. 715): read off the course as a run, the web's requirement is the law's. `Flow.listed_iff_lpo` (l. 223): listing the exchanging formations of every flow over Nat is equivalent to LPO.
places.share: N: no fraction of one kind among several and no rule set again from it.
places.level: S: levels of conditions appear throughout. `World.withRest_dissipative_of_gives_nothing` (l. 292): with the rest counted, a balanced world whose formations give nothing dissipates. No general law of running down with returns depending on what is left. B: `sprouting` (l. 409): the sprout takes the ground's unit and gives it back exactly where the ground stands (`sign (l t .ground)`). `sprout_requires` (l. 478): the sprout's exchange responds to the ground falling below one.
places.giving: B: `sprout_descends` (l. 472): the sprout comes to stand across the first step, given its unit by the source, which is a formation. `source_unrequired` (l. 490): the source's giving does not respond to the ground. Nothing shows the giver as a going-on that is lost. N for a general law.
places.multiplying: B: `sprout_descends` (l. 472): one formation descends from another (`DescendsAt`), and `sprouting_not_transmitting` (l. 506) says no bound transmits the dependence. No law of a number changing by the step. N in general.
places.no_return: N.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on and ending. The iff statements (`withRest_embodied_iff` l. 300, `listed_iff_lpo` l. 223) are about premises, not continuation. B: `ExchangeLaw.contingent` (l. 559) collects three worlds, each meeting the tying premises: one meets dissipation and transmission and fails embodiment, one meets embodiment and transmission and fails dissipation, one fails transmission.
places.comparison: S: `ExchangeLaw.relation_responds_iff` (l. 698) and `relation_may_iff` (l. 706): for the relation leaving only the law's exchange open, necessary and possible response both equal the law's response. `course_runs` (l. 677): the law's course is a run of its relation. These carry a reading between a law and a relation, not between two processes' courses.
places.rank: N.
places.closed_region: N for a region closed under steps. `Flow.ClosedAt` families close a step's exchange (`exchanging_iff_within` l. 155, `listed_at_of_enclosed` l. 175). `still_closed`, `responsive_closed` and `sprouting_closed` (l. 350, 354, 467) state that the rest is idle at every step, which is closure as feasibility.
places.forms_change: B: in `sproutingWorld` (l. 440) the sprout, standing at nothing, comes to stand across the first step (`sprout_descends` l. 472) and then exchanges with the ground. A new formation comes while the source stays. No general statement.
places.how_read: All statements of the module read (l. 1 to 730). moves, reading, level (in part), comparison and closed_region (as ClosedAt) answered from statements; giving, multiplying, both_outcomes and forms_change from built witnesses; share, cost, no_return and rank not found.

places.place: Exclusion.lean: outrun_below, outrun_ends, outrun_reading_alike, full_taking_ends, continuing_excludes, continuing_ends_taker, level_kept, level_kept_of_plans, Excluding.three_courses, Excluding.admission_alike
places.states: General laws: where renewal depends on what it renews (gated), a part taking jointly more than is given for n steps from a level below n+m leaves the level below m for good and ends every dependent at need at least m, whatever any member takes. A full taker alongside another taker does the same, and a full taker that continues excludes any other taker within W.level T c + 1 steps (competitive exclusion). Joint taking within what is given keeps the level, as does a division by exclusive footprints of a realized joint plan. Built cases Excluding and Sharing show three courses of the same members, and that admission by level paths does not see the exclusion.
places.moves: S: `withinJoint_of_plan` (l. 315) and `level_kept_of_plans` (l. 327): where what formations take is what the leaves of a realized JointPlan draw, with parts' footprints within their whole's and apart and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given, and under balance the level never falls. B: `Excluding.three_courses` (l. 497): three courses of the same members (all end; one excluded; all share and continue). No `Process S A` with a choice among steps.
places.reading: S: `Flow.outrun_reading_alike` (l. 173): two flows, each with gated renewal at need one and a part outrunning what is given for n steps from a level at most n. Every score of level histories that reads c only from T+n on scores the two alike, however a member's act or the rest's differs. B: `Excluding.admission_alike` (l. 485): the level paths of Excluding and Sharing include each other and admit every member, while the second ends in one and continues in the other.
places.share: N: `TakesAll` (l. 113) is taking at least all that is given, not a share set again.
places.level: S: `Flow.outrun_below` (l. 138): with balance, Acting, Dependent and gated renewal (every giver requires c at need at least m), n outrunning steps from a level below n+m leave the level below m at every step from T+n. `Flow.level_kept` (l. 300): taking jointly within what is given at every step, the level never falls below its start. What comes back depends on what is left through the gated premise.
places.giving: S: `Flow.outrun_ends` (l. 156) and `Flow.full_taking_ends` (l. 232): under gated renewal, every formation depending on c at need at least m is inactive from T+n on. The givers are among them, since gated makes each giver require c at need at least m, and the full taker is included ('itself included', l. 22).
places.cost: N. The full taker ends with the rest (`full_taking_ends`), but no statement has keeping or giving cost the one who does it. D: the account (l. 33 to 34) reads `outrun_reading_alike` as saying a member's restraint is invisible and its own take is the only difference such a score can reward. That is a docstring reading, not a statement about cost.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.outrun_below` (l. 138) concludes that the level stays below m for every k from T+n ('for good'), from gated renewal and balance. `outrun_ends` (l. 156) concludes that every dependent, givers included, is inactive from then on: the loss of what gives. In `continuing_ends_taker` (l. 272) the non-resumption of the taker's activity (`lasting`) is a premise.
places.both_outcomes: B: `Excluding.three_courses` (l. 497): the same members all end (Exceeding), one is excluded while renewer and first continue (Excluding), or all are supported and continue (Sharing). `Sharing.full_taking_needed` (l. 469). No general 'exactly when'.
places.comparison: S: `Flow.outrun_reading_alike` (l. 173) carries equality of score between two flows L, L' under the outrun premises in each. B: `Excluding.admission_alike` (l. 485): `Web.Includes` holds in both directions between two courses' level paths.
places.rank: S: `Flow.outrun_below` (l. 138): ending within n steps from a level below n+m. `Flow.continuing_excludes` (l. 246): no other taker throughout `W.level T c + 1` steps from any T. `continuing_ends_taker` (l. 272): the taker is inactive from `T + W.level T c` on. `alongside_not_all` (l. 288).
places.closed_region: S: `Web.active_before` (l. 100): where activity does not resume once it stops, 'active only if active at T+j' is a region every step keeps (via `kept_onward`). `Flow.level_kept` (l. 300): the level at or above its start is kept at every step under joint taking within what is given. `supported_of_within` (l. 339): every formation is supported at every step.
places.forms_change: B: `Excluding.present` (l. 355) and `Excluding.continues` (l. 397): the second takes part at step 0 only and ends while renewer and first stay active at every step. What is present changes and the going on continues, but it is an ending, not a relay. N for a general statement.

places.place: Exhaustion.lean: more_accumulates, exceeds_of_more, beyond_given_bounded, seeking_bounded, seeking_ends, seeking_exhausts, Seeker.course, Seeker.ends_by_law
places.states: General laws: a take that is more than now at each step rises by at least one per step, so from a condition given at most B it comes to exceed what is given after B+1 steps. Under balance, taking beyond what is given cannot last W.level T c + 1 steps, so the seeker is not active through a stated window and ends where its activity does not resume. Where renewal is gated and the seeker persists while the level is at least m, the level falls below m within the window and every dependent ends, renewers included. A built Seeker among Exceeding's members illustrates this.
places.moves: N.
places.reading: N. `MoreThanNow` (used at l. 52) is a target on a quantity, not a reading.
places.level: S: `Flow.beyond_given_bounded` (l. 105): under balance, no formation takes part and takes more than is given at each of `W.level T c + 1` steps from T (each such step lowers the level). `Flow.seeking_exhausts` (l. 154): with Balances, Acting, Dependent, gated renewal (givers require c at need at least m), given bounded by B, a rising take while active, and the seeker active while the level is at least m, there is a j within the window where the level falls below m.
places.giving: S: `Flow.seeking_exhausts` (l. 154): from step j on, every formation requiring c at need at least m is inactive for all n. Under the gated premise the givers (renewers) are such formations ('the renewers included', l. 34).
places.cost: N. The seeker's own rising take ends it (`seeking_ends` l. 140), but that is not keeping or giving that costs the giver.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.seeking_exhausts` (l. 154) concludes that from T+j on every dependent at need at least m is inactive at every later step: the loss of what gives, derived from gated renewal (via `stays_below`). `Flow.seeking_ends` (l. 140) has the seeker inactive from a bound on, but non-resumption of its activity (`lasting`) is a premise there.
places.both_outcomes: B: `Seeker.course` (l. 274): the first is active at steps 0 to 3 and inactive from 4 on, while the renewer is active at every step. `Alone.takes_all` (l. 284): in `Alone` the first takes all that is given and is active at every step. The account contrasts the two (l. 38 to 41). No general dichotomy.
places.comparison: N.
places.rank: S: `more_accumulates` (l. 51): n steps of 'more than now' raise the quantity by at least n. `Flow.seeking_bounded` (l. 117): under balance, a seeker from a condition given at most B is not active through `B + 1 + (W.level (T + (B + 1)) c + 1)` steps from any T. `beyond_given_bounded` (l. 105): within `W.level T c + 1` steps. `seeking_ends` (l. 140): inactive from an explicit step on.
places.closed_region: N (only uses `Web.active_before` from Exclusion).
places.forms_change: B: `Seeker.present` (l. 182): from step 4 only the renewer takes part, and the renewer stays active (`Seeker.course` l. 274). An ending with continuation of the renewer, not a relay or a widening. N for a general statement.
places.how_read: All statements of the module read (l. 1 to 289). level, giving, no_return and rank answered from statements; both_outcomes and forms_change from built cases; moves, reading, share, cost, multiplying, comparison and closed_region not found.

places.place: Experiment.lean: Run.Fixes, Run.fixes_of_takes, Run.not_fixes_of_untaken, Run.not_fixes_other_of_new, keepHistory_new, keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else, FactorsThrough, Run.generalizes, Confound.misattributes, Confound.confounded, Confound.varied_refutes
places.states: General laws for every Process S A: along a run, relative to every determined process admitting its steps, the record fixes a move's outcome at a configuration where the run took it there, and fixes none for a move not taken. So a run that never returns, as a kept history never does, fixes nothing about its other acts. Read through a projection the record fixes outcomes, and where the step factors through the projection into a determined process one occasion stands for every configuration with that projection. A built Confound shows that a wrong projection misattributes, is never excluded when moves go in step with the hidden bit, and is refuted when the move is varied.
places.moves: S: `Run.not_fixes_of_untaken` (l. 122): for determined P, where the run has not taken b at s before t, the record fixes no outcome of b at s. `Run.fixes_of_takes` (l. 85): a move taken is fixed. B: `Confound.confounded` (l. 345): under the moves `aligned`, the wrong model is admitted at every step. `Confound.varied_refutes` (l. 353): under `varied`, no determined process admits the steps up to 4 read through the outcome. The choice of move sequence decides what the record can exclude.
places.reading: S: `Run.FixesThrough` (l. 208) and `Run.fixesThrough_of_takes` (l. 214): read through a projection π, a taken move's outcome is fixed. `Run.generalizes` (l. 239): where P factors through π into a determined Q, a fixed outcome for a at k is the projected outcome of a at every configuration projecting to k, observed or not. B: `Confound.misattributes` (l. 331): read through the outcome alone, the record fixes different outcomes for two moves that make no difference anywhere.
places.level: N.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: S (not a loss): `keepHistory_new` (l. 174): along any run of `keepHistory P`, the configuration at i differs from that at j for every i < j, so a kept history never returns. Concluded from the history growing by one each step (`keepHistory_length` l. 167). Nothing here is lost.
places.both_outcomes: B: `Confound.confounded` (l. 345) and `Confound.varied_refutes` (l. 353): the same wrong model is never excluded under aligned moves and excluded under varied moves. N for going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `FactorsThrough` (l. 222): every step of P read through π is a step of Q, a simulation. `Run.stepsThrough_of_factors` (l. 231) and `Run.generalizes` (l. 239) carry the record's fixings across it. `retarget` (l. 92) and `retarget_determined` (l. 96): a determined process differing only at an untaken move admits the same run.

places.states: For any balanced flow on a web, the module defines four levels of closure: feeding, influence (being affected), reach (affecting) and the system (sharing). It proves that the comparison of the levels with and without a part, or between two balanced flows that start alike, is decided within what the part (or their difference) has reached before each step: any significance covering that gives the continuation condition's comparisons (retains iff includes; not adds iff not exceeds). The laws are general; the built cases Trophic, Static, Clearing, Margin and Late show the levels coming apart and where the comparison stops.
places.moves: N: there is no Process S A, policy or choice among steps. A part is a fixed family (part : F → Bool) that is withheld with the rest of the exchange held fixed, and two given flows are compared. That is a comparison, not a choice with a keeping law.
places.reading: S: `Flow.Balances.comparison_local` (l. 504): two significances (sig : Pos → Nat → F → Prop) that agree from standpoint p on every formation the part has reached before each step compare the levels with and without the part alike (Retains both ways and not Adds both ways). `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_reach` (l. 525): any significance covering what the part has reached gives Retains ↔ Includes and ¬Adds ↔ ¬Exceeds. So what the significance registers on the reached formations decides the verdict. B: `Clearing.system_counts_dweller` (l. 1259): significance bounded by the system has the clearer's part fail to retain, losing the dweller; bounded by the influence closure, it retains.
places.level: S: Conditions have levels W.level t c, with Balances: the level after a step plus what is taken equals the level before plus what is given. `Flow.Balances.levels_agree` (l. 279) and `Flow.Balances.agrees_iff_even` (l. 322): the levels with and without a part agree at a step exactly when the part has given as much as it has taken. `Flow.Balances.le_withheld` (l. 335): withholding a part that gives nothing never lowers a level. What is given is a function of the flow, not something that depends on what is left. B: running down is shown in `Trophic.mediates` (l. 994: in responsiveWeb the forest is unsupported from step 2 on) and in `Clearing.uncoupled` (l. 1232: the dweller is inactive from step 2 on).
places.giving: B: `Clearing.no_levels_without_source` (l. 1320): with the source's part withheld and the rest fixed, no levels balance the flow, so the comparison by withheld levels does not exist. Generally, give is a function of the Flow handed in; givers are formations present at a step, but no general statement makes the giver a going-on that can be lost.
places.no_return: B: `Trophic.mediates` (l. 994): ∀ n, ¬ responsiveWeb.Supported (n+2) forest. `Clearing.uncoupled` (l. 1232): ∀ n, ¬ web.active (n+2) dweller. Both are built into the profiles of the cases, not concluded from a general law of no return. N for a general law.
places.both_outcomes: S, but of keeping and not keeping significant continuations, not of going on and ending. `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_reach` (l. 525) gives Retains ↔ Includes, and `Flow.Balances.agrees_or_reaches_before` (l. 412) gives a dichotomy: at each required condition the levels agree or the part reached before. B: `Clearing.uncoupled` (l. 1232) shows both outcomes in one case: with the habitat spared the dweller is supported throughout; with it cleared, the dweller ends.
places.comparison: S: `Flow.Balances.levels_agree` (l. 279): two balanced flows that start a condition alike and take and give alike keep it alike. `Flow.Balances.support_agrees` (l. 295): a formation's support follows only the exchanges with what it depends on. `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference` (l. 606): for two balanced flows from one start, any significance covering DiffersBefore decides Retains ↔ Includes both ways. `Flow.Balances.retains_transfer` (l. 472) carries retaining from one significance to another. `Flow.Balances.closed_comparison` (l. 683): significance bounded by a region closed under affecting compares as inclusion does.

places.states: For balanced flows in general, the module states exact conditions for a requirement to be met: after one step, at every later step, and over a stretch, with or without supported feeders, and with a giving part withheld. It defines carrying of what is given and feeding across steps, whose closure contains the feeding closure and equals it where nothing given stands. The built cases Provision (a parent fills a store, ends, and its young draws on it) and Redundant (two feeders, either suffices, neither ends) show these.
places.moves: N: there is no choice among steps. Redundant.flow a b is parametrized by which feeders give, but that is a family of built configurations, not a process with moves.
places.reading: S, in a narrow sense only. `Flow.FollowsGiven` (l. 129) is described as one way of reading what is given within what stands, since amounts carry no mark of origin. `Flow.can_stand_iff` (l. 154): some following keeps part of an amount given positive at a later step exactly where the amount is positive and the condition stands at every step between. No observation or registered rule decides a selection. N for that.
places.level: S: `Flow.meets_over_iff_at` (l. 356): with balance across n steps from T, c meets m at T+n exactly where level at T plus everything given covers everything taken plus m. `Flow.unfed_meets_iff_at` (l. 381): with no supported formation giving and givers supported, c meets m at T+n exactly where its level at T covers everything taken plus m. `Flow.stays_met_iff_at` (l. 346) and `Flow.meets_after_iff_at` (l. 336) are the step-wise forms. What is given is handed in by the flow; it does not depend on what is left.
places.giving: S, in part. `Flow.meets_without_iff_at` (l. 430): with a part that takes nothing withheld, the levels without it meet m at t exactly where the actual level exceeds m by everything the part has given. `Flow.fed_beyond_level_at` (l. 401): where g requires and takes from c at more steps than c's starting level, some supported formation feeds g at one of them. The givers are formations, but their giving is a function of the flow and their own continuation is not modelled as dependent on the level. B: `Redundant.either_suffices` (l. 667), `Redundant.withheld_either` (l. 718) and `Redundant.withheld_both` (l. 728): with both feeders withheld no levels balance. `Provision.through_store` (l. 559): the parent ends after the first step while what it gave feeds the young.
places.multiplying: N: Provision has a parent and its young, but no law of the step changes a number of units.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.depleted_keeps_nothing` (l. 171): where the condition is depleted at a step after the giving and up to t, no following keeps any of the amount given standing at t. This is concluded, about a carried amount. B: `Redundant.neither_ends` (l. 679): with neither feeder the consumer is active at step 0 and at no later step, and its run of consecutive active steps is at most the store's starting level. `Provision.through_store` (l. 559): the parent is not active from step 1 on.
places.both_outcomes: S: `Flow.stays_met_iff_at` (l. 346), `Flow.meets_over_iff_at` (l. 356) and `Flow.unfed_meets_iff_at` (l. 381) are exactly-when statements of a requirement staying met or failing, general for balanced flows. B: in Redundant, `either_suffices` (l. 667: active and supported at every step) against `neither_ends` (l. 679: active at the first step only).
places.comparison: S: `Flow.meets_without_iff_at` (l. 430) compares the levels with and without a giving part. `Flow.WithinFeeding.across` (l. 272): the feeding closure lies within the closure across steps. `Flow.ClosedAcross.fedClosed` (l. 267): a region closed under feeding across steps is closed under feeding. `Flow.withinFeedingAcross_iff_of_unheld` (l. 318): where nothing given stands after its step, the two closures agree. `Flow.carried_of_given_exceeds` (l. 189): an amount given exceeding everything taken is carried however the taking falls.
places.rank: S: `Flow.fed_beyond_level_at` (l. 401): consuming at more steps than the starting level forces a supported feeder, so without one consumption lasts at most the level. B: `Redundant.neither_ends` (l. 679), through Flow.Balances.consumption_ends_with_feeders, which is stated in another module not opened here: n consecutive active steps implies n ≤ level 0.
places.closed_region: S: `Flow.closedAcross_within` (l. 292): the closure across steps is closed under feeding across steps. `Flow.beyond_gives_nothing_across` (l. 297): what lies beyond it gives nothing at any step to a condition carried to a step at which a member requires it. B: `Provision.young_alone` (l. 543): the young alone is closed under feeding.
places.forms_change: B: `Provision.through_store` (l. 559): the parent is active at the first step only and gives one unit to a store; the young is active at the third step, supported by what the parent gave (web.level 2 () = flow.give 0 parent ()). One formation ends and another goes on from what it left.

places.states: For any balanced flow on a web, every rise is given and every fall is taken, and the family's stock obeys a balance over each step and over any stretch. Recurring uptake or rising needs recurring replenishment, and more takers without end need replenishment, and at bounded capacity givers, without bound. The laws are general; the built cases Growing, Expansion, Steady, Oscillation, Cycle and Pulse show the premises consistent and the limits of the laws.

What is given is handed in by the flow, not dependent on what is left.

The givers are formations of the flow, but no statement makes their giving depend on their own continuation or on the level. B: `Cycle.closed_more` (l. 1016): the renewers are the takers themselves.

B: `Expansion.more` (l. 845): a renewer and a grower arise at every step, takers = t. `Pulse.pulsed` (l. 1165): renewers are without bound yet absent at every odd step.
places.no_return: N: no point of no return is stated. uptake_needs_replenishment_from (l. 571) concludes that recurring uptake cannot go on with no replenishment, using falls_not_recurring from another module.
places.both_outcomes: S, of rising, not of going on and ending. `BalancesOn.rises_iff_gives` (l. 491): across a step with nothing taken, some member rises exactly when some formation gives to the family. `balances_iff_units` (l. 348) is an exactly-when between balance and matchings. places.states: Its one general law, formedWorld_before, says the following for any couplings κ that read only what comes before a step (ReadsBefore). Up to step T, a world whose strengths are read off its own standing stands as the balanced world carried by the couplings it read before T. The rest are built worlds (onset, threshold, schedule, sparse) whose standing is cited from Closing and Frequency as the standing of a balanced world, with a loop forming at a step and the standing doubling or staying polynomial.
places.moves: N: no Process S A, policy, plan or allowed set was found; the worlds are carried by given couplings, with no choice among steps.
places.reading: S: `formedWorld_before` (l. 61): under `ReadsBefore κ`, the standing up to T of the world whose couplings `formedCouplings` (l. 53) are read off its own standing equals the standing of the carried world of `strengthsBefore T` of those couplings, so what the world registered before T decides its course to T. B: `thresholdWorld_course` (l. 115): the loop of the couplings read off the threshold world's own standing is OnLoop with strengths before θ+1 and not OnLoop with strengths before θ.
places.share: N: `Frequency.count` (the number of marked steps) appears in `scheduleWorld_course` (l. 137), but it is not a share of one kind among several, and nothing is set again from it.
places.level: N: the standings in the built worlds stay or grow (D, doubling, D*(1+M)^a); no level that runs down was found.
places.giving: N: the couplings κ and the schedules are functions handed in; no giver that is a going-on of the model which can be lost.
places.multiplying: N: amounts double (`onsetWorld_course` l. 87), but no units leave units and no kinds form kinds.
places.no_return: N.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on versus ending. B: `thresholdWorld_course` (l. 115) states that the loop forms at θ and not before. S: `scheduleWorld_course` (l. 137) is an exactly-when, but of a polynomial bound (standing bounded by a polynomial iff 2^count is), not of going on or ending.
places.comparison: S: `formedWorld_before` (l. 61) carries the formed world's standing to that of a carried world up to T. B: the last clauses of `onsetWorld_course` (l. 87) and `thresholdWorld_course` (l. 115) say that up to T (or θ) the world stands as the world of every later onset or threshold, so two worlds are alike up to the earlier step.
places.rank: N.
places.closed_region: N: `Balanced` is asserted of each world, but no invariant region, kernel or fixed point was found.
places.forms_change: B: `onsetWorld_course` (l. 87) and `thresholdWorld_course` (l. 115): the world stands unchanged and then a loop forms at T or θ, from which the standing (plus one) doubles at every step, and up to that step it cannot be told from a world whose loop forms later. `sparseWorld_course` (l. 150): the coupling recurs while the standing stays polynomial.

places.place: Founding.lean: Flow.confined_ends, Flow.survivors_independent, Flow.ConfinedRise.ends, varied_before, Nested.raises_iff_carried, Nested.raises_iff_among, Body.spread_outlasts, Germline.unsequestered_falls
places.states: General laws over Flow, Web and Generations, with these premises: balance, only active formations give, activity needs support, renewal gated on a family of conditions, and excess over n steps from a stock below n+m. A lineage confined to the family has no member after T+n (`confined_ends`, `ConfinedRise.ends`), and every later member descends from one that did not depend on the family (`survivors_independent`). Also general: selection within needs variation arisen since a uniform founding (`varied_before`); for nested wholes, the mean founding value rises exactly where selection among wholes, with the within-whole change as transmission, comes out positive (`raises_iff_carried`), and under `Sequestered` exactly where selection among wholes goes for it (`raises_iff_among`). Built: `Body` and `Germline`.
places.moves: N: there is no Process with a choice among steps; generations, kids and flows are given.
places.reading: S: the amount `G.amount` is any reading (D: account l. 70). `Nested.raises_iff_among` (l. 322): under `Founded` and `Sequestered`, the mean founding value rises at t iff `discordAt t < concordAt t`, so selection on the amount decides the rise. `Flow.Rise.selected` (l. 150) is a premise that the amount is positive exactly at the lineage's members and that concord exceeds discord.
places.share: S: `Nested.raises_iff_carried` (l. 300) and `raises_iff_among` (l. 322) concern `Generations.Raises`, the mean founding value over the wholes. B: `Germline.sequestered_rises` (l. 902) and `unsequestered_falls` (l. 912) have the sum over size going from a half to one, or from a half to none. N: no rule or favouring is set again from that mean or share.
places.level: S: `Flow.confined_ends` (l. 124) and `survivors_independent` (l. 106): from a family's stock `W.stock ds T < n + m`, with uptake exceeding replenishment at each of n steps, and renewal gated (every giver to the family requires it at need ≥ m), the lineage ends. What comes back depends on what is left through the gated premise; the law is cited from `GroupEnding.Flow.family_childless`.
places.giving: S: the `gated` premise of `confined_ends` (l. 127) and `Rise.gated` (l. 153): whatever is present and gives to the family requires a condition of the family at need ≥ m. With `Acting` and `Dependent`, givers are formations of the model that become inactive when the family runs down, not a function handed in. B: `Body.give_body` (l. 678): nothing gives to the body.
places.cost: B: `Germline.within_against` (l. 896): within the first whole, selection at the second generation goes against holding back (`concordAt 1 < discordAt 1`), so the part that holds back leaves fewer offspring within. N: no general law that keeping costs the keeper.
places.multiplying: S: in `Generations`, each generation is the flatMap of kids. `lineage` and `Flow.confined_ends` (l. 124) conclude that the lineage at T+n+k+1 is `[]`. `Nested.Founded` (l. 265): wholes found next wholes from their members. B: `Germline.unsequestered_falls` (l. 912): size 1 = 2; `Body.spread_outlasts` (l. 795).
places.no_return: S, concluded: `Flow.confined_ends` (l. 124) and `ConfinedRise.ends` (l. 170): for every k, `lineage G h (T + n + k + 1) = []`, from the premises of excess, a start stock below n+m and gated renewal. The loss is of the family that gives to itself (renewal gated on the family), and the confined lineage is lost with it, whatever selection had raised. B: `Body.confined_ended` (l. 761); `Body.body_ended` (l. 787): from step one nothing depending on the body at need two is active.
places.both_outcomes: B: in `Body`, the confined lineage ends (`confined_ended` l. 761) while the spreading lineage, meeting every clause of a rise too (`spread_rise` l. 768), has a member after the body ends (`spread_outlasts` l. 795). In `Germline`, the mean rises when sequestered and falls when not (l. 902, l. 912). S: `raises_iff_carried` (l. 300) and `raises_iff_among` (l. 322) are general exactly-whens, of the mean rising rather than of going on or ending.
places.comparison: S: `Nested.raised_carried` (l. 280) and `lowered_carried` (l. 289) carry what transmission raised or lowered across a generation of wholes to how far the next founders moved from their founder within its whole. `raises_iff_carried` (l. 300) and `varied_within` (l. 328) relate the among-wholes change to the within-whole change. N: no simulation or order kept by a step.
places.rank: S: `Flow.confined_ends` (l. 124) gives ending within a bound: n steps of excess from a stock below n+m end the confined lineage by generation T+n+1. The drain is in the cited `GroupEnding.Flow.family_childless`.
places.closed_region: S: `uniform_until` (l. 183): founded uniform at v, with exact transmission at every step before t, every member at t carries v, an invariant kept along generations. `exact_of_sequestered` (l. 313): under Founded and Sequestered, transmission across wholes is exact.
places.forms_change: S: `Flow.survivors_independent` (l. 106): after the family's end, every member of a later generation is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at need ≥ m, so what goes on is what did not depend on what ended. `Nested.Founded` (l. 265): wholes founded by parts of earlier wholes, generation after generation. B: `Body.spread_outlasts` (l. 795) with `body_ended` (l. 787): the spreading lineage's descendant, depending on a condition outside the body, has a member after every body-dependent part has ended.

places.place: Fragments.lean: Fragment.same_probes_iff_ends, joint_iff_probes, readJoint_iff, joined_assoc, probes_miss_course, passage_not_self_joint
places.states: General for every `Process S A`: fragments (start, course, finish) that are traced join where the first finishes where the second starts; joining is functional and associative, keeps fragments traced, and has the idle fragment as identity. Read through probes, two traced fragments answer alike exactly where their ends agree (`same_probes_iff_ends`), the probes recover joining (`joint_iff_probes`), and an exact presentation recovers it from codes (`readJoint_iff`). Built: `once` and `loops`.
places.moves: S: `Fragment.Traced` (l. 46) is a core `Trace` of a `Process S A`. `merge_traced` (l. 75): two joining traced fragments, one after the other, are traced. `joined_assoc` (l. 101): joining is associative. N: no law about what some choice or every choice keeps.
places.reading: S: `probes` (l. 145) reads a fragment by whether it joins before or after the idle fragment at each configuration. `same_probes_iff_ends` (l. 151): two traced fragments answer alike iff they start alike and finish alike. `joint_iff_of_same_probes` (l. 195): fragments answering alike join alike. `readJoint_iff` (l. 186): a presentation exact on the probes recovers joining from codes alone. B: `probes_miss_course` (l. 238): two loops by different moves answer every probe alike while their courses differ.
places.level: N.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: B: `passage_not_self_joint` (l. 217): in the process `once` (false to true only), the passage cannot join itself, since it finishes where it does not start. This is built, not a general irreversibility law, and concerns no level or giver.
places.both_outcomes: N.
places.comparison: S: `joint_iff_of_same_probes` (l. 195): for traced f, f', g, g' with f, f' answering the probes alike and g, g' alike, `Joint P f g ↔ Joint P f' g'`, which carries joining between fragments read alike. N: no law between two processes.
places.rank: N.
places.closed_region: N: the idle fragment is an identity for joining (`joined_idle_left` l. 129, `joined_idle_right` l. 134), but no invariant region was found.
places.forms_change: N.

places.place: Frame.lean: invariant_iff_closedUnder, Invariant.reach, reach_iff_withinClosure, closure_iff_certified, not_within_of_closed, ReturnsAlong.whole, Reach.map, Novel
places.states: General: a `Frame` is a `Process S A` with the claims realized at each configuration. The module gives runs and the grammar's closure under any relation (ClosedUnder = «闭», WithinClosure = «所闭») with its laws (reflexive, transitive, monotone, symmetric under a symmetric relation, a certificate of a closure). Reach is the closure of the steps, an invariant is a region closed under them, and invariants hold along reach and runs. There are no built models apart from definitions.
places.moves: S: `Run` (l. 64) is an infinite execution of a `Process S A`. `Invariant` (l. 265) is kept by every admissible step whatever its action. `Invariant.reach` (l. 282): what holds at s and is kept by every step holds at every t reached from s, so every course keeps it. `Invariant.run` (l. 286) says the same along a run.
places.reading: S: `Frame.realized` (l. 57) and `Novel` (l. 296) take a `reading : C → Prop` and a record `before : S → C → Prop` of the configuration; the only law is `Novel.mono` (l. 300), novelty is monotone in the reading. N: no law in which what is registered decides something. D: the account (l. 11) says readings are stated over the frame in later layers.
places.level: N.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: S, concluded from a closed region: `not_within_of_closed` (l. 153): where a region closed under a relation holds f and not g, g is not within f's closure. With `reach_iff_withinClosure` (l. 251) and `invariant_iff_closedUnder` (l. 275), from a start inside an invariant region no course reaches outside it. `WithinClosure.not_rel` (l. 132): nothing within a closure bears the relation to what lies beyond. This is not tied to a level or to the loss of a giver.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on versus ending. S: `closure_iff_certified` (l. 146) is an exactly-when about closures (a region is f's closure iff it holds f, is closed and lies within f's closure).
places.comparison: S: `Reach.map` (l. 227): a map preserving steps from P to Q carries reachability. `Reach.lift` (l. 234): where every Q-step from q s lifts to a P-step, reachability in Q from q s is reflected to P. `WithinClosure.mono` (l. 122): a larger relation has a larger closure.
places.rank: N.
places.closed_region: S: `invariant_iff_closedUnder` (l. 275): an invariant is a region closed under the steps. `Invariant.reach` (l. 282) and `Invariant.run` (l. 286). `closure_iff_certified` (l. 146) is a certificate of a closure. `WithinClosureOf.least` (l. 196): a group's closure is the least closed region holding every member. `closedUnder_withinClosure` (l. 139). `ReturnsAlong.whole` (l. 176): one returning element whose closure is the whole makes every closure the whole.
places.forms_change: S, definition only: `Novel` (l. 296) is a claim of a reading realized at t and not recorded as realized before; its one law is `Novel.mono` (l. 300). N: no statement that the going on continues while what is present changes, or that more can go on after.

places.place: FreeEnergyCounting.lean: bound, bound_eq_iff, bound_lt_of_not_proportional, bound_given_record, given_record_eq_iff_share, Witness.total_two_unreached
places.states: General: for natural counts n and weights a over any listed hypotheses, `N^N * ∏ a^n ≤ A^N * ∏ n^n` (`bound`), with equality exactly where the counts are proportional to the weights (`bound_eq_iff`) and strictness otherwise. This is the free-energy bound in counting form, an AM-GM inequality. Joined to the core's generative model: the total joint weight is the record's weight (`record_total`), and with hypotheses listed once, the count beliefs at the bound are exactly those matching each hypothesis's share given the record (`given_record_eq_iff_share`). The witnesses are built.
places.moves: N.
places.reading: S: `given_record_eq_iff_share` (l. 598): with `Distinct hs`, the count belief n reaches the bound iff at every listed hypothesis n h over the total is the same ratio as the hypothesis's share given the record `rec`. `given_record_eq_iff` (l. 569): reaching the bound iff `n h * E = joint h * N`, E the record's weight. So the registered record decides which beliefs reach the bound. B: `Witness.duplicate_share` (l. 710): a hypothesis listed twice breaks the join.
places.share: S: counts over a total stand for shares n h / N (account l. 52), and the share given the record appears in `given_record_eq_iff_share` (l. 598). N: no rule or favouring is set again from the share; there is no step.

places.giving: N.
places.no_return: N.

places.comparison: N: `rearrange` (l. 103) is a rearrangement inequality of numbers, not a law carrying something between processes or starts.
places.rank: N.

places.place: FreeEnergyGuarantees.lean: RiskAndNeeds.need_ends, restraint_unread, expectation_not_course, IdenticalCells.two_alike_stay_alike, descent_commutes, exchanged_run, unique_minimum_alike, SharedModels.alike_not_one, OneGoal.continues, OneGoal.three_end
places.states: General laws: under any descent that reads no cell's number, two neighbouring alike cells stay alike at every step (`two_alike_stay_alike`); with an exchangeable field the descent commutes with exchange (`descent_commutes`, `exchanged_run`), and a unique minimum of a symmetric free energy has alike neighbours (`unique_minimum_alike`). Under the outrun premises of `Flow.outrun_below`, whatever chooser gives an outside member's takes, the level is below the need and the member inactive from T+n (`need_ends`), and no score reading only from T+n tells that course from the restrained one (`restraint_unread`). Built: `TwoCells`, `Outrun`, and `SharedModels` (held pair, Exceeding/Alone, OneGoal two and three regulators).
places.moves: S: `Chooser` (l. 523): actions `first :: others`, a model `predict`, a preferred level; `chosen` (l. 542) is the first action of least risk (`chosen_minimizes` l. 545). `need_ends` (l. 582): for every member g outside the rest and every chooser, model, reading and preferred level giving g's takes, for every k, `W.level (T+n+k) c < m` and g, depending at need ≥ m, is not active; no choice keeps the need. `restraint_unread` (l. 605) treats a chooser and `Chooser.restraint` (l. 554) alike.
places.reading: S: `restraint_unread` (l. 605): every score of level histories that reads the condition only from T+n on gives the chooser's course and the restrained course the same score. `two_alike_stay_alike` (l. 344): the field reads a cell's state and the configuration, never its number, so alike cells get alike successors. `Chooser` reads R through `reading : Nat → R` (l. 589). `expectation_not_course` (l. 651): a chooser reading the level that chooses at no risk predicts its preferred level, and the level reached is below that prediction.
places.share: N: `othersField` (l. 252) sums what the other cells give, but there is no share of one kind among several and no rule set again from one.
places.level: S: `need_ends` (l. 582) premises: the condition c's level starts below n+m, the rest jointly takes more than is given at each of n steps from T, and renewal is gated at need m; it concludes the level is below m at every step from T+n on. What comes back depends on what is left through the gated renewal, cited from `Flow.outrun_below`. `outside_takes_nothing` (l. 628): at a level ≤ 1 with the rest outrunning, an outside member present takes nothing.
places.giving: S: the `gated` premise of `need_ends` (l. 584): every giver present requires the condition at need ≥ m. With `Acting` and `Dependent`, givers are members of the model that become inactive, cited from `Flow.outrun_ends`. B: in `Outrun` (l. 680–720) the renewer depends on the condition at need three and is active at step zero only; in `OneGoal.three_end` (l. 1010) no member, the renewer included, is active from step one.
places.cost: N: no law that keeping or giving costs the keeper. B: `Outrun.ends_either_way` (l. 746): the restrained first member takes nothing and ends anyway, so restraint does not keep it, but no cost to the restrainer is stated as such.
places.multiplying: N: the number of cells is kept along a descent (`run_length` l. 329; `length_exchangeAt` l. 234); no units leave units.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `need_ends` (l. 582) concludes for every k from T+n that the level is below m and the dependent member is inactive. This is at the loss of what gives (gated renewal whose givers depend on the condition). `restraint_unread` (l. 605): no score reading only after T+n can tell restraint. B: `OneGoal.three_end` (l. 1010): from step one no member is active; `alike_not_one` (l. 863): in Exceeding no member is active from step two.
places.both_outcomes: B: `OneGoal.continues` (l. 939), where two regulators reading the shared level keep all three members active at every step, against `OneGoal.three_end` (l. 1010), where three regulators end every member from step one. `SharedModels.alike_not_one` (l. 863): the same forager ends with the pair (Exceeding) and continues alone (Alone). `TwoCells.alike_rests` (l. 441) against `TwoCells.parts` (l. 480): alike cells stay, a broken start parts. All built.
places.comparison: S: `descent_commutes` (l. 262): with an exchangeable field, the descent commutes with exchanging cells k, k+1. `exchanged_run` (l. 280): the run from the exchanged start is the exchanged run. `rests_exchanged` (l. 287). `minimum_exchanged` (l. 388): exchanging cells of a minimum gives a minimum. `restraint_unread` (l. 605) compares two flows L, L' under a score and finds them alike.
places.rank: S: `need_ends` (l. 582) is ending within a bound: from a level below n+m, with n steps of outrunning from T, the level is below the need from T+n on. `expectation_not_course` (l. 651) applies from T+n under the same bound.
places.closed_region: S: `keeps_exchange_fixed` (l. 273): from a configuration fixed by the exchange, every configuration of a commuting run is fixed by it. `two_alike_stay_alike` (l. 344): an alike neighbouring pair is kept at every step. `unique_minimum_alike` (l. 397). B: `TwoCells.alike_rests` (l. 441): [1,1] is a rest; `TwoCells.parts` (l. 480): from step one the run rests at [0,3].
places.forms_change: B: `OneGoal.continues` (l. 939) with `OneGoal.level` (l. 892): the level alternates four, two, by turns, while all members stay active at every step. `TwoCells.parts` (l. 480): from [1,2] the two cells part to the two ends and rest there. `SharedModels.alike_not_one` (l. 863): the same forager continues alone where with a second it ends. N: no general law of continuation while what is present changes.

places.place: Frequency.lean: carried_le_count, carried_le_disturbed, runaway_of_roundTrip, carried_le_of_rare, Frequency.SelfLoop.polynomial_iff, Frequency.Sparse, settled_iff_recursOrStops, lpo_of_settled, gap_le_count, Saturation.stops_iff, Saturation.floored, Saturation.wearing_stops
places.states: The general laws are about the carrying law of couplings over a world with its conditions listed. The carried amount is at most (D + E·d)·(1+M)^a, with a the number of coupling steps (`carried_le_disturbed`, `carried_le_count`). Returns in time order at least double what has reached a condition, so returns that come often enough run away (`runaway_of_roundTrip`), while rare couplings keep the amount polynomial (`carried_le_of_rare`). That every schedule settles is exactly the dichotomy `RecursOrStops` (`settled_iff_recursOrStops`). A coupling whose strength is saturated by what has passed stops exactly where its response reaches zero (`Saturation.stops_iff`). The built models are the self-loop on any schedule (`Frequency.SelfLoop`), the sparse schedule (`Frequency.Sparse`), and the once- and row-couplings `Frequency.First` and `Frequency.Rows`.
places.moves: N: no `Process S A`, policy or allowed set occurs. The schedule `on : Nat → Bool` and the strengths `k` are given, not chosen. `Frequency.coupling` (l. 332) is read off the strengths, not chosen.
places.reading: S: `Saturation.strengths` (l. 1122) sets the strength of each reading of d into c at a step to `sat a`, where a is the amount already passed through that coupling (`Saturation.passed`, l. 1114). `Saturation.stops_iff` (l. 1329) states that, with strengths f(a)·k, f not rising, k acting at each step through a present formation outside the part, d listed and its level standing, the coupling stops by some step exactly where f is zero at some amount. What has passed thus decides whether the coupling acts. No class of things read alike occurs.
places.share: N: `Frequency.count` (l. 139) counts marked steps, but nothing is a count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule is set again from a share.
places.level: S: the response of a saturated coupling is drawn down by what passes through it. `Saturation.wearing_stops` (l. 1454): in the formed course, with strengths (A − a)·k, a what has passed, k acting at each step and d standing at the start, the coupling stops by step A. `Saturation.passed_lt` (l. 1250): where strengths are zero once A (positive) has passed and no step passes more than m, what has passed stays below A + m. What passes at each step depends on the response at what has passed (`Saturation.course_succ`, l. 1403). The carried levels themselves never fall (`Saturation.course_stands`, l. 1414).
places.giving: N: what gives is the strength function k (or sat) and the list `present` of formations, both handed in. The stopping of a coupling is concluded (`Saturation.stops`, l. 1212), but the coupling is a strength function, not a unit, kind or formation of the model that is lost.
places.cost: S, in the coupling's own response only: under the premise `Saturation.Antitone` (l. 1127), or with f not rising in `stops_by_zero` (l. 1305), what passes through a coupling lowers that coupling's later strength. `wearing_stops` (l. 1454) is the case (A − a). Nothing charges the formation that gives.
places.multiplying: N: no units leave units and no kinds form kinds.
places.no_return: S, concluded from a premise on strengths. `Saturation.stops` (l. 1212): where `ZeroFrom sat d c A` (strengths zero once A has passed) and A has passed by step N, the coupling stops by N. `StopsBy.not_recurs` (l. 705) and `Saturation.not_recurs` (l. 1221): it then does not recur. `Saturation.passed_from` (l. 1239): nothing more passes after N. The loss is of a coupling (what gives), not of a low level. That irreversible zero strength holds is the premise ZeroFrom. Whether each coupling either recurs or stops is not decided without `RecursOrStops` (`recurs_or_stops`, l. 803).
places.both_outcomes: S: `Saturation.stops_iff` (l. 1329), general: the coupling stops by some step iff its response f reaches zero at some amount. `Saturation.course_stops_iff` (l. 1443) is the same in the formed course. `Saturation.floored` (l. 1343) gives the other side: with f ≥ 1 the coupling recurs. `settled_iff_recursOrStops` (l. 1008) and `settled_every_iff` (l. 1024): every schedule settles exactly where RecursOrStops holds. places.states: The corpus's candidate theorems read as general statements over every carrier and relation: correlatives of one relation stand together (two independent relations do not), the return of correlatives of a mark is equivalent to double-negation stability, an occurrence has no own position exactly when it is not-not conditioned and not its own condition, every condition precedes its result exactly where the net has no cycle, and the core is never separated at a finite stage of inquiry, the converse holding where the relation of no separating stage is constant. Built countermodels include an infinitely branching net (致诘不尽), the successor net on the naturals (薪尽火传, 有生不必有亡) and small witnesses for contact and marks.

places.both_outcomes: S: «有成坏当且仅当不自缘» (l. 286): an occurrence begins under some class, and ends under some class, exactly when it is not its own condition; «念念灭当且仅当无自缘» (l. 281): everything ends under identity iff nothing is its own condition (general). places.states: General conditional laws for every carrier and relation: what ends under E alters exactly where it has a successor under F, and under F constant both ways altering and passing through are one; where everything has a coarse successor and the fine class parts every step, everything is 全生成; a non-returning line held by a list is shorter than the list and so not endless; what the core puts together never ends alike; dependence «依» and its laws. Each comes with built witnesses showing where its premise fails the conclusion can fail (day and night, the short line, counting, small Unit/Bool nets).

B: «生于核下可变之例» (l. 577): beginning is not kept along the forward core.

Not at the loss of something that gives. B: «亡而息之例» (l. 49): an end with nothing after it ceases and does not alter.
places.both_outcomes: S: «亡而两向有常则异当且仅当通» (l. 138): for what ends under E, with F a class constant under R and its converse, altering under F exactly where it passes through (never-ending going and coming); «亡者异当且仅当有后» (l. 43): what ends under E alters into a continuation under F iff it has a successor under F. places.place: GrammarCourse.lean: Law.core_is_sameFuture, Law.constant_iff_keeps, Law.unending_iff, Law.ends_iff_changes, Law.continues_in_core_iff, Law.stays_of_constant, Law.learnable_iff_core, TwoCourses.core_iff, TwoCourses.core_exact, core_iff_below
places.states: For every determined law next : S → S and map o, the module proves that the law's step read as a relation makes constancy the same as the law keeping a relation, and the core of the value class the same as SameFuture (courses through the map agree at every step), so the coarsest lawful class is the core. Positions on a course follow in general (a line under the value class ends exactly where the value changes next, never ends exactly where the course is constant from there, and a step continues under the core exactly then), together with bounded reading of the core (N + N - 1 steps, exact for two courses) and learnability through the core.
places.moves: N: the law is determined (next : S → S); no choice among steps.

places.giving: N

General for every determined law and value type.

places.place: GrammarCrossing.lean: «不出当且仅当不外者闭», «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭», «不出皆闭当且仅当排中», «逆之不出当且仅当外者不出», «对称则不出当且仅当逆不出», «闭而有入之例», «内至外之线有出步»
places.states: For every carrier, relation R and region P, the module states how not going out of a region («不出») stands to being closed («闭»): it is the closedness of what is not outside, it is closedness where membership is stable, and that the two coincide everywhere is exactly excluded middle. It also relates going out to coming in along the converse, and places the step going out on a line from inside to outside; all general, with one witness on Bool.
places.moves: N: no process with moves, policy or allowed set; the statements are about one relation R, its converse, and lines «相续» R E. Nothing is stated about what a choice keeps.
places.reading: N: the region P is any proposition. No observation, class read alike, or rule made from what is registered appears.
places.level: N
places.giving: N
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility or loss is stated. S, the nearest: `«内至外之线则非不出»` (l. 139): a line under E from a member of P to something outside means P is not «不出» along R. That is a crossing, not a point of no return.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on or ending. S, the nearest, of closedness: `«不出皆闭当且仅当排中»` (l. 75): that every region not gone out of is closed, for every relation on every carrier in Type, is exactly excluded middle. `«内至外之线有出步»` (l. 150) takes a dichotomy as a premise: each step keeps to P or goes out of it.
places.comparison: S: `«逆之不出当且仅当外者不出»` (l. 102): P is not gone out of along the converse of R exactly where nothing outside P bears R to something not outside P. S: `«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出»` (l. 109): for a symmetric R, «不出» R P ↔ «不出» («逆» R) P. B: `«闭而有入之例»` (l. 120): a non-symmetric relation on Bool with a closed region that something outside comes into. These carry a property between a relation and its converse, not between two processes.
places.rank: N
places.closed_region: S: `«不出当且仅当不外者闭»` (l. 57): «不出» R P ↔ «闭» R (fun y => ¬¬ P y), with no decision. S: `«不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»` (l. 65): given stable membership (¬¬P y → P y), «不出» R P ↔ «闭» R P. B: `«闭而有入之例»` (l. 120).

places.place: GrammarMap.lean: «传», «全生成», «全守», «有终», «延», «尽», «生成», «守», «退化», «延尽不并», «延尽之定当且仅当排中», «全三域之周», «尽则有终当且仅当排中», «生生即延», Map.Endless.generation, «生守相杂»
places.states: For every carrier and relation R, read at a fine class E and a coarse class L, the module defines carrying renewal (the coarse line continues while a fine line begins), strong generation, strong keeping, reaching an end, going on along some branch («延») and ending on every branch («尽», inductive), generation, keeping and degeneration. It proves which of these exclude each other, that with excluded middle the strong forms cover every point, that telling them apart at every point of every model is exactly excluded middle, and that «尽» gives «有终» up to double negation or where going on is decided. All of this is general. Built cases on Nat, Unit, Bool and a two-branch fork show that each region is inhabited.
places.moves: S, partly: there is no Process with actions or policy, but R may branch. `«延»` (l. 225) is a family S holding x, each member continued under L by a member: going on along some branch. `«尽»` (l. 229) is ending on every branch. `«延尽不并»` (l. 233): «尽» R L x → ¬ «延» R L x. B: `Map.«生守相杂»` (l. 553): at the root of the fork, generation along the chain branch and keeping along the still branch.
places.reading: S, as grains rather than observations: every law is read under two classes, a fine E and a coarse L. `«传则异»` (l. 65): a carrying renewal is an alteration, so the fine class tells its two ends apart. `«有常则无终»` (l. 111): where L is constant under R («有常» R L) and x has a predecessor, ¬ «有终» R L x. B: `Endless.generation` (l. 421, under «静») and `Endless.generation_in_pairs` (l. 445, under pairs): which fine class is used decides whether a step counts as a renewal. No rule is made from what is registered.
places.level: N
places.giving: N for a law. D: the opening account glosses the fine parts as what makes up the pattern (cells, flames, members). No statement makes the coarse going-on depend on fine renewal that can be lost; «全生成» holds «不穷» as part of its definition (l. 80), so `«阶全生成则上无终»` (l. 199) follows from the definition.
places.multiplying: N: fine lines begin («生» within «传»), but nothing counts them and no law of the step changes their number.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `«延尽不并»` (l. 233): from a point that ends on every branch, no branch goes on. `«尽则非不穷»` (l. 248). `«有终之所前亦有终»` (l. 149): what reaches a point whose line reaches an end reaches an end too. `«有常则无终»` (l. 111) / `«有终则粗不有常»` (l. 118): reaching an end after a continued step means the coarse class is not constant. All of these concern the loss of the coarse pattern itself, not a low level.
places.both_outcomes: S, general: `«延尽之定当且仅当排中»` (l. 330): every point of every model goes on along some branch or ends on every branch, iff excluded middle. `«不穷有终之定当且仅当排中»` (l. 125): the same for never ending vs reaching an end. `«全三域之周»` (l. 157): given excluded middle, every point is «全生成», «全守» or «有终». `«全三域之定当且仅当排中»` (l. 177). Exclusions: `«全生成有终不并»`, `«全生成全守不并»`, `«全守有终不并»` (l. 97-108), `«生成退化不并»` (l. 296), `«单行则生守不并»` (l. 317, where R is functional). `«尽则有终当且仅当排中»` (l. 584). B: `Map.Short.renews_and_ends` (l. 476) renews and still ends.
places.comparison: S: `«生生即延»` (l. 360): «生生» R E x ↔ «延» («复生至» R E) «一» x. `«息即尽»` (l. 367): «息» R E x ↔ «尽» («复生至» R E) «一» x. Both carry renewal without end, and ceasing, to the some-branch and every-branch forms of a second relation. `«阶全生成»` (l. 195) / `«阶生成则上不退化»` (l. 355): generation at order k keeps order k+1 from degenerating. No law carries a property between two processes or two starts.
places.rank: N for a bound, rank or variant. The inductive `«尽»` (l. 229) is ending on every branch with no bound. `«尽而续可定则有终»` (l. 261): «尽», with going on decided at the points of its line, gives «有终».
places.closed_region: S: `«延»` (l. 225), `«生成»` (l. 274) and `«守»` (l. 279) are each the existence of a family closed under going on, a certificate. `«单行则族含所及»` (l. 305): where R is functional, a family closed under going on contains everything the line reaches. `«全生成之所及亦全生成»` (l. 144): «全生成» is kept along its own line.
places.forms_change: S: `«全生成»` (l. 80) is defined as the coarse line never ending, with a carrying renewal (a new fine line beginning while the coarse pattern continues) ahead of every point. `«全生成之所及亦全生成»` (l. 144), `«生成退化不并»` (l. 296). B: `Map.Endless.generation` (l. 421), `Map.Endless.generation_in_pairs` (l. 445, where a kind goes on across one step and renews beyond every point), `Map.Endless.generates` (l. 483), `Map.«生守相杂»` (l. 553). N for a widening; the account says «全生成则生成» is in KeepingWidening.

places.place: GrammarLaws.lean: «闭», «所闭», «不出», «对», «对则守数», «程守数当且仅当可对», «计», «类之对当且仅当类类等数», «入当且仅当有不返», «定后于有后则入当且仅当不返», «线有限不并则回», «线终不过所列», «尽则不屡», «定后定前则前并生与后并亡同数», «间无生则间亡不过所覆», «有覆而亡屡则生屡», «有界覆而生屡则亡屡», «同行», «像定后当且仅当同行», «广»
places.states: The module states, for every carrier and relation, five groups of shared laws on the grammar: closure («所闭» is reflexive-transitive reach); balance (a one-to-one pairing «对» keeps the count, on regions not crossed and within classes, and gives the census of a step); finite runs (drawn in, return under a fixed successor, pigeonhole return, and ends on lines from a list bounded by the list); rest («尽» of courses gives falls that do not recur); and lumping and order. All of these are general laws. The few built cases on Bool, Nat, Unit and Option Bool are witnesses that a premise cannot be dropped.
places.moves: N for a Process with actions or a policy. S, the nearest: R need not have a fixed successor, and `«尽则不或屡»` (l. 1773) quantifies over every course: where the line's steps from T are Q steps (as far as can be refuted) and every course of Q steps then an F step ends from g T («尽» («而» («所闭» Q) F) «一» (g T)), it is not the case that F steps recur, as far as can be refuted.
places.reading: S: `«像定后当且仅当同行»` (l. 2705): the image of R along a map π has a fixed successor exactly where sameness under π goes alike under R, so the read part carries a law exactly where what π leaves out makes no difference to where it goes. S: `«类之对当且仅当类类等数»` (l. 1031): under a class E decided by a test e, lists are paired under E exactly where every class has equal counts. S: `«定后遍后则核为其内最粗同行之类»` (l. 2643). The test in «计» (l. 853) is a region read as a Bool test.
places.share: S for counts only: `«计»` (l. 853) counts the units of a list that a test holds of. N for a rule or favouring set again from a count. `«承之迭»` (l. 1211) sets each round's region again from the round before (what every condition held), but that region is not a share.
places.level: S: `«对则守数»` (l. 639): a pairing of before++given with after++taken gives after+taken = before+given. `«程守数当且仅当可对»` (l. 820): over a stretch, q(S+n) + total lost = q S + total gained iff unit lists exist with those lengths, paired under «一». These describe a level with gains and losses. N for a level that runs down with what comes back depending on what is left. D: the account says Amounts' falls are cases of the rest law.
places.giving: N: the account says the pairing is supplied, not derived from the unfolding.
places.multiplying: S for turnover counts, not offspring: `«定后定前则前并生与后并亡同数»` (l. 2152): units listed once before and after a step, under a continuation that fixes successors and predecessors and is decided by k: after + ceasing = before + arising. `«线生不过所列»` (l. 1428). N for units that leave units by a law of the step.
places.no_return: S, concluded, general: `«入当且仅当有不返»` (l. 1478): x is drawn in (some closed region it lies outside holds something it reaches) exactly where it reaches some y that does not reach back. `«有后不返则入»` (l. 1522). `«定后于则返者不入»` (l. 1512): with the successor fixed within x's closure, an x that reaches itself is not drawn. This is about reach, at no particular level and not at the loss of something that gives.
places.both_outcomes: S, general, for return vs being drawn in: `«定后于有后则入当且仅当不返»` (l. 1527): with the successor fixed within x's closure and some successor, «入» R x ↔ ¬ «及» R x x. `«有限遍后定后则定前当且仅当皆返»` (l. 1736). `«四比之周»` (l. 2776) gives four cases for two relations. N for a dichotomy of going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `«同行之逐点»` (l. 2571): E-alike occurrences go by R to E-alike occurrences. `«同行之迭»` (l. 2677): the same for n steps. `«保之像»` (l. 2696): a map preserves R exactly where its image lies within R'. `«借步之所闭在二所闭»` (l. 347) / `«二所闭在借步之所闭»` (l. 362): closures under two relations compared. `«所闭之单调»` (l. 257). `«对之接»` (l. 717) composes pairings. `«广之传递»` (l. 2750) and `strictJoin_trans` (l. 2788): an order of relations. `«则逾之定当且仅当排中»` (l. 2807).
places.rank: S: `«尽则不屡»` (l. 1792): falls that end (the inductive «尽» of Q-courses then F) do not recur along a line of Q steps, with no decision; no converse is established (account). S: `«线有限不并则回»` (l. 1647): a line held by a list, merging nothing at its places, comes back to its start within the list's length. Count bounds: `«线终不过所列»` (l. 1374), `«间无生则间亡不过所覆»` (l. 2282). No numeric variant.
places.closed_region: S: `«闭»` (l. 235), `«所闭之闭»` (l. 253), `«所闭不出»` (l. 290), `«所闭之证»` (l. 300): a region is x's closure exactly where it holds x, is closed and lies within the closure. `kept_onward` (l. 1633): a region of Nat that every step keeps holds from where it holds on. S: `«定后遍后则核为其内最粗同行之类»` (l. 2643): with a fixed, total successor, the core of a class is the coarsest class inside it that R goes alike across.
places.forms_change: S: `«有覆而亡屡则生屡»` (l. 2320): in a region P that nothing outside continues into, each step one stage on, with no split, lists covering arbitrarily late stages, and beginning-or-predecessor decided after T, endings recurring give beginnings at arbitrarily late stages. `«有覆而亡屡则生不止»` (l. 2352) and `«所覆后亡屡则生未否»` (l. 2338) are the undecided forms. `«有界覆而生屡则亡屡»` (l. 2436), `«定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡»` (l. 2549), the run form: units come and go while the region continues. For widening, «广» (l. 2724) is only an order of relations; N for a widening over time.
