places.place: GrammarPath.lean: 所经必同, 所缘同于, 至终有常, 本类至终有常, 常闭则后皆续, 后皆续当且仅当后皆同类, 后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭, 出类随线, FiniteSharedCondition.reaches_other_past_end
places.states: General laws for every carrier, net R and class E. A line under a class that leaves a decided region only into a set C passes a member of C alike to its start (所经必同, l. 140). Under constancy, or constancy up to the net's end (至终有常, l. 235), or that constancy at a member's class (本类至终有常, l. 308), a class that holds a member's effects (所缘同于, l. 172) takes in everything downstream of anything alike to it (常闭则后皆续 l. 393; 至终常闭则后皆续 l. 378; 本类常闭则后皆续 l. 364). With no regularity, everything downstream is on the line exactly where it is all alike, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage (l. 188, l. 205). The module also has ten built witnesses, among them Unclosed, Inconstant, FiniteFamilies, FiniteSharedCondition, CleanStep, FiniteWake, FinerOutside, FinerWake, UnevenOutside and OtherLeaves, which show the premises are needed.
places.moves: N: there is no Process with moves, policy or allowed set; only relations R and classes E. Branching appears (in «后不定则至终有常可不同行», l. 296, 0 conditions both 1 and 2), but no law about a choice.
places.reading: S: the class E (an equivalence of occurrences read alike) decides what is reached. `所经必同` (l. 140): where every step out of region P under E lands in C, a line from inside to outside holds a member of C alike to its start. `所经不同则不及` (l. 162): if no member of C is alike to the start, nothing outside is reached. `外分唯系出类之同` (l. 523) and `外分唯系己出之同` (l. 567): how what lies outside the member's class is divided bears on the condition only through alikeness to effects that leave the class. `二分` (l. 604) is the split by a decided predicate. D: the account (l. 71) reads a class drawn by what a member intends as a reading only.
places.share: N: no count or fraction, and no rule set again from one.
places.level: N: no stock or amount. In FiniteFamilies the stages are numbers 0 to 3 with stage < 3 as a cutoff, not a level that runs down.
places.giving: B: in `FiniteSharedCondition` (l. 889–1022), the shared condition is a kind `r` of the model whose stages condition each family's next stage. `reaches_other_past_end` (l. 1010) reaches the second family through it. Nothing states that `r` can be lost; it ends only at the net's last stage. In general laws the region P and the set C are handed-in premises.
places.multiplying: N: no law of number. B: in FiniteFamilies.step (l. 806) one member's old age is followed by the second member's birth within a family. It is a fixed succession, not units whose number changes.
places.no_return: S: `所经不同则不及` (l. 162) concludes that nothing outside the region is reached under the class where the class holds no member of C alike to the start. `亡而网续则不至终有常` (l. 326) and `亡而网续则本类不至终有常` (l. 337) take a line that ends (亡) while its last stage still conditions something as a premise, and conclude that the class is not constant up to the net's end. `亡而网续则后不皆续` (l. 227) concludes that such a line does not take in all downstream. No statement that something lost is not regained.
places.both_outcomes: S, general exactly-whens. `后皆续当且仅当后皆同类` (l. 188): everything downstream lies on the line exactly where it is all alike. `后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭` (l. 205): exactly where the class holds the effects of the member and of each line stage; its failure is `亡而网续则后不皆续` (l. 227), a line that ends while the net goes on. Also `本类常则闭当且仅当后皆同类` (l. 487), `局定后则至终有常当且仅当同行可决` (l. 271), `有常当且仅当至终有常可续` (l. 288), `本类常当且仅当与己相随` (l. 546) and `二分本类常当且仅当内外皆随` (l. 636). B: in FiniteFamilies, `family_takes_in_all` (l. 869) and `member_no_reach` (l. 855) give both outcomes under two classes on one net.
places.comparison: S, between two classes on one net, not between two processes. `外合不失本类之常` (l. 513): where F is coarser than E and keeps m's block, the condition at m's class under E gives it under F. `本类之常至二分` (l. 621): it carries to the split. `外分唯系出类之同` (l. 523) and `闭则外分无关` (l. 596): two classes agreeing on m's block give the condition under one exactly where under the other, given the stated agreement. B: FinerOutside (l. 1164) and FinerWake (l. 1242) show a finer outside division can break it.
places.rank: N: no bound, variant or deadline. B: FiniteFamilies.one_not_constant (l. 820) is a finite net in which every line ends, with no rank stated.
places.closed_region: S: `本类常闭则所缘同类` (l. 346), and in the global form `至终常闭则所缘同类` (l. 355) and `常闭则所缘同类` (l. 385): under constancy at m's class, where m conditions something and its effects are held, whatever is alike to m conditions only what is alike to m, so m's block is closed under steps. `本类常闭则后皆续` (l. 364) extends this to everything downstream. 所经必同 (l. 140) uses a region P with exits only into C.
places.forms_change: B: `FiniteSharedCondition.reaches_other_past_end` (l. 1010): under the coarse class, the line from the first family's first birth reaches the second family's stage 2 past the first member's end, while `member_not_constant_at` (l. 994) shows the member's line ends. `FiniteFamilies.family_takes_in_all` (l. 869): the family's class takes in all downstream while the member's line ends (`member_no_reach`, l. 855). S: `出类随线` (l. 460): under constancy up to the net's end, every occurrence on a member's line that conditions anything has an effect outside the class (the wake; built in FiniteWake.wake_follows, l. 1158).

places.states: Definitions read from the corpus, each for every carrier and relation: alteration 化 (l. 50), continuing under E while F tells the ends apart; 成坏 (l. 59); 同于 (l. 68); return 复 (l. 97); passing through 通 (l. 114). General laws follow: 化为有缘之成坏 (l. 63), 同于为类 (l. 71), 复者住 (l. 106), 有常则往不穷 (l. 117), 两向有常有前则通 (l. 125), 非一非异 (l. 160) and 因灭而续 (l. 172). Built witnesses are 同于不必传递 (l. 81), 有常而不通 (l. 138) and 昼夜往来不穷 (l. 152).
places.moves: N.
places.reading: S: `非一非异` (l. 160): in a net without self-conditioning, nothing continues under identity, yet every condition is a continuation under some class E while identity tells its ends apart. Whether a step continues depends on the class it is read under. `化` (l. 50) reads one step at two classes, E and F. `同于为类` (l. 71): belonging to a common one is a class where each belongs to exactly one.
places.level: N.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: S: `因灭而续` (l. 172): with no self-conditioning, for a condition x→y alike under E, x ends under identity (亡 R 静 x) and y begins under identity, while x→y continues under E. The ending is concluded, relative to identity. B: `有常而不通` (l. 138): counting up from zero, the line coming back ends at zero. No irreversibility or point of no return.
places.both_outcomes: S: `因灭而续` (l. 172) states at once, for one step, ending under identity and continuing under a coarser class E, each relative to its class. This is a both-at-once, not an exactly-when. General.
places.comparison: N: no carrying between two processes or starts. `化为有缘之成坏` (l. 63) is an identity of two relations.
places.rank: N.
places.closed_region: S: `有常则往不穷` (l. 117): under a constant class, a line with a past never ends going. `两向有常有前则通` (l. 125): constant both ways under R and its converse, with a predecessor, gives 通. `复者住` (l. 106): what returns abides.
places.forms_change: S: `化` (l. 50) with `化之二说同形` (l. 53): a continuation under the thing's class while the marks' class F tells the two apart. `因灭而续` (l. 172): the cause ends under identity while the line continues under E. B: `昼夜往来不穷` (l. 152): two occurrences, each the other's condition, alternate without end under the one.

places.states: General laws for every carrier, R and E about the core 核 R E. A step kept under the core can always be kept (守核则不穷, l. 86). A step into an end leaves the core (亡前核变, l. 118), and the two ends of a line that ends lie in different core classes (有亡之线两端核异, l. 132). It also states laws of a Process read move by move (moveRel l. 189, goAlike_iff_constant l. 207), of a rule that changes itself (adaptive_constant_iff l. 221, adaptive_core_iff l. 229, adaptive_core_apart l. 239), and of closed capture read in the grammar (constant_iff_unread l. 263, lock_line l. 324, loss_ends_line l. 352). Built cases: ClosedCapture.Beyond.closed_line (l. 371) and open_line_ends (l. 386).
places.moves: S: `moveRel` (l. 189) reads each move a of a `Process S A` as a relation. `constant_of_goAlike` (l. 194): where every move is possible everywhere and P goes alike by π, the class sameValue π is constant under every move. `goAlike_of_constant` (l. 201) gives the converse for a determined process, and `goAlike_iff_constant` (l. 207) the iff. `adaptive_constant_iff` (l. 221): the state's class is constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to F. Schedules `reads : Nat → Bool` are quantified in constant_iff_unread (l. 263).
places.reading: S: `ClosedCapture.constant_iff_unread` (l. 263): the class of loopPart (share, rule, step count) is constant under the two-level step along every schedule exactly where `Unread f h` (nothing beyond the share is read). `loss_ends_line` (l. 352): a reading h that favours at no configuration whose loss is past N, with a reading step r where N ≤ b + r, from a favouring start, makes the line under favouredAlike not unending. `adaptive_core_apart` (l. 239): where two rules take one state to different states, the core of the state's class tells the configurations apart. B: Beyond.closed_line (l. 371) reads from the share alone (joinRead closedRead) and the locked line never ends; Beyond.open_line_ends (l. 386) reads from the loss (lossRead) and the favouring line ends at the first step.
places.share: S: `ClosedCapture.lock_line` (l. 324): under the premises Raises P favours fA, ReadsShare P M hA (the rule read from the share, monotone), upper-closed favours and Accrues fB, from a start Locked M favours hA (a, g), the line under lockedAlike never ends along the joined step with joinRead hA (the rule read from the share only). This is a rule set again from the share and kept locked. The premises are those of ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss and are handed in.
places.level: S: `loss` (l. 296) is a Nat coordinate. With premise `Accrues fB` (every step adds at least one), `loss_alters` (l. 312) concludes that every step changes the loss. It grows; it is not a stock that runs down with returns depending on it. What the loss decides depends on the reading: under a share-only reading nothing turns (lock_line, l. 324); under a reading that turns past bound N the favouring line ends (loss_ends_line, l. 352).
places.giving: N: the loss step fB and the readings are functions handed in. Nothing that gives to a level is itself a going-on of the model that can be lost.
places.no_return: S: `ClosedCapture.lock_line` (l. 324) concludes from its premises that from a locked start the course stays locked at every step (the line under lockedAlike is unending) while the loss rises each step: no turning back from lock under a share-only reading. It is concluded, and the loss is not of something that gives. `亡前核变` (l. 118) and `有亡之线末步离核` (l. 125) conclude that a line ends only by a step leaving the core. `有亡之线两端核异` (l. 132): its ends are apart in the core.
places.both_outcomes: S: `Law.unending_iff_steps` (l. 146): along a determined law, a line never ends exactly where every orbit step is related by E (general). `constant_iff_unread` (l. 263) is an iff of constancy and Unread. The two outcomes for closed capture come in two theorems under two readings, lock_line (l. 324, unending) and loss_ends_line (l. 352, not unending), not one exactly-when. B: Beyond.closed_line (l. 371) and Beyond.open_line_ends (l. 386): one selection and loss step, the locked line never ending under the share reading and the favouring line ending at step 1 under the loss reading.
places.comparison: S: `goAlike_iff_constant` (l. 207): a determined process with every move possible goes alike by a map π (lumped onto a coarser process) exactly where π's class is constant under every move. `adaptive_core_iff` (l. 229): the state's class is its own core exactly where the rule makes no difference. `守核之线不亡` (l. 111): a line under the core leaves its last occurrence continued under the coarser E.
places.rank: S: `loss_ends_line` (l. 352): with a loss bound N, a reading step r and N ≤ b + r, the favouring line is not unending (by turned_by_loss, the rule no longer favours at r + 1), an ending bounded by the reading step past the bound. No falling variant.
places.closed_region: S: `守核则不穷` (l. 86): from a step under the core, every occurrence its core line reaches has a successor under the core (the core is constant, «根»). `adaptive_core_iff` (l. 229): the state's class is contained in its own core. In `lock_line` (l. 324) the locked configurations are kept along the whole orbit.
places.forms_change: S: `ClosedCapture.lock_line` (l. 324): the line under being locked goes on without end while each step is an alteration (异) under sameValue loss: the going on continues the same while the loss coordinate changes at every step (built in Beyond.closed_line, l. 371). `有亡之线两端核异` (l. 132): a line that ends passes from one core class to another. No widening.

On the base, members depending on a condition, or a coupled family of conditions, whose gated renewal ran into excess leave no descendant from `T + n` on, so groups on one such family end together. Built witnesses (Outweighed, Outweighs, Exhausted, Assorted) show within-group selection outweighing, and differences among groups being used up or kept.

places.states: S: One general law: for every relation r, grouping by r recovers the words of every sequence in the two-word encoding exactly when a→b and c→d are linked and b→a, b→c, d→a, d→c are not (`two_word_iff`, l. 92). Everything else is of one built model: a formed apparatus with a stock receives observation slots (each draws one unit), the log's majority bonds give the grouping through which an utterance is parsed and answered, and the laws are stated of every trace of that one reception process (`reception`, l. 328).
places.moves: S: `reception` (l. 328) is a `Process State (Option Sound)` built by `Assurance.ofMap`; each slot is a move and its step is determined (`step_iff`, l. 331). Laws over every trace: `total_kept` (l. 351), every trace keeps stock plus drawn; `still_without_support` (l. 357), with stock zero every trace ends where it began; `trace_end` (l. 335). `broadenAfterFailure` (l. 176) is a supplied policy: receive more slots exactly where the utterance does not parse; `broadening_trace` (l. 366) says it reaches its state by a trace that keeps stock plus drawn. All of this is of the built model.
places.reading: S/B: what is registered (the log) decides the grouping: `parse` (l. 153) groups by `bond s.log`, the log's majority bonds (defined in Segmentation). B: `context_forms_bond` (l. 231), after the context the bonds are `idealBond`; `order_changes_grouping` (l. 289) and `order_not_frequency` (l. 423): a reordered course with every sound counted alike (`counts_agree`, l. 284) forms a different bond, and the utterance is left unparsed along every trace of it; `gap_breaks_edge` (l. 275), a slot with no sound breaks a transition; `repetition_joins_words` (l. 321). S, general over relations: `two_word_iff` (l. 92).
places.share: B: the grouping is set from a count among several. `bond` is the majority of observed transitions in the log (from Segmentation, used here), and `context_forms_bond` (l. 231) and `order_changes_grouping` (l. 289) show the grouping set from it. N: no law was found in which a favouring sets itself again from the share it already favours; the log grows by the slots supplied, and only `broadenAfterFailure` (l. 176) makes further reception depend on the parse failing.
places.level: S: the machine's stock is a level that receiving and answering draw down. `receive` (l. 159) draws one unit per slot; with stock zero it changes nothing (`receive_short`, l. 196; `still_without_support`, l. 357). Stock plus drawn is kept (`receive_stock` l. 180, `expose_stock` l. 189, `total_kept` l. 351). B: what comes back depends on what is left. `support_used` (l. 409): stock falls from 14 to 4 along the context. `parsed_short` (l. 270) / `parse_without_support` (l. 417): with 27 units the utterance parses but is not answered. `broaden_prefix` (l. 305): with 19 units broadening keeps only a prefix and the utterance still fails. `broaden_one_form` (l. 311): with 21 units it parses one form, unanswered.

places.no_return: S: once the stock is zero, reception changes nothing along every trace (`still_without_support`, l. 357; `receive_short`, l. 196). B: with one unit less the answer is lost (`parsed_short`, l. 270). This is not the loss of something that gives.

B: answered with 28 units (`reception_changes_parse`, l. 386) and unanswered with 27 (`parse_without_support`, l. 417) are two built cases, not one dichotomy.

places.states: S: General laws of extrapolating a course from its prefix. No prefix fixes the next value (`no_prefix_fixes_next`, l. 236), not even among finite worlds (`no_prefix_fixes_next_finite`, l. 570). Every extrapolation misses at every proposal on its diagonal course (`diagonal_misses`, l. 298), whose world no list holds (`diagonal_open`, l. 325). Elimination over candidates misses at most up to an according candidate's place (`index_le_of_accords`, l. 393), and in a world held by a list fewer than `tri l.length` times, with its rest unrefuted (`held_byElimination_bounded`, l. 759; `held_rest_unrefuted`, l. 778). General laws of lumping, training and selection through a map: data fix an untried value exactly where it is lumped with an observed input (`determines_lumped_iff`, l. 867); training through the data leaves the class's freedom (`Training.unselected_beyond_data`, l. 958); a selection through a map is right only where what matters is read off the map (`selects_right_iff`, l. 1058). Built witnesses are `Shift` and `Alternate`.
places.moves: S: there is no `Process S A` with moves in this module (`GoAlikeAt` is moved to LearningRuns). There are general laws about every choice rule. For every extrapolation `pred`, every value it proposes misses on its diagonal course (`diagonal_misses`, l. 298; `diagonal_unrested`, l. 308). For every loss and every choice made from it, functions agreeing on the data are selected alike (`Training.loss_through`, l. 947). Every selection through the data, within a class free at x, leaves every member's value at x reachable by a selected member (`Training.unselected_beyond_data`, l. 958). Every equivariant selection selects alike what the map lumps (`selects_through_lumping`, l. 993).
places.reading: S: the registered decides. Extrapolation is through the prefix: one prefix gives one current candidate and one proposal (`byElimination_through_prefix`, l. 446). `determines_lumped_iff` (l. 867): within the functions lumped by π, finite data fix the value at x exactly where some observed input is lumped with x. `every_determines_nothing` (l. 913): the data alone fix no untried value. `selects_not_right_of_parted` (l. 1013): where what matters holds of one of two alternatives the map lumps and not the other, no selection through the map selects exactly what matters. `through_iff_reads` (l. 1049) and `selects_right_iff` (l. 1058): some selection through r selects p exactly where p is read off r. `values_not_right_of_parted` (l. 1034).

places.level: N: no stock or reserve that runs down.
places.giving: N
places.no_return: S: the elimination's current candidate never falls back (`index_mono`, l. 382; `index_mono_le`, l. 386); a candidate passed missed at an earlier step (`missed_before`, l. 406). This is concluded, of the learner's index. `diagonal_open` (l. 325): the diagonal law's orbit never returns (no list holds it). Neither is the loss of a level or of something that gives.
places.both_outcomes: S: about learning coming to rest, not about going on and ending. Elimination over the lasso candidates on a lasso course is not refuted to rest (`rest_unrefuted`, l. 714), and it rests only on lasso courses (`lasso_of_rest`, l. 730); its diagonal course is no lasso (`diagonal_not_lasso`, l. 787). The exactly-whens `determines_lumped_iff` (l. 867), `Training.fit_right_iff` (l. 970), `free_determines_iff` (l. 898) and `selects_right_iff` (l. 1058) are general. N for a dichotomy of going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `no_prefix_fixes_next` (l. 236) builds two courses sharing a prefix and differing at the next step; a proposal is not right on both. `byElimination_through_prefix` (l. 446) carries the candidate and the proposal between two courses with equal prefix. `Training.loss_through` (l. 947) carries the selection between two functions agreeing on the data. `lumped_right_iff` (l. 884) carries a value from an observed input to a lumped one, right exactly where the world takes one value at the two. `merged_bound` (l. 807) composes the bound one enumeration wider.
places.rank: S: bounds on misses. `index_le_of_accords` (l. 393): where candidate j accords, the index never passes j. `misses_not_recurring` (l. 438). `lasso_byElimination_bounded` (l. 689): the index is at most `tri (i+q) + q`, and the learner proposes from i+q+1 on. `held_byElimination_bounded` (l. 759): under a determined law whose orbit a list l holds, fewer than `tri l.length` misses, with proposals from l.length on. `lasso_of_held` (l. 495): repetition from i with period q+1, i+q+1 ≤ l.length. `stable_unrefuted` (l. 452): a bounded never-falling count is not refuted to be constant from some step. These bound a rising count; no falling rank. B: `Alternate.rests` (l. 1143) is right from step 3.

places.states: S: General laws of learning along runs of any process. At a parting of two runs a proposal misses on one (`missed_on_one_of_part`, l. 173). No run's prefix fixes the next value, even among lasso runs of free branching (`prefix_fixes_no_next`, l. 184). Training on runs' prefixes selects alike runs alike through the map and is right at a moment exactly where the prefix determines it (`loss_through_prefix`, l. 224; `fit_right_iff_runs`, l. 245). Under a determined process an outcome transfers exactly where the two configurations go alike by the move, and structure and change are one lumping (`transfer_right_iff`, l. 92; `goAlike_iff_lumped`, l. 113). Built witnesses are the negation runs and the pair law.
places.moves: S: `GoAlikeAt P π s s' a` (l. 79) is defined for a `Process S A` by a move a. `goAlike_iff_at` (l. 83): going alike is going alike at every two lumped configurations by every move. `transfer_right_iff` (l. 92): for a determined P, the outcome of a observed at s₀ transfers to every step of a from s exactly where s₀ and s go alike by a. `missed_on_one_of_part` (l. 173) and `byElimination_through_prefix` (l. 200) hold for runs of every process.
places.reading: S: `fit_right_iff_runs` (l. 245): every two runs alike through `reg` before t are alike at x exactly where the prefix determines x within `Courses P reg`. `free_prefix_fixes_nothing` (l. 264): under free branching the prefix fixes no later value. `loss_through_prefix` (l. 224); `unselected_beyond_prefix` (l. 234). `claim_not_right_on_both` (l. 371): on runs of a determined law beginning alike in the frame by reg, a proposal is right on at most one where the features differ. `goAlike_iff_lumped` (l. 113). B: `pair_not_learnable` (l. 445): through the first coordinate, no extrapolation predicts the second along every run. `pair_whole_predicts` (l. 453): through both coordinates, elimination predicts from step 2.

places.giving: N
places.no_return: N: no point of no return of keeping or losing. `answer_open` (l. 300): a run of the diagonal law never revisits (no list holds it). B: `negation_never_rests` (l. 415).
places.both_outcomes: N for going on and ending. The exactly-whens `fit_right_iff_runs` (l. 245), `transfer_right_iff` (l. 92), `goAlike_iff_lumped` (l. 113) and `lumped_iff_fixed_image` (l. 101) are of fit and transfer, general.
places.comparison: S: carries between runs. `missed_on_one_of_part` (l. 173): two runs alike through the map before t and apart at t. `byElimination_through_prefix` (l. 200): two runs alike before t give the same candidate and proposal. `transfer_right_iff` (l. 92): the outcome carried from s₀ to s. `prefix_fixes_no_next` (l. 184): relates a run of any process to two runs of free branching with its prefix. `missed_on_one` (l. 388): runs alike in the frame have equal prefixes at every step. `answer_course` (l. 286): the diagonal course is the course of a run of the diagonal law.
places.rank: S: `held_byElimination_bounded` (l. 343): on a run of a determined law whose configurations a list holds, fewer than `tri l.length` misses, proposals from l.length on, and no misses at arbitrarily late steps. `held_rest_unrefuted` (l. 361). B: `alternate_rests` (l. 421), right from step 3; `pair_whole_predicts` (l. 453), from step 2.
places.closed_region: N: `Courses P reg` (l. 216) is a class of courses. That a list holds a run is a premise. No closed-region law was found.
places.forms_change: S: `answer_open` (l. 300): the run of the diagonal law from the empty prefix keeps the whole prefix and is held by no list. `merged_unrested` (l. 321): elimination over every merging never rests along it. B: `negation_never_rests` (l. 415): along every run of negation each configuration differs from the one before (an alternation), while elimination predicts it from step 3 (`alternate_rests`, l. 421).

places.place: LeastLoss.lean: Halving.never_rests, Layered.never_rests, Halving.approaches_without_reaching, Halving.takes_halve, Branching.Lossless.loses_nothing, Branching.loss_needs_merge, Branching.rests_along_run, Law.Lossless.regains, Law.Lossless.narrowing_spreads, Law.Lossless.reset_unlisted, Reset.kept_by_rest
places.states: S: Built counterexamples showing that each premise the whole numbers supply to the rest laws is needed. In dyadic amounts (dense, Archimedean, no least loss) the halving stock falls at every step and never rests (`Halving.never_rests`, l. 256; `Halving.worlds_need_not_rest`, l. 699). In layered amounts (a least loss, not Archimedean) the stock also never rests (`Layered.never_rests`, l. 415; `Layered.worlds_need_not_rest`, l. 709). General laws for every process: along a run held by a list, a process that merges nothing loses nothing (`Branching.Lossless.loses_nothing`, l. 501), a positive loss needs a merge (`Branching.loss_needs_merge`, l. 522), and strict falls of an amount that does not rise do not recur (`Branching.rests_along_run`, l. 532). Further general laws: a lossless law keeps possibilities apart, with Landauer's count (`Law.Lossless.narrowing_spreads`, l. 628), and a part reset at every step needs an unbounded whole (`Law.Lossless.reset_unlisted`, l. 641).
places.moves: S: the Branching laws are stated for every `Process S Act` and every `Run P`. `Branching.Lossless.loses_nothing` (l. 501): for every run held by a list of a process that merges nothing, every step's loss is within nothing. `Branching.rests_along_run` (l. 532): for every run held by a list, with the amount not rising from T, strict falls do not recur, whether or not the process merges.
places.reading: S: amounts are read off configurations (q : S → A), and a finite reading decides rest (`Branching.rests_along_run`, l. 532). `Halving.stock_unlisted` (l. 483): falls that recur need values no list holds. `Law.distinct_within` (l. 596) and `Law.Lossless.narrowing_spreads` (l. 628): read by a part and a rest that together tell configurations apart, k possibilities no two alike number at most ps.length*es.length n steps on, under a law that merges nothing. `Law.Lossless.reset_unlisted` (l. 641).
places.level: S: a general amount q with step losses d along a run (`Branching.Lossless.loses_nothing`, l. 501). `Law.Lossless.regains` (l. 547): under a lossless law over finitely many configurations, an amount that does not rise along an orbit is regained, so nothing lost stays lost. B: `Halving.stock` (l. 227) with `Halving.loss` (l. 230), the loss of each step half the stock, so what is lost depends on what is left. `Layered.stock` (l. 381). `Halving.approaches_without_reaching` (l. 271): steps losing at least ε do not recur, yet the stock falls at every step.
places.giving: N: what gives is not a going-on of a model. B: `Halving.takes_halve` (l. 314): a supplied replenishment of one whole at every step balances 2^(t+1) takers. The replenishment is a constant handed in.
places.multiplying: B: `Halving.takes_halve` (l. 314): the number of takers at the step from t is 2^(t+1), more without end. They are a count of takes, not units that leave units.
places.no_return: S: irreversibility is located in merging, and concluded. `Branching.loss_needs_merge` (l. 522) and `Law.loss_needs_merge` (l. 577): a loss above nothing along a run held by a list means the process is not `Lossless`. `Law.Lossless.regains` (l. 547): without merging, what is lost is regained. `Law.Lossless.reset_unlisted` (l. 641): a part reset at every step inside a lossless whole needs a whole no list holds. These are at the level of an amount or a part, not the loss of something that gives. B: `Reset.kept_by_rest` (l. 682).
places.both_outcomes: D: the docstring of `Branching.rests_along_run` (l. 527) reads a dichotomy: a run within finitely many configurations either loses nothing (where the process merges nothing) or comes to rest. The two parts are separate statements (`Branching.Lossless.loses_nothing`, l. 501; `rests_along_run`, l. 532). No single statement states both. B: `Halving.never_rests` (l. 256) and `Layered.never_rests` (l. 415) give the never-rest outcome only.
places.comparison: S: `Law.Lossless.keeps_apart` (l. 614): under a law that merges nothing, starts no two alike stay no two alike any number of steps on. `Law.Lossless.loses_nothing` (l. 565) and `Law.loss_needs_merge` (l. 577) are stated as instances of the Branching laws along a law's run. N: no simulation between two processes.
places.rank: S: `Branching.rests_along_run` (l. 532): along a run held by a list, with the amount not rising from T, steps of strict fall do not recur (stated as the negation of 'for every N some later step falls strictly'). B: `Halving.never_rests` (l. 256) and `Layered.never_rests` (l. 415): falls at every step, never rests. `Halving.approaches_without_reaching` (l. 271): for every ε there is m such that no m steps each lose at least ε. `Halving.endless` (l. 443) and `Layered.endless` (l. 462).
places.closed_region: N: no invariant region or kernel law was found. The nearest are `Law.Lossless.regains` (l. 547), where the orbit returns to its start, and `Law.Lossless.keeps_apart` (l. 614).
places.forms_change: S/B: `Law.Lossless.reset_unlisted` (l. 641): where a lossless law resets a part to one configuration at every step and some configuration has another part, no list holds the configurations; the whole goes on and its rest grows. B: `Reset.kept_by_rest` (l. 682): the part merges at every step while the history kept in the rest grows by one each step (`Reset.rest_length`, l. 675) and never repeats.

places.place: LevelCoupling.lean: ExchangeLaw.RespondsTo.couples, ExchangeLaw.Through.couples_of_respondsTo, ExchangeLaw.Through.not_respondsByLevel, not_not_obs_iff_respondsByLevel, crossing_passes_iff, ExchangeLaw.Through.rises_at_step, carried_iff_rising, supply_not_carried, Complement.carry, supply_carried_by_complement
places.states: S: General laws of what an exchange law reading only through a web's couplings (`ExchangeLaw.Through W obs part`) can respond to. A response is a positive strength for every strength array of the law (`ExchangeLaw.RespondsTo.couples`, l. 159). Only what couples in can respond (`ExchangeLaw.Through.couples_of_respondsTo`, l. 200). By threshold only a crossing of the need passes (`ExchangeLaw.Through.not_respondsByLevel`, l. 252; `crossing_passes_iff`, l. 601). Coupling by level is exactly where a response by level is possible (`not_not_obs_iff_respondsByLevel`, l. 314). Dependence alone carries of a level exactly what rises with it (`carried_iff_rising`, l. 904), so it carries no supply of a deficit (`supply_not_carried`, l. 1046), unless the level stands with a complement at a fixed total (`Complement.carry`, l. 1005). The built laws `levelLaw`, `thresholdLaw`, `admissionLaw`, `Layers` and `Complement` are the witnesses inside these iffs.
places.moves: N: no `Process S A` with moves. The laws quantify over exchange laws and histories ('some law reading through its couplings', e.g. `crossing_passes_iff`, l. 601), not over choices of steps.
places.reading: S: what is registered (coupled in by threshold `W.DependsOn` or by level `obs`) decides what can respond. `ExchangeLaw.Through.respondsWithin_uncoupled` (l. 185): a level that couples in neither way is coupled with strength zero. `ExchangeLaw.Through.reads_of_respondsTo` (l. 207): a response is read in every schedule covering what couples in. `ExchangeLaw.Through.not_respondsByLevel` (l. 252): where `¬ obs h d`, no response by level. `ExchangeLaw.Through.crosses_of_unobserved` (l. 359): a response to an unobserved level is a crossing of its need. `not_not_obs_iff_respondsByLevel` (l. 314). `carried_iff_rising` (l. 904).
places.level: S: levels (histories l : Nat → C → Nat) against needs (`W.need`) and admission (`W.Admits`). A response that depends on what is left: `supplyLaw` (l. 1028) gives what the level of d lacks of k. `supply_not_carried` (l. 1046): under dependence alone, no family each exchanging only where supported carries it over levels up to a positive bound. It passes by level (`supplyLaw_through`, l. 1033) and is carried with a complement at a fixed total (`supply_carried_by_complement`, l. 1060). N: no level runs down under a dynamic in this module; histories are handed in.
places.giving: S: what gives a response is a family of formations each exchanging only where supported (`ExchangeLaw.NeedsSupportAt`, l. 656; `ExchangeLaw.CarriesGiving`, l. 691). Not admitted by the levels at the step, such a unit takes and gives nothing. Built: `Layers.carry` (l. 855), units at thresholds, unit j+1 giving the rise at need j+1; `Complement.carry` (l. 1005). N: no law of these units being lost over time.
places.cost: N: the carrying units take nothing (`Layers.law`, l. 779; `Complement.law`, l. 954). No cost to the giver.
places.no_return: N
places.both_outcomes: N for going on and ending. The exactly-whens are of responding and carrying: `crossing_passes_iff` (l. 601), `crossing_passes_of_support` (l. 632), `carried_iff_rising` (l. 904), `not_not_obs_iff_respondsByLevel` (l. 314, double-negated).
places.comparison: S: an order between two histories is carried. `ExchangeLaw.Through.rises_at_step` (l. 667): under a law reading through dependence alone, a supported formation takes and gives no less where the levels at the step stand no lower (`NoLowerAt`, l. 660), the history before alike. `ExchangeLaw.Through.carried_rises` (l. 698): a carried response is no lower. `ExchangeLaw.Through.carried_fall_needs_fall` (l. 714): it falls only where some level at the step falls. `RespondsTo` (l. 110) compares two histories differing only in one level.

places.closed_region: N
places.forms_change: N

places.place: Lexical.lean: Above, BasicPriority, Above.anchor, Above.no_trade, BasicPriority.same_claims_alike, adjoin, classified, classified_robust_iff_of_decided, classified_robust_iff_iff_em, Above.adjoin_basic_reverses
places.states: S: The module defines a lexical order of two tiers of claims (`Above basic gain a b`, l. 130: a strictly includes b's basic claims, or holds exactly b's basic claims and strictly includes b's gains), proves it irreflexive and transitive, and proves that a retained basic claim anchors it (`Above.anchor`, l. 151) and that no gains trade for a lost basic claim (`Above.no_trade`, l. 157). It takes `BasicPriority` (l. 196) as a hypothesis carrying these to any comparison `better`, and proves general laws of adjoined fresh contents and of comparison under every classification of them (`classified_robust_iff_of_decided`, l. 510; `classified_robust_iff_iff_em`, l. 546), with built witnesses `Repair`, `Crossed`, `Ceiling`, `Reorganizing`.
places.moves: N: There is no process, step, policy or allowed set in this module. The alternatives are elements of a bare type `H`. The account says the frame laws (`Lexical.Frame.Above`, `tierFrame`) live in `Becoming.FrontierFrames`, which was not read.
places.reading: S: `Above.congr_left` (l. 349) and `Above.congr_right` (l. 356): `Above` reads the claims alone. Two alternatives realizing the same claims in both tiers stand the same way. `BasicPriority.same_claims_alike` (l. 367): under `BasicPriority`, two alternatives with the same basic claims and gains are not better than each other, and each is better or worse than any third exactly where the other is. Its docstring adds that a loss imposed by another and the same loss self-borne are not ordered unless the agent is among the claims. `Above.agent_adjoined` (l. 384): adjoining such a claim orders them. S: `classified_robust_iff_iff_em` (l. 546): the criterion of being above under every classification holds over every type exactly under excluded middle. B: `Reorganizing.classification_matters` (l. 634): how one new content is classified (gain or basic) decides whether the alternatives are incomparable or ordered.
places.share: N: No count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set again from one.
places.level: N: No stock that runs down. The nearest is B: `Ceiling.within` (l. 613), a supplied numerical bound `h.1 ≤ limit` read as a basic claim, and `Ceiling.above` (l. 620), which says staying within it is above any gain beyond it. Nothing in it runs down or returns.
places.giving: N: Claims are predicates handed in (`basic : H → C → Prop`, `gain : H → G → Prop`). Nothing gives to a level, and no unit can be lost.
places.cost: N: No cost to the one who acts. D: the docstring of `BasicPriority.same_claims_alike` (l. 362) speaks of a loss self-borne versus one imposed by another's part, but the statement only compares claims. B: `Repair.loss_retained` (l. 591) says celebration realizes an event that repair does not, so a loss is recorded, not a cost to an actor.
places.multiplying: N: No units leaving units and no kinds forming kinds.
places.no_return: N: No irreversibility in time. `Above.no_trade` (l. 157) is a law of the order: an alternative that lacks a basic claim b holds is not above b, whatever its gains. It says nothing about regaining anything along a course.
places.both_outcomes: N: There is no dichotomy of going on and ending, or of keeping and losing along a course. The iff statements (`classified_robust_iff_of_decided` l. 510, `classified_extremes_iff_of_decided` l. 522, `Above.adjoin_gain_iff` l. 314) concern only the comparison.
places.comparison: S: `Above` itself compares two alternatives. `Above.trans` (l. 141) and `BasicPriority.trans` (l. 210) carry the order along a chain. `BasicPriority.iff` (l. 198) carries every statement about `Above` to `better`. `Above.adjoin_fresh_gain` (l. 304): with the same basic claims and gains neither alternative is above the other, but with fresh gains of which a holds strictly more, a is above. `Above.adjoin_basic_reverses` (l. 323): adjoining fresh basic contents can reverse an order. These compare alternatives, not processes.
places.rank: N: No rank, variant, drain or bound on ending.
places.closed_region: N: No invariant, kernel, fixed point or region closed under steps, since there are no steps.
places.forms_change: N: No going on and no course. The nearest is S, of a widened description only: `included_adjoin_iff` (l. 268) and `strictIncluded_adjoin_iff` (l. 278) describe how the order behaves when a description is widened by fresh contents (`adjoin`, l. 262), and `Above.adjoin_fresh_gain` and `Above.adjoin_basic_reverses` show the widening can create or reverse an order.

places.place: Lifting.lean: LiftExtension, comparison_lifts, LiftCoherence, LiftSurvives, lift_coherent_selection_survives, lift_continual_improvement_has_no_survivor, LiftModel.some_outcome_does_not_lift, LiftModel.lift_needs_live_middle
places.states: S: For any `Frame S A C` and a comparison meeting C (`Comparison F living Better`, from `Becoming.Extension`): where every outcome of response b generatively extends every outcome of a (`LiftExtension`, l. 38), b is liftedly better under the conservative rule (`comparison_lifts`, l. 43). Under `LiftCoherence` a selected response survives (`lift_coherent_selection_survives`, l. 71), and where every live response is liftedly extended by a live one none survives (`lift_continual_improvement_has_no_survivor`, l. 79). The laws are general. `LiftModel` (l. 85) is one built model showing the rule is substantive.
places.moves: S: The responses are moves `A` of `F.P`, live where `Enabled F.P s a`. `LiftCoherence` (l. 66): a selection whose selected responses are live and liftedly dominated by no live response. `lift_coherent_selection_survives` (l. 71): given `Comparison F living Better` and `LiftCoherence`, every selected response is `LiftSurvives` (live, and liftedly extended by no live response). `lift_continual_improvement_has_no_survivor` (l. 79): if every live response has a live response that liftedly extends it, no response is `LiftSurvives`. `lifted_comparison_supplies_reason` (l. 54): under `LiftedArticulation`, a lifted extension between live responses gives `Reason a b`.
places.reading: S (through names defined elsewhere): `LiftExtension` (l. 38) is built from `Extension F living t t'` (Extension.lean l. 45, opened to understand it), which reads what each configuration realizes (`F.realized`). t' realizes all that t does and some living content that t does not. `comparison_lifts` (l. 43): where these realized contents extend for every pair of outcomes, the comparison lifts. What a configuration realizes therefore decides the lifted comparison. No law in this module concerns a coarser observation.
places.share: N: No share and no rule set again from a share.
places.level: N: No stock or level that runs down.
places.giving: N: Nothing gives to a level. `living` and `Better` are handed in.
places.cost: N: No cost to the one who keeps or gives.
places.multiplying: N: No units or kinds whose number changes.
places.no_return: N: No point of no return. `lift_continual_improvement_has_no_survivor` (l. 79) says no selection survives under continual lifted improvement. That is a statement about selection, not irreversibility. B: `LiftModel.options` (l. 92), where `dead` has no outcome, is a response with no step, not a loss.
places.both_outcomes: N: There is no dichotomy of going on and ending, or keeping and losing. The two N-with-L theorems (l. 71, l. 79) give a survivor under coherence and no survivor under continual improvement, but they are not stated as one exactly-when.
places.comparison: S: `comparison_lifts` (l. 43) carries C from configurations to responses: `LiftExtension F living s a b` gives `LiftBetter F (fun x y => Better y x) s b a`, so every outcome of b beats every outcome of a. `LiftCoherence` (l. 66) is undominatedness by a live response. B: `LiftModel.some_outcome_does_not_lift` (l. 104): a response with outcomes 0 or 4 and one with outcome 3 are comparable by neither direction of `LiftBetter`, though some outcome beats. `LiftModel.lift_needs_live_middle` (l. 113): through the outcome-less `dead` both lifted comparisons hold vacuously, but `low` is not liftedly better than `high`, so transitivity needs a live middle.
places.rank: N: No rank, variant or bound.
places.closed_region: N: No invariant or closed region.
places.forms_change: N: No going on along a course with changing forms. The nearest is S: `LiftExtension` (l. 38) is a widening between the outcomes of two responses from one configuration: every outcome of b realizes all that any outcome of a realizes, plus living content. It is not stated along a run.

The rest are N over all statements.

places.place: Likeness.lean: carries_law_alike_iff, RespectsClaims, imageUnder, image_determinedAt_iff, Run.not_fixesAlike_other_of_new, Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_untaken, BranchingTest, alike_iff_sameBranchingTests, stops_decreasing, AlikeTo.steady_within_classes, alike_iff_alikeTo_classes, alike_decided_iff_em, alike_of_sameBranchingTests_outcomes_iff, eitherThroughout_iff_llpoForDecided, Unbounded.not_alike, Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level
places.states: S: General laws of likeness (bisimilarity) of frames. A description π carries a law up to likeness exactly where some equivalence respecting the claims makes configurations go alike (`carries_law_alike_iff`, l. 219). Branching tests fix likeness constructively on finite decided frames (`alike_iff_sameBranchingTests`, l. 1103), with depth bounds `N - 1` and `N + N' - 1` (`alike_iff_alikeTo_classes` l. 1289, `alike_iff_alikeTo_across` l. 1319). The decisions cannot be dropped (`alike_decided_iff_em` l. 1484, `alike_of_sameBranchingTests_iff_em` l. 2303), and for frames with only listed outcomes the result holds exactly under `EitherThroughout`, which is LLPO for decided families (`alike_of_sameBranchingTests_outcomes_iff` l. 2586, `eitherThroughout_iff_llpoForDecided` l. 1739). It also proves a dichotomy of difference-making (`Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level`, l. 2626). It has built witnesses `Likeness.Parting`, `EndOfPath`, `OneLoop`, `EitherStep`, `EitherClaim`, `Chains`, `Unbounded`.
places.moves: S: Frames carry `Process S A` with moves. `Run.not_fixesAlike_other_of_new` (l. 342): in a frame determined up to likeness everywhere, a run none of whose configurations is alike to an earlier one fixes up to likeness no outcome of any move b other than the one taken at n, given two configurations that differ in a claim. `Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_untaken` (l. 370): read through π into a process Q determined up to likeness that admits the run's steps, a move not yet taken at a description alike to k has no outcome fixed up to likeness. `Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level` (l. 2626) is about one move `a` from the withheld configuration. B: `Choosing.branching_apart` (l. 607): the test `bothOpen` holds at the start of `late` and fails at the start of `early`, so a test sees when a choice is made.
places.reading: S: `carries_law_alike_iff` (l. 219): some process on descriptions K, determined up to likeness under `claims`, admits every step of P read through π exactly when some equivalence E is `RespectsClaims` (l. 171) and `GoAlikeUnder P π E`. `carries_law_named_iff` (l. 240): where each description is its own claim this is `GoAlike P π`. `image_determinedAt_iff` (l. 262): the image is determined up to likeness exactly where configurations whose descriptions are alike in it go alike. `alike_iff_sameBranchingTests` (l. 1103): on finite decided frames with listed moves and claims, what branching tests register decides likeness. B: `Unbounded.sameBranchingTests` (l. 2548) and `Unbounded.not_alike` (l. 2575): where a move has infinitely many outcomes, `bounded` and `unbounded` pass every branching test and are not alike. S: `Dependence.dichotomy_of_determinedAt` (l. 2642): where claims that agree force the same level of the condition (`registers`), determinacy up to likeness gives the dichotomy.
places.share: N: No count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set again from one.
places.level: S: `Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level` (l. 2626) uses the levels `K.level t c` and needs `K.need` of a `Dependence` (World.lean, opened). The premise is that every step by move a from `withhold f s` reaches the same level, and the dependence holds and is met there (`need ≤ level`). The conclusion is that either f's part makes the difference or the same move still breaks the dependence, where breaking is the level after falling below the need (Joint.lean `Breaks`, opened). No law here says that what comes back depends on what is left.
places.giving: N: In `Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level` the formation `f` and its part are handled through a function handed in (`withhold : F → S → S`). Nothing states that what gives is a going-on of the model that can be lost.
places.cost: N: No cost to the one who keeps or gives.
places.multiplying: N: No units leaving units and no kinds forming kinds.
places.no_return: N: No irreversibility law and no point of no return. `Run.not_fixesAlike_other_of_new` (l. 342) takes never returning to an alike configuration as a premise, and the premise concerns the run's novelty, not loss. B: some built configurations have no move: `Likeness.Parting.Step` (l. 292, `stopped` has no move), `EndOfPath.frame` (l. 1393, the last place steps nowhere), and `Unbounded` (`rest 0` steps nowhere). No statement says these are reached irreversibly.
places.both_outcomes: S: `Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level` (l. 2626), general: under the premises given in `level`, `K.MakesDifference P withhold f s a g c ∨ K.BreaksBy P (withhold f s) a g c`. Either, with f's part withheld, every step keeps the dependence, or the same move still breaks it. This is a dichotomy of keeping and losing a dependence. B: `Likeness.Parting.image_not_determinedAt` (l. 316): from `start` one move leads both to `going` (which can go on) and to `stopped` (which cannot). B: `Chains.Step` (l. 2344): a chain goes on from n exactly where its family holds at n.
places.comparison: S: Likeness (`Alike`, a bisimulation between two frames) is the central relation carried between two frames or two starts. `BisimulationWith.comp` (l. 650) and `AlikeWith.trans` (l. 678) compose it. `AlikeWith.holds_iff` (l. 783) says alike configurations pass the same tests with parts. `factors_imageUnder` (l. 181) says the step of P factors through π into `imageUnder P π E`, a simulation. `imageUnder_bisimulation` (l. 186) says an equivalence respecting claims is a bisimulation of the image. `Alike.functional` (l. 868) says where likeness separates G's configurations, a configuration is alike to at most one of them. `alikeTo_frameBy_iff` (l. 1331): for determined laws, likeness to depth k is agreement of observations for k+1 steps.
places.rank: S: `stops_decreasing` (l. 524): a decreasing family decided at each step stops decreasing on a list at some step no later than the list's length. `AlikeTo.steady_within` (l. 1073): likeness to depth stops refining at a depth no greater than the number of pairs. `AlikeTo.steady_within_classes` (l. 1279): within one frame of N listed configurations with c pairwise claim-distinct ones, it stops at k with k + c ≤ N. `AlikeTo.steady_within_across` (l. 1301) gives k + c ≤ N + N'. B: `EndOfPath.classes_exact` (l. 1447) shows the depth N - 1 is exact. These bound refinement, not the ending of a course.
places.closed_region: S: `AlikeTo.bisimulation` (l. 1095): where likeness to depth N does not refine further, it is a bisimulation, a relation closed under matched steps. `imageUnder_bisimulation` (l. 186) and `imageUnder_determinedAt` (l. 198): an equivalence respecting the claims and going alike makes the image determined up to likeness everywhere. `OutcomesListed.alikeTo_bisimulation` (l. 1936): given `EitherThroughout`, likeness to every depth is a bisimulation on frames with listed outcomes. These are closed relations on pairs, not closed regions of one course.
places.forms_change: N: No statement in which a going on continues while what is present changes, or in which more can go on after. B, the nearest: `Chains` (l. 2331), where chains go on exactly while their families hold and one endless chain always goes on, and `Unbounded` (l. 2499), with chains of every finite length beside an endless one. Neither concerns forms changing.
places.how_read: Every declaration's statement and docstring read (whole module, 2734 lines, read in four parts to the end, including the `ListedOutcomeFrames` section). `Dependence`, `Breaks`, `MakesDifference`, `DeterminedAt` and `GoAlikeUnder` were opened in World.lean, Joint.lean, Labelled.lean and Laws.lean. states, moves, reading, level, both_outcomes, comparison, rank and closed_region answered from statements, with built cases noted. The rest are N over all statements. The account's `makesDifference_iff` and `Choosing.late`/`early` are defined in other modules.

places.place: LimitVerification.lean: Verifies, Refutes, ByRecord, still_verifies, recurs_not_verified, settles_not_refuted, identifies_verifies, jointly_refutes, eventuallyFalse_lpo
places.states: For any Process S A it gives general laws of what a method fixed by the record can verify or refute in the limit: verified readings are unions of closed readings, refuted ones meets of verifiable ones, test readings are both, and meets are kept; with decidable equality of configurations, "the last step changed nothing" verifies settling (still_verifies), and identifying a hypothesis in the limit decides it in the limit. On two built processes (the free two-configuration process and the Bool sequences), settling is neither verifiable nor refutable, and under Markov's principle no method fixed by the record refutes settling or verifies recurrence; two further steps are calibrated as the limited principle of omniscience (LPO).
places.moves: S: `Method` (l. 83) is a guess on runs of any `Process S A`. `Sequences.recurs_not_verified` (l. 580): under `Markov`, for every method `m` with `ByRecord m`, the run `against m`, whose moves are chosen as the negation of the guess (`against_act`, l. 571), defeats `Verifies m Recurs`. `Free.settles_not_refuted` (l. 721) does the same against refuting settling, with the run changing where the method says yes (`against_state`, l. 709). These are laws about one chosen course against every method, not about what every choice keeps.
places.reading: S: `ByRecord` (l. 86): the guess at `k` is the same on runs agreeing up to `k`. `Verifies` (l. 102) and `Refutes` (l. 106) say a reading holds exactly where the guess converges to yes, or its yes recurs. `still_verifies` (l. 479): with `DecidableEq S`, `still` verifies `Enough.Settles`. `identifies_verifies` and `identifies_refutes` (l. 441, l. 449): identification decides each hypothesis `H r = v` in the limit. `recurs_not_verified` (l. 580): what is registered up to each horizon cannot verify recurrence.
places.share: N: no count or fraction of a kind among several, and no rule set from one.
places.level: N: no stock or level that runs down.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility is stated. `Converges` (l. 89) is keeping a guess from some horizon on, and `converges_unique` (l. 109) says a method converges to at most one guess. Neither is a loss.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on and ending, or keeping and losing. The nearest is `still_verifies` (l. 479): a run settles exactly where "the last step changed nothing" converges to yes. That is an exactly-when about settling, general for any process with decidable equality of configurations.
places.comparison: S, partial: `Tracks.agree` (l. 425): two targets tracked by the same guess agree from some horizon on, on every run. `both_verifies` (l. 266) and `jointly_refutes` (l. 338) combine two methods into one for the meet of their readings. Nothing carries between two processes.
places.rank: N: convergence is only "from some horizon on", with no bound, rank or deadline.
places.closed_region: N for regions closed under steps. `yesFrom_closed` (l. 142) is closedness of a reading in the sense of adherence: a run adhering to "from n on yes" is in it, for a method fixed by the record.
places.forms_change: S, partial and in the sense of readings only: `Tracks` (l. 411) allows a target that changes with the horizon. `Free.unsettled_dense` (l. 674): every finite record of the free process extends to a run that changes at every later step. `recurs_not_verified` (l. 580): that a run changes again and again cannot be verified in the limit. No statement has a going-on continuing while what is present changes, and none has a widening.
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings to the end (l. 744), plus the opening account. moves, reading, comparison and forms_change are from statements. both_outcomes and closed_region note statements nearby. share, level, giving, cost, multiplying, no_return and rank are N.

places.place: LineOnAStock.lean: after, net, ways_alike, alike_iff, need_unmet, falls_to_unmet, line_ends, way_ends, fall, gone_from, unending_iff_holds, takes_nothing, account, HigherStartEnds
places.states: The laws are general over any type of units with need, use and kids, on a level renewed by `RegimeMargin.step giving (taken use w)`. Ways read levels only through the needs met (`after_alike`, `alike_iff`, `ways_alike`). A closed line once gone stays gone (`gone_from`). A way whose kids take more comes to an unmet need within hi + 1 steps, the way unchanged until then (`need_unmet`, `falls_to_unmet`). A growing line ends (`line_ends`, `way_ends`), and an overdrawn line of one need ends (`fall`). In the even case the net never ends exactly where the course reaches a configuration that holds (`unending_iff_holds`). Kept countermodels and worked courses are built on particular kinds (KidsNeedMore, HigherStartEnds, TwoForOne, NothingTakenEnds and others).
places.moves: N: the step `step` (l. 153) and the net `net` (l. 158, `Law.stepWhile`) are deterministic. There is no choice among steps and no law of what every choice keeps.
places.reading: S: `after_alike` (l. 328): where two levels meet the same needs in `w`, the way after a step at each is the same. `left_of_taken` (l. 349): the level after a step depends on the way only through what it takes. `alike_iff` (l. 493): where every unit leaves a kid, two levels are `Alike` (l. 418) exactly where they meet the same needs. `ways_alike` (l. 547): for two givings, two uses and two start levels whose levels meet the same needs of the way step by step, the ways are the same at every step up to n. `born_alike` (l. 587): the same number is born. B: `AlikeFiner.alike_not_met` (l. 1997): alike levels that meet different needs.
places.share: B: `ShareRises.course_values` (l. 1705): C's take goes from 2 of 4 to 2 of 2 while the number of drawers falls. `lineTake` and `lineCount` (l. 178, l. 182) are amounts of a line within the way. No rule or favouring is set again from a share: `kids` is fixed. The account says this ("nothing here ... changes `kids`").
places.level: S: `left` (l. 146) is `RegimeMargin.step giving (taken use w) x`, which is x - taken + giving (x - taken), so what is given back depends on what is left. `account` (l. 1305): while what is taken is within the level, the level at N plus everything taken equals the start plus everything given. `step_zero` (l. 697): with `FromNothing`, a draw at least the level leaves nothing. `step_lowers` (l. 720): below H + y, a step lowers the level or leaves nothing. `taken_below` (l. 1281): on a course that goes on, what is taken is below the level.
places.giving: N: `giving : Nat → Nat` is a function handed in. Its bounds `FromNothing`, `Keeps`, `Short`, `Meets` and `Regime` (l. 193) are premises. The account says these are given and not derived. No unit or formation of the model gives to the level.
places.cost: N: units take `use` from the shared level. Nothing a unit does costs it an offspring or its own standing.
places.multiplying: S: `after` (l. 138) and `mem_after_iff` (l. 317): a unit is in the next way exactly where it is a kid of a unit of the way whose need the level meets. `rise` (l. 635): where every unit of S is met and its kids of S take more than it, what S takes rises by at least the number of units of S. `generation` (l. 173), `born_eq_length` (l. 577). Kinds leave other kinds by the fixed `kids`, but no new kind is made. B: `Doubling.course_values` (l. 1736): 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 units.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `never_in` (l. 664) and `gone_from` (l. 674): under the premise `closed` (no unit outside the line leaves a unit of it), and under any giving and use, a line with no unit at step k has none at any later step. `gone_after` (l. 685): where no unit of the line is met at k, none is present after k. The loss is of a line of units that take from the level; no giver is lost. The net's ending is `Law.stepWhile` having no next (`way_ends`, l. 928).
places.both_outcomes: S, general: `unending_iff_holds` (l. 1239). With `even`, `some`, `down`, `needs`, `nothing`, `high` and `along` (Regime at each reached way), the net from (w, x) never ends exactly where, some need met at every step before, the course reaches a configuration that `Holds` (l. 188). B: `HigherStartEnds.higher_ends` (l. 1840): from ([A], 6) the net never ends; from ([A], 7) it ends, with the ways equal at steps 0 to 2. `NothingTakenEnds.ending_differs` (l. 2109). The account says there is no exact condition when kids take more or less.
places.comparison: S: `ways_alike` (l. 547) and `born_alike` (l. 587) carry the way and the number born between two courses with different givings, uses and starts. `takes_nothing` (l. 1453) and `strip_course` (l. 1431): with units of Z taking nothing and leaving only Z, the courses from (strip Z w, x) and (w, x) have equal levels at every step and equal ways once Z is stripped; whether the net ends is not carried (`NothingTakenEnds`). `after_length_le` (l. 453): a higher level leaves a way no shorter at one step. `course_asItWas` (l. 951): while every need is met, the course is the orbit of `TurningInTime.asItWas (allKids kids)`.
places.rank: S: `need_unmet` (l. 1011): with `FromNothing`, `Keeps giving 0 hi`, `grows` for every unit, `Needing`, x ≤ hi, a non-empty way and every need met at the start, some need is unmet at a step n with 0 < n ≤ hi + 1, and the way up to n is `generation kids j w`. `falls_to_unmet` (l. 1057) adds `down`: the level at n is below a need the start met, and below x. `one_need_ends` (l. 1094): with one need, the net ends within hi + 1 steps. `line_ends` (l. 904), `way_ends` (l. 928) and `fall` (l. 773) end with no bound stated; `ends_high` (l. 847) and `ends_all` (l. 886) use strong induction on a need bound with fuel.
places.closed_region: S: `course_fixed` (l. 1345): a configuration the step leaves as it is stays so. `unending_of_fixed` (l. 1352): a course that reaches such a configuration, with some need met there and before, never ends. `Holds` (l. 188) is the certificate in `unending_iff_holds`. `never_in` (l. 664): under `closed`, units not of the line form a region closed under the step. B: `KidsNeedMore.fixed` (l. 1496), `HigherStartEnds.from_six` (l. 1810), `TakesNothing.lost` (l. 2041).
places.forms_change: B: `HigherStartEnds.from_six` (l. 1810): the way goes A, then B B, then C B C B, which is fixed, and the net never ends. `TwoForOne.holds_by_law` (l. 1645): P gives way to Q Q at every step from 1, and the net never ends, by `unending_iff_holds`. `TakesNothing.lost` (l. 2041): C and B are lost while A goes on. `ShareRises.goes_on` (l. 1713): O is lost and C goes on. S, general: `unending_iff_holds` admits kids that are not the unit, but its premise `even` keeps what is taken the same. No widening.
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings to the end (l. 2143), in four parts, plus the opening account. reading, level, multiplying, no_return, both_outcomes, comparison, rank and closed_region are from statements. share and forms_change are from built cases. moves, giving and cost are N.

places.place: LineOnAStockCases.lean: MultiplyingTakersCase.agree, multiplying_takers, DrainCase.drain, gift_eq, need_agrees, late
places.states: This module is built only. It equates two examples from other modules (`LineageRegimes.MultiplyingTakers`, and the gated `LineageDrawdown.Drain`) step by step with courses of LineOnAStock's model: family sizes with way lengths, pools with levels, draws with what is taken, and activity with some need met. It shows that the premises of `way_ends` and `fall` hold on those courses. Its docstrings say that the read-back conclusions add nothing the examples' own Lean did not give.
places.moves: N.
places.reading: B: `MultiplyingTakersCase.agree` (l. 61): at every step the example's family length, its pool `web.level t 0` and "some member active" equal this course's way length, level and `Goes`. `DrainCase.need_agrees` (l. 165): for every pool p, 4 ≤ p + gift p exactly where 1 ≤ p, reading Drain's need of one as a need of four here. The docstring says the organisms' identities are not equated.
places.level: B: `DrainCase.gift` (l. 137) gives three from one up and nothing at nothing, so what comes back depends on what is left. `drain` (l. 196): the Drain pool with the gift on it equals the level here at every step. `MultiplyingTakersCase.late` (l. 43): nothing given, course `([], 0)` from step 3.
places.giving: B: `DrainCase.gift_eq` (l. 154): the gated renewer's giving in `LineageDrawdown.Drain` equals `gift` of the pool at every phase. Here `gift` is a function handed in; in Drain the renewer is a formation.
places.multiplying: B: `MultiplyingTakersCase.agree` (l. 61): families of 1, 2 and 4 members match the `Doubling` way. `DrainCase.kids` (l. 131): d0 leaves d1, d1; d1 leaves d1; r leaves nothing.
places.no_return: B, concluded through `fall` and `never_in`: `drain` (l. 196), last conjunct: from some step on, the Drain family is empty. `DrainCase.late` (l. 148): the course is `([], 0)` from step 10. The docstring says the size equality from step 10 is itself proved from `LineageDrawdown.Drain.familyP_eq`.
places.both_outcomes: N.
places.comparison: B: `agree` (l. 61), `multiplying_takers` (l. 92) and `drain` (l. 196) carry sizes, levels, draws and activity between a built example of another model and a course of this one, by computation step by step. `multiplying_takers` also carries `way_ends`' conclusion back as a step at which no member of the family is active.
places.rank: B: `way_ends` and `fall` are applied, with no bound on the step. `late` gives fixed steps: 3 (l. 43) and 10 (l. 148).
places.closed_region: B: `late` (l. 43, l. 148): `([], 0)` is reached and kept at every later step.
places.forms_change: B, weak: in `DrainCase` the kinds present change from r and d0 at the start to d1 alone from step 1 (`fall` is applied at `([d1, d1], 11)`), and then the way ends. There is no going on and no widening.
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings (l. 1 to l. 274), plus the opening account. Every answer is from built statements; moves, share, cost and both_outcomes are N.

places.place: LineageDrawdown.lean: below_iff, degeneration_of_unmet, next_empty_of_unmet, ends_of_unmet, ends_of_drawdown, no_term_of_drawdown, Drain.gated_ends, Drain.outside_ends, Drain.renewer_goes_on_outside
places.states: For any `Flow` and `Web` it gives general restatements of landed laws: the ledger `below_iff` (under balance, the stock at T + n is below m exactly where stock plus replenishment is below m plus uptake); a line ends on every branch at the kind grain where its reach at N requires a member of a family whose stock is below the need (`degeneration_of_unmet`); and on the census, generations of descent are empty and the selection term is zero after such a step (`ends_of_unmet`, `ends_of_drawdown`). One built witness, `Drain`, has a pool, a renewer with or without a gate, and organisms. In both cases the line degenerates; without the gate the renewer's own line goes on.
places.moves: S: `degeneration_of_unmet` (l. 94) concludes `«退化»` (ends on every branch) for the relation `lineStep L W Q` at grain `W.kindClass Q`, from `W.Dependent`, a stock below m at N, an active start not after N, and every reached y at N requiring a member of `ds` at need ≥ m. This is a law about every continuation, on a relation, not a `Process S A`.
places.reading: S: the verdicts are stated at the grain `W.kindClass Q`, for any Q (`degeneration_of_unmet`, l. 94; `degeneration_of_drawdown`, l. 124). `degeneration_of_unmet_listed` (l. 109) adds `ContinuationsListed` (the census holds every continuation). No law makes what is registered at a grain decide something beyond the verdict at that grain.
places.share: B: `Drain.share_P` (l. 570): the drawers' share goes from one of two to all. `selection_P` (l. 527): concordance two at step 0. S: `ends_of_unmet` (l. 160): the selection terms `concordAt` and `discordAt` are zero from N on. No rule is set again from a share; offspring numbers are supplied (opening account).
places.level: S: `below_iff` (l. 74): under `L.Balances W`, `W.stock ds (T + n) < m` iff stock at T plus total replenishment < m plus total uptake. Replenishment is the flow's own and in general need not depend on what is left. B: `Drain.activeOf` (l. 239): the gated renewer is active only where 1 ≤ pool. `phaseP` (l. 304): from step 10 the pool stays at nothing with the gate, and is restored without it.
places.giving: S, as premise: `next_empty_of_unmet` (l. 146) takes `L.Acting W` (only active formations give) and `W.Dependent` (activity needs support). So giving is by formations of the model, under premises. B: `Drain` relatum 1 is the renewer, a formation. `gated` (l. 366): with the gate, whatever gives to the pool requires it at need one, so its giving is lost when the pool is at nothing. `from_outside` (l. 380) and `not_gated` (l. 386): without the gate it gives three each step and requires nothing.
places.cost: B: `Drain.takeOf` (l. 244): an organism takes its own standing (`levelOf`) at its step and draws from the pool while active. `giveOf` (l. 250): it gives one unit to each offspring. `kidsP` (l. 306) and `share_P` (l. 570): the restrained member (draw one) leaves none and the drawer (draw two) leaves two. These numbers are supplied, not derived; the opening account says so. No general law.
places.multiplying: S: `next_empty_of_unmet` (l. 146): in `SelectionTerm.Generations` of descent (`Flow.Descended`), under `Acting`, `Dependent`, a stock below m at N and every member of generation N requiring such a member, `G.size (N + 1) = 0`. The kids themselves are given by G, not by a law of the step. B: `Drain.kidsP` (l. 306): drawer 4 leaves 5 and 6, then each leaves one. `sizes_P` (l. 546): size two through step nine.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `ends_of_unmet` (l. 160): every generation after N is empty and the selection term is zero from N on, from `acting`, `dependent`, `descended`, `below` and `members`. The loss follows the stock of a depended-on family falling below the need. `degeneration_of_unmet` (l. 94): ends on every branch. D: the opening account says the gate makes the end last, and that without it a formation can be active again (`Restored.returns`, `Flow.family_excess_ends`, not stated here). B: with the gate, the giver (the renewer) stays inactive at a pool of nothing (`phaseP`, l. 304).
places.both_outcomes: S: `below_iff` (l. 74) is an exactly-when for the stock being below the need, general under balance. B: without the gate, the organisms' line degenerates (`Drain.outside_ends`, l. 624) while the renewer's line goes on (`Drain.renewer_goes_on_outside`, l. 433). These are two lines of one model, not a dichotomy for one line.
places.comparison: B: `Drain.gated_ends` (l. 613) and `Drain.outside_ends` (l. 624): the same course with and without the gate, and the same end. The docstring says the gate is not among the law's premises. No general law carries between two processes.
places.rank: S: `ends_of_drawdown` (l. 177): where the draws outrun stock plus replenishment over the n steps from T, generations after T + n are empty. This gives a deadline T + n from the ledger. `no_term_of_drawdown` (l. 190). D: `Flow.below_of_excess` (n steps of excess from a stock below n + m) is named in the account, not stated here. B: `excess_P` (l. 577) has eight steps of excess; `draws_past_P` (l. 603).
places.closed_region: S: `ends_of_unmet` (l. 160): the empty generation is kept from N + 1 on. B: `Drain.renewer_goes_on_outside` (l. 433): `«延»`, witnessed by the family z.2 = 1, each member continued by a member.
places.forms_change: B: `Drain.familyP` (l. 314) and `kidsP` (l. 306): 5 and 6, then 7 and 8, relay in turn with the family's size two through step nine, and then the family ends. Without the gate the renewer goes on (l. 433). No widening.

places.place: LineageRegimes.lean: degeneration_of_family_excess, degeneration_at_stock_horizon, dissipation_degenerates_every_member, draw_doubling_needs, multiplying_takers_need, multiplying_takers_stop, Handover.both_fates, stock_forces_neither, GatedPairCourse, FromOutside.from_outside
places.states: S: General laws on any balanced flow and web. A family's excess of uptake over replenishment is bounded by its stock (`family_excess_within_stock` l.147, `family_excess_not_past_stock` l.153). Read on a lineage, n steps of excess from a stock below n+m end the line where everything it reaches at T+n requires a member at need of at least m (`degeneration_of_family_excess` l.173). Dissipation degenerates every member (l.237). A draw at least doubling needs 2^n ≤ level+1 (`draw_doubling_needs` l.284), and so do multiplying takers (`multiplying_takers_need` l.331, `multiplying_takers_stop` l.345). B: Built handovers give both fates from the same stock at every s ≥ 1 (`Handover.both_fates` l.1047), so no region follows from the stock over `GatedPairCourse` (`stock_forces_neither` l.1086). `FromOutside` is a built case where no regime binds.
places.moves: N: No Process S A, policy, plan or allowed set. Flows are given triples (present, take, give). `stock_forces_neither` (l.1086) quantifies over all courses (L, W, G) meeting `GatedPairCourse` (l.1074). That is a class of courses, not a choice within one.
places.reading: S: The regions are stated at grains. `«退化»` is stated at `W.kindClass Q`; `«生成»` is stated at (kindClass, carrierClass) (e.g. `relay_generates` l.871). `stock_forces_neither` (l.1086): for every s ≥ 1, not every `GatedPairCourse` with start stock s degenerates, and not every one generates. So the stock at the start decides neither region. No rule made from what is registered appears.
places.share: N: Generation sizes `G.size` appear, with doubling as a premise (`multiplies`), but no share of one kind among several and no rule set again from one.
places.level: S: `excess_within_level` (l.140): under balance, n steps of joint excess at c need level ≥ n. `degeneration_of_family_excess` (l.173): under `W.Dependent` (activity needs support), excess from stock < n+m leaves stock < m at T+n (via `Flow.below_of_excess`). The line degenerates where all it reaches then requires a member of ds at need ≥ m. `draw_doubling_needs` (l.284): with c given nothing and the draw at T+j ≥ 2^j, 2^n ≤ level T c + 1. B: in MultiplyingTakers the pool stands 3, 2, then 0 (`multiplying` l.601).
places.giving: S: The general laws take `Flow.Acting` (only active formations give) as a premise in `GatedPairCourse` (l.1074). `degeneration_of_family_excess` holds whatever renews the family, so the renewer need not be losable. B: `Handover.gated` (l.765): whatever gives to the pair depends on a member at need one, itself; each relatum is active exactly while it stands (`Handover.web` l.689). `FromOutside.not_gated` (l.1137): the renewer gives without requiring the condition, at every need.
places.cost: B: `Handover.flow` (l.683): the holder takes its whole amount from itself and gives the next step's amount to the other (`taken_eq` l.782). In the run-down it gives one unit less each step, and `runDown_dissipates` (l.936) holds. D: the account's modelling choices say giving is not drawn from the giver's own level unless it takes. So no general law makes giving cost the giver.
places.multiplying: S: `sizes_double` (l.309) and `multiplying_takers_need` (l.331): generations from at least one, each at least doubling the one before (a premise, not a law of the step), each drawing a unit per member from a condition given nothing, need 2^n ≤ level+1. `size_le_taken` (l.320): a generation without repeats draws at least its size. B: `MultiplyingTakers.multiplying` (l.601) has sizes 1, 2, 4, then 0.
places.no_return: S: Concluded, not a premise. `degeneration_of_family_excess` (l.173) and `degeneration_at_stock_horizon` (l.213) conclude `«退化»` (the line ends on every branch) at a low level: the stock is below need at T+n, with a premise on the line's reach. `dissipation_degenerates_every_member` (l.237) concludes it for every member; after stock+1 generations there are none. `multiplying_takers_stop` (l.345) concludes that not every member of the first n generations stays active. In the general laws the loss is not of what gives. B: in the run-down the giver itself runs down (`runDown_degenerates` l.995).
places.both_outcomes: B: `Handover.both_fates` (l.1047): for every s ≥ 1, two built handovers start from the same stock s. The relay keeps stock s, has no excess and no dissipation, and generates (`«生成»`). The run-down is in excess for s steps, dissipated on, and degenerates. `stock_forces_neither` (l.1086) restates this, using `«生成退化不并»`. N: no exactly-when for one model was found.
places.comparison: B: `Handover.relay_one_flow` (l.822): at stock one the relay's take, give and level equal `Reproduction.Relay`'s; the webs differ. S: `doubling_needs_of_draw` (l.293) makes `Flow.Balances.doubling_needs` a case of `draw_doubling_needs`. N: no simulation, order kept by the step, or carrying law between two processes.
places.rank: S: `family_excess_within_stock` (l.147) and `family_excess_not_past_stock` (l.153): at most stock-many steps of excess. `degeneration_at_stock_horizon` (l.213): at need one the horizon is the stock. `multiplying_takers_need` (l.331): at most log2(level+1) generations. `dissipation_degenerates_every_member` (l.237): no members after stock+1 generations.
places.closed_region: S: The census closed under continuation (`ContinuationsListed`, from LineageRegions) is a premise in `degeneration_of_family_excess_listed` (l.194) and `dissipation_degenerates_every_member` (l.237). B: `Handover.runDown_listed` (l.963) meets it. `FromOutside.from_outside` (l.1145) is a standing region: the level stays at two and every member is active and supported at every step.
places.forms_change: B: `Handover.relay_generates` (l.871): in the relay the two relata alternate holding the amount, and the lineage of one member per generation generates at (kind, carrier) at every stock s ≥ 1. N: no widening.
