places.states: S: General laws for any `Flow X X` with listed generations. A descent within the kind into an embodied offspring is a carrying renewal (`descended_carries` l.339). Where every member reproduces the lineage generates (`generation_of_reproducing` l.405). Under the census, an empty later generation degenerates a member (`degeneration_of_empty` l.496, `degeneration_of_dissipation` l.557). A whole generation degenerates exactly when a later generation is empty (`generation_degenerates_iff` l.673). B: built witnesses (RelayRead, StandingRelay, Chain, OneBirth, Lasting, Courses) show which premises cannot be dropped, and give same terms with two fates (`Courses.same_terms_two_fates` l.1626).
places.moves: N: No Process S A, policy or allowed set. The kinds Q are supplied, and `Courses` takes a reproduction schedule `on : Nat → Bool` as a parameter of built courses, not a choice within one process.
places.reading: S: `carries_iff` (l.230) reads a carrying renewal with activity read on any web V. `supported_carries_iff` (l.351) is the grain `W.admitting W.level`. `active_along_kind` (l.507): what the line reaches under the kind class is active. B: `StandingRelay.grain_decides_region` (l.854): the same course generates at the grain of activity, and keeps (`«守»`) without generating at the grain of support (its docstring calls that grain vacuous). `Courses.same_terms_two_fates` (l.1626): the same families and selection terms through H, yet one course generates and one degenerates, so the terms through a horizon do not decide the region. `Courses.positive_and_degenerate_at_own_kind` (l.1602) is a kind grain at which the law fails.
places.share: N: No share or fraction with a rule set again from it. S, for the counts that do appear: concordance and discordance terms `G.concordAt` and `G.discordAt` appear in `generation_of_positive_term` (l.461), `not_all_degenerate_while` (l.746) and `not_all_degenerate_of_positive` (l.762). A positive term while generations last leaves not every member of generation t degenerating, under `KidsContinue`.
places.level: S: `degeneration_of_dissipation` (l.557): in `Descended` generations whose offspring lie in a family ds balanced and dissipated on at each step up to its start stock, with the census holding every continuation, every member of a generation up to stock+1 degenerates. Support (`W.Supported`, level ≥ need) is the grain of support, and `Web.Dependent` (activity needs support) is a premise. B: `OneBirth.one_birth` (l.1230) has stock two.
places.giving: S: What gives is a parent formation of the model. `Flow.DescendsAt`: g takes part, gives to f, and f comes to stand. `Flow.Acting` (only active formations give) is a premise of `descent_continues` (l.276), `descended_carries` (l.339) and `kids_continue` (l.578), and parents can themselves degenerate. B: `Courses.DownClosed` (l.1489): reproduction on at a step was on at the step before ("what gives stands").
places.cost: B: `OneBirth` (take/give l.1122-1135): the parent spends its two units, giving one to the offspring, and the offspring spends its one. `OneBirth.dissipates` (l.1189). N: no general law in which giving costs the giver.
places.multiplying: S: Generations by kids lists (`G.family (t+1)` is the flatMap of kids). `family_descendant` (l.616): every member d generations on is a listed descendant. `nonempty_while` (l.731): a selection term positive at every nonempty generation from t keeps every later generation nonempty. `generation_of_exact` (l.441): with exact transmission of offspring number, a member with an offspring generates. B: `Courses.kids` (l.1357) gives two offspring per marked formation; `Chain`.
places.no_return: S: Concluded. `degeneration_of_empty` (l.496): under `ContinuationsListed`, a generation empty at N ≥ the member's step makes the line `«退化»`. `empty_of_degenerates` (l.659): under `KidsContinue`, if every member of generation t degenerates, some later generation is empty. `line_ends` (l.643): from some depth there is no listed descendant. These are losses of the units that give, the generations. `degeneration_of_dissipation` (l.557) is at a low level. B: `Lasting.lasting` (l.1326): without the census the line goes on although the generation after the stock is empty.
places.both_outcomes: S: General. `generation_degenerates_iff` (l.673): under `KidsContinue` and `ContinuationsListed`, every member of generation t degenerates iff some generation N ≥ t is empty. `degenerates_iff_line_ends` (l.691): under `KidsContinue` and `ContinuationsAreKids`, a member degenerates iff at some depth D it has no listed descendant. B: `Chain.chain` (l.1022): in one model member 1 generates and the childless 0 degenerates. `Courses.same_terms_two_fates` (l.1626) is two courses.
places.comparison: S: `carries_iff_via_base` (l.261): for a reflexive kind, a carrying renewal at (kind, carrier) is one at (activity, carrier) with the kind folded in (an equivalence of two readings). `firstSupported_iff_step` (l.325). `active_along_kind` (l.507): the kind class is finer than activity. B: `Courses.same_terms_two_fates` (l.1626) compares two courses with equal families and terms through H. N: no simulation between processes.
places.rank: S: `line_ends` (l.643), by induction on `«尽»` with `common_bound` (l.624): finitely many offspring give a depth D beyond which no listed descendant exists. `degeneration_of_dissipation` (l.557): every member degenerates within stock+1 generations. B: `Courses.upTo_empty` (l.1570): from H+2 on there is no member.
places.closed_region: S: `ContinuationsListed` (l.476) is a census closed under continuation. `reached_listed` (l.486): what the line from a member reaches is listed. `generation_of_carrying` (l.193): a family S each of whose members carries a renewal into S makes every member generate. B: `StandingRelay.grain_decides_region` (l.854) has a `«守»` witnessed by the relay's family; `Lasting.goes_on` (l.1308) is a `«延»` witnessed by a set closed under continuation.
places.forms_change: S: `generation_of_reproducing` (l.405) and `generation_of_reproducing_supported` (l.420): where every member from t on has a listed offspring, each member at t generates (`«生成»`) through births of new formations. B: `Chain.chain` (l.1022): formation t+1 stands only at step t, yet member 1 generates. `Courses.marked_generates` (l.1558). `OneBirth.one_birth` (l.1230): it renews and still ends (`«新而尽»`). N: no widening statement.

It follows that plans with the same, reassociated or reordered draws are realized at the same lists (l.104, l.111, l.117).
places.moves: S: Plans are present (`JointPlan (List R)`, leaves and pairs). `realizes_iff_supports` (l.99) says where a plan is realized, not what a choice keeps. There is no stepwise process.
places.reading: S: `realizes_iff_of_draws` (l.104): plans with equal `draws` are realized at the same lists. Realization reads only what the leaves draw on.

places.giving: N

places.place: ListedWebs.lean: forced_iff_more, forces_iff_noSplit, forcedAlong_iff_more, forcedAlong_of_eventually_noSplit, ceasing_not_recurring, rests_unrefuted_iff
places.states: S: General laws for every web's activity. Under a census at t and t+1, every continuation without a split fails to continue every formation active after the step iff more are active after than before (`forced_iff_more` l.85); this holds over a run at arbitrarily late steps (`forcedAlong_iff_more` l.147). With a covering list and no arising from N on, ceasing does not recur (`ceasing_not_recurring` l.68), and a world's rest is unrefuted by a stated iff (`rests_unrefuted_iff` l.170). D: the account names further laws (`across`, `ceasings_within`, `ceasing_of_outpacing`, `keep_pace`, `persists`, `ceasing_needs_arising`, `ceasing_steps_found`) that are not in this module; their sections are empty headers.
places.moves: N: No Process S A or policy. The quantification is over continuation relations S without a split (`forced_iff_more` l.85, `forces_iff_noSplit` l.102), not over moves.
places.reading: S: A census lists what is active (`alive t`, distinct, ↔ `W.active t f`). `forced_iff_more` (l.85): the comparison of the listed counts, (alive t).length < (alive (t+1)).length, decides whether arising is forced under every no-split continuation. `rests_unrefuted_iff` (l.170) concerns what can be refuted, with no decidedness.
places.level: N
places.giving: N
places.multiplying: N: more formations active after a step forces arising, but no units leave units by a law of the step.
places.no_return: N: no point of no return. S, for what is nearest: `ceasing_not_recurring` (l.68): where a list covers the formations active at N and none arises from N on (a premise), some formation does not cease at arbitrarily late steps.
places.both_outcomes: S: General. `rests_unrefuted_iff` (l.170): that a world rests from some M ≥ T cannot be refuted iff it is not the case that after every step from T a later arising or ceasing stays unrefuted (double-negated). `forcedAlong_iff_more` (l.147) is an iff of forced arising and growth at arbitrarily late steps.
places.comparison: S: `forces_iff_noSplit` (l.102): across every web, more listed after a step than a covering list before forces that not every formation after continues one before under S, iff S lets no formation continue as two. It is a carrying (pigeonhole) law between two steps.
places.rank: S: `ceasing_not_recurring` (l.68): a finite covering list with no arising from N on leaves ceasing not recurring, a bound by the list. No variant falls.
places.closed_region: S: `w.RestsFrom M`, a stretch with no arising or ceasing, appears in `rests_unrefuted_iff` (l.170) only as what is unrefuted. N: no invariant or largest closed region.
places.forms_change: S: `forced_iff_more` (l.85) and `forcedAlong_iff_more` (l.147): where more are active after a step (at arbitrarily late steps), some formation active after continues none active before under every no-split continuation. So what is present changes by forced arising. N: no widening.

places.place: Listing.lean: listsOnce_iff_decided, not_of_listsOnce, Numbers.unique, numbers_iff_decided, Flow.standing_lowers_listing, World.Enumerated.not_recurring, Doubled.needs_once, Flow.byOccurrence_once, World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em
places.states: It states in general that a list can be listed without repetition exactly where identity among its members is decided, and that this can never be refuted. It follows that every law whose conclusion is a refutation holds of a family however it is listed. Sums and counts once per member are one number, which exists exactly where identity is decided. It gives `_listing` corollaries of the dissipation, non-recurrence and drawing-in laws, World.finite_iff, the reading of a flow by occurrences, and counting up to indiscernibility, which is fixed for every world exactly under excluded middle. The laws are general; the built witnesses are Doubled (repetition breaks a sum law) and probe.
places.moves: N: there is no Process, policy or allowed set. Flow gives present, take and give at each step as functions, with no choice among steps.
places.reading: S: `World.Indiscernible` (l. 739) makes a class of relata alike in every relation of the world. `NumbersBy.unique` (l. 695) and `numbersBy_iff_decided` (l. 708): read up to such a likeness, a list's count is one number, and it exists exactly where likeness among its members is decided. `World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em` (l. 794): that this count exists for every list of every world is equivalent to excluded middle. `World.probe_named_apart` (l. 805, built): where Q holds, two relata number 2 by name and 1 through relations. `Flow.byOccurrence` (l. 873) reads each place in a step's list as a relatum of its own. No law here has a registered reading decide a selection.
places.share: N: `Numbers` (l. 224) is a count of relata. No fraction, and no rule set again from a share.
places.level: S: `Flow.standing_lowers_listing` (l. 415): under `L.Balances W` and `L.Dissipative`, if a family ds is closed across t and a member c comes to stand, the stock over every list listing ds once falls from t to t+1. `Flow.standing_lowers_decided` (l. 423) gives the same where identity is decided. `CensusWebs.stock_eq` / `stock_le` (l. 1065, 1071): the stock once per member is one number, and repetition only adds. B: `Doubled.needs_once` (l. 584): over [true,true,false] the stock does not fall; listed once it does. No law here makes what comes back depend on what is left.
places.giving: N: what gives is `L.give t f c`, a function the flow is handed, and closure and balance are premises. No law here concerns the loss of what gives. `Web.arising_of_ceasing_listing` (l. 513) relates ceasing to arising (W.Unceasing), not to what gives to a level.
places.multiplying: N: arising and ceasing appear (Enumerated.not_recurring, arising_of_ceasing_listing), but no law of a step by which units leave units.
places.no_return: S, all concluded from premises: `World.Enumerated.not_recurring` (l. 483): in an enumerated world that is balanced, dissipative and has embodied arising, neither arising nor ceasing recurs at arbitrarily late steps. `Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring_listing` (l. 377) and `Flow.taking_not_recurring_listing` (l. 442, with the unit fixed from T and the family closed from T): taking from a family does not recur. `Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring_listing` (l. 434). These are failures of recurrence, not a point after which something lost is not regained.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on and ending. The exactly-when statements here are about listing and identity (listsOnce_iff_decided l. 155, numbers_iff_decided l. 234, World.finite_iff l. 467, indiscernible_decided_iff_em l. 784, present_listsOnce_all_iff l. 1007).
places.comparison: S: the by-occurrence reading carries premises both ways between a flow and the flow read by occurrences: `Flow.byOccurrence_dissipative` (l. 933), `byOccurrence_balances` (l. 946), `byOccurrence_closedAt` (l. 921), `byOccurrence_takers` (l. 914), `byOccurrence_acting`, `byOccurrence_taking`, `byOccurrence_more`. `BalancesOn.sample_byOccurrence` (l. 979): balance composes across a coarse step. `Flow.ClosedAt.widen` (l. 315): closure across a step passes upward to any family holding the members. `DissipatesOn.of_same` (l. 343): dissipation passes between two once-lists with the same members.
places.rank: N: there is no variant or bound on ending. `Numbers.le_length` (l. 244) bounds a count by a length. `standing_lowers_listing` (l. 415) is a strict fall at one step, not a rank.
places.closed_region: S, in the flow's sense of a family closed across a step: `Flow.enclosed_iff` (l. 321): a step is enclosed exactly where some family closed across it has decided identity among its members. `Flow.around_iff` (l. 328) is likewise. `Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing` (l. 367) concludes that no family keeps a closed ds from some step on, given recurring takers. No invariant set of states or fixed point.
places.forms_change: N: `Flow.byOccurrence_uncounted` (l. 972) says occurrences are not followed across steps. No relay, and no widening.
places.how_read: All statements of the module were read, with most proof bodies. Every question was answered from statements (reading, level, no_return, comparison and closed_region with S; level also B from Doubled), and N was given after reading all statements. None was answered from docstrings only; none is U.

places.states: General corollaries, each `_listing`, of refutation laws from Continuation, Dissipation, Roles, Resolution and Standpoints, with `Distinct` dropped by `not_of_listsOnce`. A dissipative family that is enclosed and keeps being taken from (or keeps rising, or has embodied arising) cannot from some step on be fed from nothing beyond it, cannot stay closed, cannot have no inflow, and is not a cut; where some list holds every condition, rising and coming to stand do not recur. There is no built model; the account says the witnesses Frontier and Lone need no corollary.

places.multiplying: N: embodied arising recurring is a premise (embodiedArising_*_listing, l. 291 to 333), not a law of number.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `rising_not_recurring_listing` (l. 253), `standing_not_recurring_listing` (l. 259) and `taking_needs_refinement_listing` (l. 266) conclude that rising, coming to stand and taking do not recur from some step on. The same holds over every course of seeking, whatever the policy that picks each experiment from the course so far: seeking does not correct an error that every experiment ties. These laws are general; the built witness Agree (three coin biases) shows one wrong order turned and another kept, and seeking with an experiment that separates turns it.
places.moves: S: `seekWeight` (l. 168): a course of seeking weighs each experiment by choose : List (E × O) → E → Nat, read from the course so far. `seeking_keeps_order` (l. 187): for every choose, if every experiment ties h₁ and h₂ and prior h₁ < prior h₂, then for any record weighing something, h₂'s posterior share is not at most h₁'s. B: `Agree.seeking_turns_tails` (l. 349): with the policy `pickReading` choosing the experiment that reads both tosses, the order is turned.
places.reading: S: `Tied` (l. 69): a likelihood ties h₁ and h₂ when its weights agree at every outcome. `order_kept` (l. 151): under a tie with prior h₁ < prior h₂, no record weighing something brings h₁'s share up to h₂'s. What the likelihood registers decides what can be corrected. B: `Agree.agreeing` (l. 247) reads only whether two tosses agree. `Agree.turns_fair` (l. 275) and `Agree.keeps_tails` (l. 288) hold under the record twoHeads.
places.share: S: the posterior `share` of a hypothesis given a record. `posterior_le_iff_prior` (l. 90): for a tied pair, h₁'s share ≤ h₂'s iff prior h₁ ≤ prior h₂. `posterior_ratio_kept` (l. 127): the shares stand as the prior weights. N for a rule set again from the share: the choice `choose` reads the course, not the shares.

places.no_return: S: `seeking_keeps_order` (l. 187) and `order_kept` (l. 151): an order tied under every experiment is corrected by no record and no course of seeking, whatever the policy. This is concluded from the premise that every experiment ties the pair. It concerns an order of hypotheses, not a loss of a level or of something that gives.
places.both_outcomes: N: no exactly-when of going on and ending. B (of keeping or turning a wrong order, in one model under one record): `Agree.turns_fair` (l. 275) with `Agree.keeps_tails` (l. 288), and `Agree.seeking_keeps_tails` (l. 305) with `Agree.seeking_turns_tails` (l. 349).
places.comparison: S: `seek_tied` (l. 175): if every experiment ties h₁ and h₂, then seekWeight is equal under h₁ and h₂ for every course and every choose. The tie is carried from each experiment to every course. `tied_mass` (l. 72): tied hypotheses give every record one weight. Both are between two hypotheses, not two processes.

places.states: For any web and continuation R, read at the grain of activity and of activity with one formation, it says what a carrying renewal is (`carries_iff`, `passing_carries_iff`). It proves that generation needs carriers arising at arbitrarily late steps, that a line along which formations carry on as themselves keeps, and constructively that a line with nothing active at one later step N ends on every branch. Three regimes (consumption held, a family's excess beyond renewal, passing that stops) each degenerate a line, and reaching an end, beyond degeneration, is exactly excluded middle. These laws are general; the built witnesses are the shifts, the relay, Depleted, Coupled, the stopped relay and Undecided.
places.moves: S: the continuation R : Nat → F → F → Prop may branch, and «退化» asks every branch to end. `every_branch_ends_of_gone` (l. 328): for a class E finer than activity, from an active x, if nothing the line reaches at step N ≥ x.1 is active, then every branch ends. There is no Process S A, policy or allowed set here; the 'choice' is a branch of the relation.
places.reading: S: activityClass (pattern) and carrierClass (parts) read occurrences alike. `carries_iff` (l. 175): from an active x, a carrying renewal is a continuation step into an active y whose formation was not active and carrying on as itself before. `itself_not_generation` (l. 268) and `not_generation_of_within_itself` (l. 256): along any continuation contained in `itself` (names alone), nothing generates. What is registered as continuing decides generation.
places.level: S: `consumed_held_gone` (l. 366) and `consumed_held_degenerates` (l. 376): with W.Dependent (activity needs support), if the level of c stays below need T g c at every s > T, and every reached occurrence at N > T holds a dependence on c at no lower need, then the line degenerates. `family_excess_gone` (l. 400) and `family_excess_degenerates` (l. 414): under L.Balances W, with replenishment < uptake for n steps from step T and W.stock ds T < n + m, lines that all depend on the family at need ≥ m at step T + n degenerate. N for what comes back depending on what is left: replenishment is a Flow function handed in.
places.giving: N: in the excess regime, what renews the family is `L.replenishment`, a function of the handed-in Flow ("whatever gives it", l. 399). D: the account (l. 72-73) says a gate with only active formations giving (`Flow.family_excess_ends`, another module) is not used here. B: `coupled_degenerates` (l. 598) uses Coupled, where a renewer formation is part of the web; its giving is defined in Becoming.Continuation, not stated here.
places.multiplying: S (partly): `passing_carries_iff` (l. 190): under the passing continuation, a carrying renewal from carrier b at t to a is exactly passes t b a ∧ V.Arises t a. A carrier gives rise to a carrier, but no law counts carriers. B: `shifted_pass` (l. 480): carrier n passes to n + 1.
places.no_return: S: `every_branch_ends_of_gone` (l. 328) and `ends_of_ends_at` (l. 305): degeneration is concluded from a uniform horizon N at which nothing reached is active. In the regimes the running down is a premise: `below : ∀ s, T < s → level s c < need T g c` (l. 376) and n steps of excess (l. 414). So the irreversibility of the low level is assumed and the end of the line is concluded. It is at a low level, not at the loss of a giver. `end_of_gone_iff_excluded_middle` (l. 695): that every such line reaches an end (有终) is exactly excluded middle.
places.both_outcomes: N: no general exactly-when of going on and ending for one model. B: `renewal_undecided` (l. 536): in the relay every carrier renews and the line still ends (`relay_renews_and_ends` l. 515), while in the shifts every carrier renews and the line generates; these are two models. Also `Map.Depleted.continues` (l. 585) with `Map.Depleted.degenerates` (l. 590): the line takes a step and then degenerates.
places.comparison: S: `reached_coarser` (l. 314): what the line reaches under a finer class E it reaches under a coarser E'. `active_along_finer` (l. 321): from an active start, what the line reaches under a class finer than activity is active. These carry between two grains, not between two processes.
places.rank: S: `ends_before` (l. 295) and `ends_of_ends_at` (l. 305): ending on every branch by induction on the steps left d to a horizon N. The regimes give deadlines: T + n in `family_excess_not_endless` (l. 428), T + d in `stopped_not_endless` (l. 457), any N > T in `consumed_held_not_endless` (l. 389).

B: `shifted_generates` (l. 489): in the shifts the carriers generate at every occurrence. `relay_renews_and_ends` (l. 515).

It defines keeping from some point on (后守) and proves that, with excluded middle, every point is 生成, 后守 or 退化, and that placing every point so is exactly excluded middle. It also proves that telling 后守 on a line of a sequence is deciding whether the sequence stops changing (LPO). The laws are general; the built cases are Map.Once (renews, then stays) and Settles.sequence.

The branches are of a relation, not moves of a Process S A, and there is no law about what a choice keeps.

places.states: A built process: four moves, each installed once from one start, cover claims of four positions resting on a base, and a claim is realized once its time has come while the base holds and the move covers it. Under the premise BasicAlike, a strictly matches b1 and b3 strictly matches a, and a strict match between courses exists exactly when the better loses fewer claims (3, 4, 3, 2). The fragile b3 loses the base and matches nothing, and claims missed at their time stay missed after support returns. Everything is of this one model, with the content relation and the sufficiency of matching as premises.
places.moves: B: `process` (l. 90) is a Process State Move with four moves. `advance` (l. 85) installs the first move once and later steps keep it. Each course `run fragile m` (l. 96) takes one move throughout. `lost_counts` (l. 330): a loses 3 claims, b1 4, b2 3, b3 2. `conditional_outer_order` (l. 272): under sufficiency and transitivity, the b3 course is strictly above b1.
places.reading: B: `BasicAlike` (l. 165), a premise reading the non-base claims as alike. `matches_iff` (l. 326): under it, a strict match between courses x and y iff lostCount x < lostCount y. `reads_at_time` (l. 379): every claim of a position is read at its time by `Supported`.

places.states: For every process and projection π, some determined process on the description admits every step read through π exactly when configurations alike under π go alike (`carries_law_iff`), and the image is the least such process. A step that depends only on π re-absorbs every other difference in one step, and a system that changes its own rule is one determined process on state and rule, with a law at the state alone only where the rule makes no difference. A law through π is not fixed by the record at a projected configuration not yet taken, and in the standard model x' = F(x, u, ε) an intervention is a move not taken and noise a move not represented. These are general laws; Coarse and Switching are the built cases.
places.moves: S: `GoAlike.runs_agree` (l. 166): where GoAlike P π holds, two runs taking the same moves from starts alike under π are alike at every step. `DependsOnlyOn.reabsorbed` (l. 191): if the next configuration depends only on π, such runs are equal from step 1 on. `Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken` (l. 289): if some determined Q admits the run's steps through π before t and the run has not taken a at a configuration projecting to k, the record fixes no outcome of a at k (given two distinct κ). `inputs_intervention_unfixed` (l. 334).

What the description registers decides whether a law is carried. `goAlike_id_iff` (l. 142): through id this is determinacy. `goAlike_const` (l. 149): the constant description always carries one. `forget_inputs_determined_iff` (l. 356): with the noise forgotten, the model is determined iff F x u e = F x u e' for all e, e'.

places.states: For any type of standpoints it defines a valuation (living, related, own, sig), boundary neutrality and the rules N_rel, N_std and A, and proves that A with neutrality gives the positioned articulation D. It proves that an event drawing at a step that breaks a dependence is not living and is related to the broken formation's events, so under N_rel valuing it reaches them, and that an event is living iff each of its relations is. The built cases are Separate, Mixed and Model; many results listed in the opening account (significant_iff, universal_reason, Comparison.climbs, most minimality models) are not stated in this module.

places.comparison: S: `apart_only_downstream` (l. 292) carries equality of levels between two balanced courses L/W and L'/W' at every condition off c's downstream, given that they follow the same reading law, have the same formations present, the part acts alike, and they start alike except at c. `conveyed_upstream` (l. 116) and `carried_zero_off_downstream` (l. 135): where the starting gap δ is positive only at c and the part gives no gap, a conveyed gap at t lies Upstream from c, and the carried amount off the downstream is 0. `ExchangeLaw.ReadsInto.restrict` (l. 252): strengths of the law restricted to what is read are still strengths of the law. `upstream_readCouplings` (l. 273): every route of the restricted strengths is a route of reading formed by the same step. `ExchangeLaw.ReadsAt.readsInto` (l. 221) and `ExchangeLaw.Through.readsInto` (l. 227): a law that reads a schedule in the sense of Thresholds, or reads through a coupling with a covering schedule, reads into every condition. B: `Measure.couples_after` (l. 484): of two measurement courses whose start differs by d on the stock only, the record is alike and the stock d higher up to T, and at T+1 the second record is d higher.
places.rank: N: no ending within a bound, no falling rank or variant, no drain, no deadline.
places.closed_region: S, partly: the downstream of c is closed under couplings. `Upstream.single` (l. 87), `Upstream.trans` (l. 92) and `Upstream.snoc` (l. 101) say that a coupling is a chain, chains join, and a chain extended by a coupling is a chain. `apart_only_downstream` (l. 292) says that its complement, the conditions off the downstream, keeps levels alike at every step: an invariant of agreement between two courses. B: `Measure.downstream_before` (l. 438): for T' ≤ T, only the stock lies downstream of the stock. `Measure.no_loop_before` (l. 449): before T no loop passes through the stock. No largest closed region, kernel or fixed point of one process's states was found.
places.forms_change: S: `upstream_succ_iff` (l. 154) and `route_forms_by_closing` (l. 179): a route that is present at T+1 and absent at T passes through a coupling acting at step T. `Upstream.before_mono` (l. 106) adds that routes only accumulate, so what is downstream widens over steps. B: in `Observation.Measure`, `downstream_before` (l. 438) and `no_loop_before` (l. 449) hold before T, and `route_at` (l. 457) and `loop_at` (l. 475) show that at T the route stock to record and the loop stock to record to draw form: a new reading opens. N for the going-on continuing while the formations present change: the formations present are held fixed in every statement.
places.how_read: I read the whole module (566 lines): the opening account, every statement and docstring, and the proof bodies of apart_only_downstream and couples_after in part. I answered reading, comparison, closed_region, forms_change and no_return (of routes) from statements, level from a built case, and both_outcomes in part from the account. places.states: The module gives exact characterizations, general over every world of the spine, of which patterns of one step can be realized: a pattern (the passages of a family's members, the number of takers, whether something exchanges) is shown by some world on some step and family exactly when it satisfies the law of every step (`every_iff`, l. 1120), and each condition (balance, running down, closure, both, the givers, capacity, activity) adds exactly its named law (`balance_iff` l. 1128, `runsDown_iff` l. 1138, `closed_iff` l. 1148, `runsDown_givers_iff` l. 2927, `every_capacity_iff` l. 2963, `every_active_iff` l. 3016), with the same for runs on one family (`run_*_iff`, l. 1251 to 1300, 3236 to 3309) and for families chosen step by step (`step_*_iff`, l. 3333 to 3400). The reverse directions use two built worlds (`Witness.world` l. 1050, `Chain.world` l. 2145), but the iff statements themselves are general.
places.moves: N: no `Process S A`, policy, plan or allowed set of moves in the statements read. The only choice is existential: in `StepRealized` (l. 3096) a family may be chosen at each step. That is a choice of which conditions are listed, not a choice of moves.
places.reading: S: what a step shows of a condition is read as a `Passage` (l. 142; `Flow.passage` l. 193), and of a family as `Flow.Realizes` (l. 203): passages, takers, exchange. `laws` (l. 1192): where a law is exact for a condition, a property Q of patterns (one that respects equivalent readings of exchange, `Respects` l. 1186) holds of everything every world shows under the condition exactly when it holds of every pattern satisfying the law. Also `Realizes.roles` (l. 415): read with one kind of relatum, the step shows the same pattern. What is read is a single step's numbers. No rule is made from what is registered and fed back.
places.share: N: no favouring is set again from a share. Built only: `Chain.lift` (l. 1679), `Chain.fill` (l. 1724), `taking_shares` (l. 2754) and `running_shares` (l. 2760) lay out shares of a total over relata to build the witness.
places.level: S: levels before and after (`Passage.before`, `.after`) and the family's total. `RunsDown` (l. 323): balance, and the total falls by at least the number of takers. `RunsDownOn.taken_iff` (l. 262): across a step at which a family runs down, something is taken from it exactly when its total falls. `BalancesOn.taken_le` (l. 233): what is taken is at most the level before plus what is given. N: nothing in the module makes what comes back depend on what is left.
places.giving: S: the givers are relata of the world's flow, counted by `Flow.renewers` (`RealizesGivers` l. 1846), and obey `Givers` (l. 1857): at least one where anything is given (`sign_replenishment_le_renewers` l. 1790), at most what is given (`renewers_le_replenishment` l. 1796). N: no statement read makes a giver a going-on that can be formed or lost. Givers are only counted as present at a step.
places.cost: N: no cost to the one that keeps or gives. Related but not a cost: under dissipation every relatum giving to the family also takes from it (`DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers` l. 1803), so running down adds r ≤ k (`runsDown_givers_iff` l. 2927). `DissipatesOn` (Dissipation.lean l. 242) bounds each relatum's giving by its taking less one.
places.multiplying: N: no units that leave units and no kinds that form kinds by a law of the step. Built only: in the chain witness a condition (a chain) is born at a step where nothing at the step before leads to it (`Chain.born` l. 1929, `Chain.start` l. 1935). That is a construction, not a law of number.
places.no_return: N: no point of no return or irreversibility. `standing_iff` (l. 1418) fixes, at one step, when a condition ceases to stand (0 < a and x = a + y). Nothing says it is never regained. `vanishing_steps` (l. 3547) and `steps_not_run` (l. 3525) are built non-realizability results, not irreversibilities.
places.both_outcomes: S: `standing_iff` (l. 1418), general over worlds balanced at one condition across a step: a level a, taken x, given y and readings of coming and ceasing to stand are shown together exactly when x ≤ a + y, comes ↔ (a = 0 ∧ x < y) and ceases ↔ (0 < a ∧ x = a + y). Both coming to stand and ceasing are fixed at one step. `RunsDownOn.taken_iff` (l. 262): taken from ↔ total falls. Every other iff in the module is about whether a pattern is realizable, not about going on versus ending.
places.comparison: S: `Realizes.roles`, `BalancesOn.roles`, `DissipatesOn.roles`, `RunsDownOn.roles`, `ClosedAt.roles` (l. 415 to 456): reading the world with one kind of relatum carries the pattern and every condition. `RealizedGivers.weaken` (l. 2846): realization under a condition carries to any weaker condition. `RunRealizedGivers.steps` (l. 3111): a run on one family is a run on families chosen step by step. `Chained.continues` (l. 2705): following position by position implies continuity up to order, and `steps_not_run` (l. 3525, built `swapped`) shows the converse fails. `laws` and `run_laws` (l. 1192, 1321) carry properties between patterns and worlds.
places.rank: S, per step only: running down makes the total fall by at least the takers (`RunsDown` l. 323). `runsDown_passages_iff` (l. 1172): some count of takers realizes a running-down family exactly when each passage balances, the total falls by at least one wherever anything is taken, and exchange holds where anything moves. N: no law of ending within a bound, no deadline, and no variant iterated to an end.
places.closed_region: S, but of exchange, not of steps: `Flow.ClosedAt` and `closed_iff` (l. 1148). `ExchangesAt.closed` (l. 239): across a closed step, exchange happens only where something is taken from or given to the family. `passages_continue` (l. 3631): what a flow shows on one family continues up to order across every step, a law that holds along all steps. B: `Chain.family_identical` (l. 2555) has the family the same at every step. N: no invariant region, kernel, fixed point or standing population.
places.forms_change: S: `step_every_iff` (l. 3333), `step_balance_iff` (l. 3345) and `step_closed_iff` (l. 3360), general: under no condition, balance or closure, a run is shown on families chosen step by step exactly when each step satisfies its law, so what stands after one step need not be what stands before the next. `step_runsDown_iff` (l. 3379): under running down, the family may change while what stands continues up to order (`Continues` l. 2700). B: `steps_not_run` (l. 3525), two idle conditions listed in one order and then the other; `vanishing_steps` (l. 3547), a condition gone from the list, shown under balance but not under running down; `Chain.unlinked` (l. 2535), each step has its own conditions. N: no widening, nothing about more able to go on after.
places.how_read: Every question answered from statements except share and multiplying (built cases only) and no_return (not found); none from the account alone; none unreached. The opening account and lines 1 to 804 were read directly. Every declaration's signature and docstring from l. 805 to the end (l. 3647) was read through an extraction that printed each line up to :=, with the bodies of the key defs opened (Realized, Stated, Givers, Links, Continues, StepRealized, chain flow and web). Proof bodies were mostly not read.

places.place: Onward.lean: run_iff_continues, run_iff_unbounded, run_iff_returning, run_decided, KeepsMoving, KeepsMoving.run, lossless_no_rise, rise_needs_merge, lossless_unlisted, Finds, searchedRun, runs_iff_dependentChoice, fan_no_run
places.states: General over every `Process S A`: where a list holds every configuration, a run starts at s exactly when a course as long as the list does (`run_iff_continues` l. 164), exactly when courses of every length do (`run_iff_unbounded` l. 172), and exactly when a course leads to a configuration that returns (`run_iff_returning` l. 179). A family that keeps moving has a run from each member that stays in it (`KeepsMoving.run` l. 231). Over all processes, runs from every member of every such family are exactly `DependentChoice` (`runs_iff_dependentChoice` l. 397). One built case: `fan_no_run` (l. 196), on `Lasting.Fan`, has courses of every length and no run.
places.moves: S: `Process S A` with actions. `KeepsMoving P K` (l. 206): from each member of K some step leads to a member. `KeepsMoving.run` (l. 231): within finitely many configurations, from each member a run starts all of whose states are in K, so some choice keeps K. `searchedRun` (l. 342) with `searchedRun_within` (l. 350): given `Finds`, a run built as data, by searching the test at each step, stays in K. `runs_iff_dependentChoice` (l. 397): that such a run exists for every process is exactly dependent choice.
places.reading: S: `Finds P K e test` (l. 326) is a Bool test over enumerated moves: what passes is a step that stays in K, and wherever such a step exists some enumerated move passes. `searchedStep` (l. 335, a def) takes the first passing move, so the test decides which step is taken. `decidedTest_finds` (l. 363): where steps and K are decidable and moves are enumerated, testing each move is such a test. There is no observation class or rule made from what is registered in the sense of a reading of the world.
places.level: N: no stock that runs down. The only quantity is `lossless_no_rise` (l. 264): merging nothing (`Branching.Lossless`) within finitely many configurations, a q that never falls across a step within a family that keeps moving keeps its value across each such step.
places.giving: N.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility. The laws run the other way. `KeepsMoving.returns` (l. 255): merging nothing, within finitely many configurations, each member of a family that keeps moving returns. `lossless_unlisted` (l. 291): merging nothing, a configuration with courses of every length that never returns forces that no finite list holds all configurations. The never-returning there is a premise, and the conclusion is openness.
places.both_outcomes: S: `run_decided` (l. 187), general: within finitely many configurations whose successors are listed (`Lasting.FinitelyBranching`), `Decided (∃ r : Run P, r.state 0 = s)`, that is, either a run starts at s or none does. The three exactly-when laws `run_iff_*` (l. 164, 172, 179) say when a run without end starts. `lossless_returns_iff` (l. 242): merging nothing, s returns exactly when a course as long as the list starts from it.
places.comparison: S: `run_of_trace` (l. 98) and `run_of_reach` (l. 106): a run from t carries back to any s that leads to t, by putting the course first. `ofWithin` (l. 214): a run of the steps within K is a run of P. `runs_iff_dependentChoice` (l. 397) carries between processes with moves and total relations (each direction builds one from the other). `lossless_returns_iff`, `lossless_no_rise` and `lossless_unlisted` restate `Branching`'s laws along runs with no run given.
places.rank: S, for search and for finding a return, not for a process ending: `acc_below` (l. 311): below a place where the test passes, the search is accessible, so `search` (l. 320) ends at a passing place. `returning_of_continues` (l. 133): a course as long as the list repeats a configuration within that length (pigeonhole through `revisits_within`). N: no falling variant or deadline of the process itself.
places.closed_region: S: `KeepsMoving K` (l. 206) is a region in which every member has a step staying inside, though K need not be closed under every step. `within P K` (l. 210) is the process restricted to K. `KeepsMoving.continues` (l. 222): courses of every length stay in K. `KeepsMoving.run` (l. 231) and `searchedRun_within` (l. 350): a run stays in K for ever.
places.forms_change: N: no relay, no kinds coming and going, no widening. Within finitely many configurations a run that goes on is a course into a return, coming round (`run_of_returning` l. 113). `rise_needs_merge` (l. 282): a rise of a never-falling quantity within a family that keeps moving needs a merge. D: the account's readings (D43) say that going on without end does so by coming round.

The whole module (423 lines) was read: the account, every statement and most proof bodies. A few names were looked up in Recurrence.lean (`Returns`, `Lossless`) and Lasting.lean (`Continues`, `Unbounded`).

places.states: In general, for any process, reading, acceptability and executability, it defines a configuration as correctable when a uniform policy through the reading in force there gives at each reading an act acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there, characterises this by fibers given choice, and proves that a revision to a finer reading losing no executability keeps correctability while a revision to a coarser reading gaining no executability opens nothing; with every act acceptable, any configuration with an executable act is correctable. On the one built process of Revision's Revising (a stock, a link, a response), it shows which configurations are correctable and that rebuilding the link, replenishing, or both open the correction along a short trace.
places.moves: S: `OpensAlong` (l. 89) is stated for any `Process X B` and needs `∃ w, Trace P x w x'`; `Correctable` (l. 74) is the existence of a `GuardHorizon.UniformPolicy` choosing one act per reading; `correctable_iff` (l. 80): given `Viability.ChoiceOver O A`, correctable at `x` iff for every reading `o` some act `a` is acceptable and executable at `x` for every situation `s` with `reading x s = o`. B: Revising's acts `replenish`, `rebuild b`, `correct` (Revision.lean l. 145-156) are the moves of the built case.
places.reading: S: `reading : X → S → O` is the reading in force at a configuration; `correctable_iff` (l. 80) says whether a fitting policy exists is decided by the fibers of the reading; `finer_keeps` (l. 95): if `forget (reading x' s) = reading x s` for all `s` and every act executable at `x` is executable at `x'`, correctability at `x` gives it at `x'`; `coarser_opens_nothing` (l. 107): if `forget (reading x s) = reading x' s` and no executability is gained, `¬ OpensAlong`. B: `Linked.unlinked_uncorrectable` (l. 138): with the link off both situations are read alike and need different acts, so no configuration `(n, false, v)` is correctable.
places.share: N: no count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set again from one, in any statement of the module.
places.level: B: Revising's natural-number stock (from Revision.lean `P`: replenish adds one, rebuild and correct each consume one); `Linked.starved_uncorrectable` (l. 157): with the link on and stock 0 no configuration is correctable; `Linked.linked_correctable` (l. 146): with link on and stock `n+1` every configuration is. What replenishing gives does not depend on what is left (always one unit). N in the general part: executability is a supplied predicate.
places.giving: N: what gives to the stock is the act `replenish`, always enabled, a move of the supplied process, not a unit or formation that can be lost. The link that the correction needs can be removed (`rebuild false` in Revision's P) but it does not give to the stock.
places.cost: B: `Linked.rebuilt_starved` (l. 175): from stock 1 with the link off, rebuilding the link steps to `(0, true, v)`, consuming the last unit, and there the correction is not correctable; rebuilding and correcting each draw on the same stock (Revision.lean `P`, l. 153). N in the general part.
places.multiplying: N: no units leaving units and no kinds forming kinds in any statement.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility is stated; the starved configuration `(0, true, v)` is left by replenishing, which opens the correction (`Linked.opens_by_support`, l. 189).
places.both_outcomes: S: `correctable_iff` (l. 80) is an exactly-when for correctability (not for going on and ending). B: on Revising's states, `Linked.unlinked_uncorrectable` (l. 138), `Linked.linked_correctable` (l. 146) and `Linked.starved_uncorrectable` (l. 157) together decide correctability at every configuration (link off: never; link on with a unit: always; link on with none: never). N for an exactly-when of going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `finer_keeps` (l. 95) carries correctability from configuration `x` to `x'` where the new reading refines the old through a supplied map `forget` and executability is kept; `coarser_opens_nothing` (l. 107) is its contrapositive along a course. These compare two configurations and their readings on one process, not two processes. `widened_correctable` (l. 115): with acceptability widened to everything, any configuration with an executable act is correctable.
places.rank: N: no bound, variant, drain or deadline in any statement.
places.closed_region: N: no region closed under steps, invariant or fixed point is stated; correctability is not shown kept by steps of the process.
places.forms_change: B: `Linked.opens` (l. 168): from `(n+2, false, v)` one rebuild step reaches `(n+1, true, v)`, uncorrectable before and correctable after, the reading revised; `Linked.opens_after_replenishing` (l. 182) from one unit by rebuild then replenish; `Linked.opens_by_support` (l. 189) by replenish alone with the reading unchanged. These are cases where after a change of the reading or of what can be executed more can be done (a correction becomes available); nothing about the going on continuing is stated beyond the trace.

places.place: Openness.lean: Flow.AroundStanding, Flow.standing_runs_down, Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.exchange_lowers, Flow.change_stops_unrefuted, World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted, World.CountedWithin.arising_iff_ceasing, World.arising_opens, World.rest_few, World.exchange_needs, World.openness_contingent
places.states: In general, for every flow and web (and world) with a census of what stands, balance and dissipation, across a step enclosed around what stands the total standing does not rise and falls whenever any standing changes or any present formation takes or gives, so where enclosure holds from some step on change, exchange and arising stop (unrefuted, ¬¬), and with a census of activity the world rests from some step on (unrefuted); with a bounded census arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, and arising without end is incompatible with enclosure from some step on. Built worlds (exposed, holding, procession, slow, accretion, attrition, throughput, embodiedThroughput, the Flow cycle, leaking, hatch, mutualism) show each premise is needed and that the eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness.
places.moves: N: the flows are given per step (`present`, `take`, `give` as functions of the step); no choice among steps, policy or allowed set appears in any statement.
places.reading: N: no observation or class read alike; the censuses (`Web.Census`, `Web.StandingCensus`, `Listed`) are lists of what is active or stands, and the laws use them as listings, not as a rule made from what is registered.
places.share: N: no fraction of one kind among several and no rule set again from one.
places.level: S: `Flow.standing_runs_down` (l. 246): under balance, dissipation and a standing census, across a step with `AroundStanding`, the total standing at `t+1` plus the number of takers from the enclosing family is at most the total at `t`; `Flow.standing_never_rises` (l. 257); `Flow.change_lowers` (l. 264): any rise or fall of a condition's standing lowers the total strictly. N for what comes back depending on what is left: no statement makes a return a function of the remaining level.
places.giving: S/D: `Flow.exchange_lowers` (l. 314): a formation `f ∈ L.present t` that takes or gives lowers the total standing; the docstring says under dissipation giving to the enclosing family needs taking from it. Whether a present formation must itself stand is a premise of `World.Premised` from Becoming.Premises (used in proofs of `exposed_world`, l. 1017), not stated here. B: in `exposed` the giver is the side relatum holding the standing, which falls across every step (`exposed_standing`, l. 1039).
places.cost: N: no statement says taking or giving costs the formation that does it; what is lowered is the total standing of what stands (`exchange_lowers`, l. 314; `standing_runs_down`, l. 246), not the giver's own.
places.multiplying: S: `Web.StandingCensus.over_stretch` (l. 185): over any stretch, the number standing at the end plus those that ceased to stand equals the number at the start plus those that came to stand, a counting law, not a law of units leaving units. B: `hatch_rests_unrefuted` (l. 1103): in `hatch` the child arises and the parent ceases across step 0 (built in another module); `accretion` arises one relatum per step (`census_one_way`, l. 432). N for a general law of units that leave units.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.standing_never_rises` (l. 257): across every enclosed step the total standing does not rise, concluded from balance, dissipation and the standing census, at the level of total standing, not at the loss of a giver. S: `World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted` (l. 599): rest from some step on, `¬¬ ∃ N, RestsFrom N`, concluded under census, embodiment, balance, dissipation and enclosure from `T`. S: `Listed.lpo_of_few` (l. 824): strengthening `few_of_quiet` to a list of every member ever holding gives LPO. D: naming the step of rest needs omniscience (account, `World.lpo_of_finite_ends`, not in this module).
places.both_outcomes: S: `World.CountedWithin.arising_iff_ceasing` (l. 366): with decided activity and at most `B` relata active at each step, arising recurs iff ceasing recurs; `World.CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing` (l. 373) where the bound returns to at most `K` at arbitrarily late steps; `Web.StandingCensus.coming_iff_ceasing` (l. 157). These pair two kinds of change, not going on and ending. S: `World.arising_opens` (l. 676) one direction only. B: `World.openness_contingent` (l. 1054): `exposed` meets the eight premises, never enclosed, and keeps arising, while `mutualism` meets them, enclosed at every step, and does not; `census_one_way` (l. 432). N for an exactly-when of going on and ending for one model.
places.comparison: N: no simulation or carrying between two processes or two starts; `Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding` (l. 210) and `World.Finite.standing` (l. 613) turn one premise into another for the same flow, and `World.standingCensus` (l. 645) turns a census of activity into a standing census under embodiment.
places.rank: S: `Flow.change_stops_unrefuted` (l. 288): under a standing census, where from `T` on each step is not refuted to run down, it is not the case that after every `M ≥ T` a later change stays unrefuted; its proof uses `Amounts.rests_unrefuted` with the total standing as a whole-number quantity falling by at least 1 at each change from the bound `stock + 1`. `Flow.standing_runs_down` (l. 246): it falls by at least the number of takers. No explicit bound on the step of ending is given; the conclusion is only unrefuted.
places.closed_region: S: `Flow.AroundStanding` (l. 195): a family without repetition, holding whatever stands before and after the step, closed across the step (`L.ClosedAt es t`); the laws assume it at every step from some step on. This is a family closed against exchange beyond it at one step, not a set of states closed under steps. S: `World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted` (l. 599) concludes a rest from some step on (unrefuted), `RestsFrom` defined elsewhere.
places.forms_change: S: `World.arising_opens` (l. 676): in a world with a census of activity, every relatum embodied, balance and dissipation, arising recurring forbids every step from any `T` on being enclosed. places.states: General laws over any set of eligible outcomes and any order rising with a listed family of conditions: every optimum stands at the least level of the conditions beyond, exactly where room holds; read off the exchange, it stands at what the rest leaves less the part's capacity, so a dependence beyond breaks exactly where its need exceeds that level; the same holds for several optimizers at a mutual best response, over courses of re-optimizing steps, over horizons, under discounting and under any law of what stands. For drawers in turn and drawers at once, every perfect profile draws to the floors, or everything, wherever what a drawer keeps does not return to it one for one. Each law has a built witness (Drain, TwoTakers, Renewing, Holding, halves).
places.moves: S: choice among eligible outcomes, with the optimum being Frontier eligible better o. Flow.ActsWithin (l. 1111) and Flow.Outcome (l. 1120) are the steps open to a part within its capacity. OpenCourse (l. 3673) and Next.Open (l. 6474) are the open courses. InTurn rules and profiles, with Revises and Perfect (ll. 8195, 8202), are policies. Laws on what every choice does: `optimum_beyond` (l. 1644): every optimum of every order rising with the family stands at each condition beyond at the level before, plus what the rest gives, less what the rest takes, less the part's capacity, or at nothing. `MutualBest.full` (l. 1868): where something stands beyond after a mutual best response, each optimizer takes its whole capacity there. `frontier_holds` (l. 3831): every optimum of every order rising with the draw over n+1 steps holds a level of greatest renewal and leaves nothing. `AtOnce.drain_most` (l. 9073): along every profile, no drawer draws more than where all draw everything, given ReturnsLess.
places.reading: S: there is no observation type. The reading is an order that rises with a listed family ds only (Rising, l. 550: ranks above every outcome exceeding another on ds, whatever either holds elsewhere). Laws in which what is registered decides: `rising_optimum_iff` (l. 661): the optima of all rising orders together are exactly the eligible outcomes no eligible outcome exceeds on the family. `optima_lack_iff` (l. 671): every such optimum lacks a property exactly where every unexceeded outcome does. `Flow.Balances.taken_eq_of_alike` (l. 4015): two balanced courses from one level, given alike at each step and leaving alike, take the same whatever levels they pass through. B: `Holding.gated_alike` (l. 4251): two courses, one keeping the dweller and one breaking it, are both optima and take the same.
places.share: N: I found no count or fraction of one kind among several from which a rule or favouring is set again. The order is fixed throughout. AtOnce portions (`AtOnce.next` l. 8837, `AtOnce.ReturnsLess` l. 8872) are a division of the level handed in as a function, not a share of kinds. Revision (`InTurn.revise` l. 8445, `revised` l. 8462) sets each profile again from the previous profile's best responses, not from a share.
places.level: S: a level x t renewed by a law of what is left. Renewing.renewal (l. 2843) is a gate, r while the level is at least 2. OpenCourse uses a law R of the level, and Next.Open a law G t z of what stands. `gated_stays_below` (l. 2357): where nothing is given while the level is below m, a level below m stays below at every later step, whatever is drawn. `ends_within` (l. 2289): where at most r is given and more than r taken at every step, the level is below a positive need m at every step t with x 0 < m + t. `drawn_bounded_iff` (l. 2571): gated, with k>0 taken at every step from a start at the need, everything ever drawn is bounded exactly where r<k.
places.giving: S: `Flow.restGiven_unsupported` (l. 2649): where everything that gives to c is supported (GiversSupported) and every formation outside the part that gives to c depends on c at a need of at least m, nothing outside the part gives to c across a step from a level below m. B: in Renewing.course (l. 2869) and TwoTakers.jointWeb (l. 3176) the dweller gives the source its renewal only while the source meets the dweller's own need of two, and is active exactly then. places.rank: S: `falls_over` (l. 2269): above the renewal, a positive level falls by at least one across each step. `ends_within` (l. 2289): below the need at every step t with x 0 < m + t (a deadline). `reread_deadline_iff` (l. 2396). `ended_drawn_le` (l. 2490): gated, everything drawn is at most x0 + r·x0, however long. places.states: For any net R and class E it states that P2 («本类至终有常») and P4 («所缘同于») at a member that conditions something hold exactly where the member's block is closed under the net. They are closed under meets, the least class meeting them is «后类» (the member with its closure), and every class meeting them reaches exactly what the line under «一» reaches. It reads this on a flow through `Flow.CouplingClass`. The laws are general, and the built witnesses JoinBreaks, MeetBreaks and ReturnsNotRegular show the limits.

places.reading: S: a class E («类», things read alike). `«本类常闭则所及即一之所及»` (l. 269): under P2 and P4 at m, «所及» R E m t ↔ «所及» R «一» m t. Which class meeting both is used makes no difference to reach. `«后类最细»` (l. 257): wherever some class meets P2 and P4 at m, «后类» R m does, and every such class contains it. `«静不闭»` (l. 332): the identity fails P4 where m conditions some v ≠ m. `Flow.couplingClass_held_iff` (l. 764): P4 for the coupling class ↔ everything f affects lies within its coupling closure. General.

places.both_outcomes: N for going on versus ending or keeping versus losing. The iffs `«本类常闭当且仅当类闭»` (l. 116) and `Flow.couplingClass_reach_iff_returns` (l. 796) concern classes and reach.
