places.states: For any giving law g of the level under a standing draw H, with step g H x = (x - H) + g (x - H), the condition ends within x steps below H + y and stays ended where giving falls short of the draw below y and nothing gives from nothing (ends_below, stays_ended), holds at or above H + y within a band, and the point is exact (ends_iff_below); the same laws hold for any adjusting giving A of what is left and the recent giving (Adjusted), with rest within 3 hi + 3 steps and an exact threshold falling in the plane of level and recent giving (Adjusted.comes_to_rest, Adjusted.threshold, Adjusted.fates), and in any linearly ordered amounts the run has a shape (Drawn.run_shape). places.states: The module states general order laws on any Web: admission within a region narrows to subregions, loss beyond a region narrows too, inclusion is admission within every region, and widening, keeping and being mixed of two level paths are the grammar's order relations (one-way, transitive, mutually exclusive). It also states general laws of renewal over a region of conditions (RenewingOver), and one built case (Omitted) where renewal over a region that omits a requirement coexists with loss of the formation's own support.
places.moves: N: no Process, policy, plan or allowed set. Level paths l, l' are compared as given functions, not chosen among.
places.reading: D: the account (l. 58-83) reads a region of conditions as the boundary a center represents. The region is only a parameter, and the account says nothing here models how it is represented. S: `Web.RenewingOver.keeps_own` (l. 267): over a region covering every condition the formation requires, with requirements untightened, renewal over the region gives Supported (t+1) f. B: `Omitted.loses_own` (l. 308): RenewingOver (· = false) 0 () holds and yet ¬ Supported 1 (), because the region omits the required `true`.
places.share: N: no count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set from one.

places.states: For every schedule of couplings and any list of conditions (general), the carried amount equals order j plus what j+1 responses carry from it, so a cut at order j loses exactly that. For every exchange law and two balanced flows, every gap is within order j exactly where no chain of j+1 couplings in time order ends there; Loops.SelfLoop and Loops.Once are built instances.

It also defines Conditions (levels, activity, requirements, needs and draws as observables of configurations) and the built data Renewable.conditions and beyondRenewalState, about which no theorem is stated here; the account says the readings along a run are in Becoming.Labelled.

places.reading: D: the account (l. 6-10) calls the conditions 'observables of configurations'. `Conditions` (l. 46) is a structure of such observables. N: no law in which what is registered decides something.
places.level: S: `falls_not_recurring` (l. 58): for rank : Nat → Nat with rank (n+1) <= rank n for all n >= T, it is not the case that for every N some n >= N has rank (n+1) < rank n. So a level that never rises can fall only finitely often. N: nothing in which what comes back depends on what is left.

places.comparison: N

places.states: For every law L of the support-gated family (a shared condition renewed by a sustaining formation while it is supported, drawn on and contributed to by a focal formation while it is supported; a parameterised family of one condition and two formations), the law is a balanced flow on its static web. Restoration, loss for good and the ending of every formation depending on the condition follow as instances of laws of every flow (Flow.restores, Flow.stays_below_at, Flow.ends_below_at), and where both formations have lost support the level stays forever. Built cases: cultivation/malignant, sharing/winning, alone/together, escalation, fluctuating, and two pulses differing only in their first draw (one recovers, one ends, and the recovered one is neither renewing nor consuming).
places.moves: N: there is no choice among steps, and draw and contrib are schedules handed in. B: the course comparisons (sharing/winning, pulse 2/pulse 3) are fixed laws.
places.reading: N
places.share: N: the classification counts no share. D: the account (l. 28-30) says the family cannot represent each drawer's own share and points to Becoming.Continuation's WithinOwn, WithinJoint and Flow.joint_excess_ends. S, not a share rule: `SupportGatedWebs.jointly_consuming` (l. 285): with d1 t <= renew and d2 t <= renew but renew < d1 t + d2 t, each alone is renewing, together they consume, and both formations end.
places.level: S: `SupportGated.renewal` (l. 71): what the sustaining formation gives across a step is renew if needG <= level t, else 0, so what comes back depends on what is left. `level_succ_le` (l. 96): level (t+1) <= level t + renewal + netGive. `below_for_good` (l. 200): if contrib t <= draw t for all t >= T and level T < bound <= needG, then level (T+n) < bound for every n. `SupportRecovery.absorbs` (l. 366): if level T < needF and level T < needG, then level (T+n) = level T for every n.
places.giving: S: `renewal_supported` (l. 130): renewal gives only where needG <= level t. `givers_supported` (l. 149): whatever gives to the condition is supported there. `overdraw_ends` (l. 225): with 0 < needG, needF <= needG and renew + contrib t < draw t from T0, there is T >= T0 after which the sustaining formation (the renewer) is inactive for good. So the giver is itself a formation of the model that can be lost. `netGive_active` (l. 138): the focal formation gives only while active and only contrib - draw.
places.cost: N: the sustaining formation's giving costs it nothing in any statement. B: `jointly_ends` (l. 239): drawing together beyond renewal ends the drawers too (focal and sustaining inactive for good), a consequence of the loss rather than a cost of giving.
places.multiplying: N: `L.formed` counts formings (`formation_does_not_decide` l. 259: formed (t+1) = formed t + 1 where the focal formation is active), but no units leave units.
places.no_return: S: `below_for_good` (l. 200) and `ends_for_good` (l. 213): concluded from the premise contrib t <= draw t from T, with level T < bound <= needG; every formation needing at least bound is inactive from T on. `overdraw_ends` (l. 225): concluded, at the loss of what gives (the sustaining formation inactive for good). `SupportRecovery.absorbs` (l. 366): concluded with no premise on later draws or contributions; once the level is below both needs it stays. This is a point of no return at the loss of every giver. B: `unsupported_pulse_ends` (l. 435).
places.both_outcomes: B: `supported_pulse_recovers` (l. 426) and `unsupported_pulse_ends` (l. 435): pulse 2 and pulse 3 differ only in the first draw (`same_later_inputs` l. 412); one returns to the sustaining need for good, the other stays at 0 with every formation inactive. `formation_does_not_decide` (l. 259): cultivation is renewing, malignant is consuming and ends. `fluctuating_neither` (l. 316) and `recovered_neither` (l. 446): neither class, so the classification is not a dichotomy. N: no general 'exactly when'.
places.comparison: B: `own_trajectory_does_not_decide` (l. 272): sharing and winning have the same focal activity and formed counts, yet one is renewing and the other consuming. `same_later_inputs` (l. 412) and `pulse_levels` (l. 419): two pulses compared. N: no general law carrying something between two processes.
places.rank: S: `repair_restores` (l. 189): if the focal formation is active at T and contrib > draw at each of the needG - level T steps from T, then needG <= level (T + (needG - level T)), so restoration comes within that bound. `SupportRecovery.window_progress` (l. 393): a window of N supported surplus steps raises the level by at least its length. `overdraw_ends` (l. 225): there exists T >= T0 (no bound given).
places.closed_region: S: `below_for_good` (l. 200): the region level < bound (bound <= needG) is closed under the steps from T, given contrib <= draw. `SupportRecovery.absorbs` (l. 366): below both needs the level is a fixed point. `balances` (l. 125): every law of the family is a balanced flow on its web. B: `supported_pulse_recovers` (l. 426): from step 2 the level stays >= 2.
places.forms_change: B: `pulse_levels` (l. 419) with `supported_pulse_recovers` (l. 426): in pulse 2 the level falls to 1, below the sustaining need of 2, so the sustaining formation is inactive at step 1, and the level then returns to and stays at the need. `recovered_neither` (l. 446): this temporary loss followed by lasting restoration is neither renewing nor consuming. N: no widening.

places.place: Reordering.lean: World.commute_laws, Reorders, Reorders.laws, Footprinted.Precedes, reorder_precedes, reorder_premises, sorts_iff, converse, Order.Crossing.order_registers, Order.Arising.order_registers
places.states: For any World, taking two consecutive exchanges in the other order, where given sides split the two steps, keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment exactly. It keeps the counts of arising and ceasing and the totals of rises and falls over any stretch holding both steps (World.commute_laws, World.commute_counts, Reorders.laws, Reorders.counts). With a given footprint, the order generated by joined exchanges (Footprinted.Precedes) is a strict partial order; commuting exchanges that are not joined keeps it and every premise (reorder_precedes, reorder_premises), and the renumberings reached are exactly those keeping it (sorts_iff, converse: Mazurkiewicz traces); these laws are general, and two built worlds (Order.Crossing, Order.Arising) show that dependence and acting are lost when joined exchanges are commuted.
places.moves: S: `Reorders` (l. 868), an inductive relation: from (L, W), any chosen step t satisfying `within` and any side with W.Split t side side gives a commutation, repeated. `Reorders.laws` (l. 878): every such chain keeps Balanced, Dissipative and Embodied exactly. `Footprinted.reorder` (l. 1504) by a list ts with `Independent` (each commuted pair not joined): `reorder_premises` (l. 1818) says every such choice keeps Balanced, Dissipative, Acting, Taking, Dependent, Embodied and Transmitting exactly. This is a choice among reorderings, not a Process S A or a policy.
places.reading: S: a footprint `touch : Nat → X → Bool` (`Footprinted`, l. 1232) registers which relata each step touches. `Contains` (l. 1247): untouched relata take no part and are Unmoved. `Joined` (l. 1253) and `Precedes` (l. 1262) are decided by what it touches. `sorts_iff` (l. 2191): with a containing footprint, a renumbering is reached by commuting exchanges that are not joined exactly when it keeps the order of joined exchanges. `Joined.mono` / `Precedes.mono` (ll. 2288, 2296): a footprint touching more joins and orders more. `Web.dependent_of_sameAt` (l. 1218): two webs showing every relatum alike at every step need support alike.
places.level: S: `Web.level` standings, and a family's stock. `Web.Commuted.stock` (l. 463): the stock's two steps' changes are exchanged. `Exchanged.fallen` / `Exchanged.fall_count` (ll. 341, 347): the totals of falls, and the number of steps at which it falls, over a stretch holding both steps are the same. `Flow.Commuted.runsDownOn_first` (l. 590): RunsDownOn across the first step of the other order iff across the second step, for a Distinct family holding what stands at the three times. N: no law in which what comes back depends on what is left. B: `Order.Crossing` (ll. 911-990): the second relatum stands at 2, then 0, after the third takes its two units.
places.giving: S (premise): `Flow.Commuted.acting` (l. 619) keeps Acting (only active relata give) only under premises that a giver across one step has its activity not begun by the first step or ended by the second. The giver's activity is a web predicate, handed in. B: `Order.Crossing.order_registers` (l. 988): the condition the first relatum depends on (the second's standing, need 2) is held by another relatum, and it is drained by the third's take. In the other order the first is active without support. `Order.Arising.order_registers` (l. 1086): a giver that arises across the first step gives before it is active in the other order.
places.multiplying: N. S only of counts: `comings_moved` / `ceasings_moved` (ll. 362, 372) and `Reorders.counts` (l. 1869) keep the number of relata of a finite family coming to be and ceasing over a stretch. No law of units leaving units.
places.no_return: N. S of the opposite: `Footprinted.commute_twice` (l. 1756): commuting the same two exchanges again shows every relatum as before. `Moved.symm` (l. 142) and `Flow.Commuted.symm` (l. 402) say commutation is symmetric.
places.both_outcomes: N for going on or ending. S of exact equivalences of keeping: `World.commute_laws` (l. 819) and `sorts_iff` (l. 2191). B: `Order.Crossing.order_registers` (l. 988): Dependent holds in the world and fails in the commuted world. `Order.Arising.order_registers` (l. 1086): Acting holds and fails, in one built model taken in two orders.
places.comparison: S: `Flow.Commuted`, `Web.Commuted` (ll. 393, 450) and `Reorders` (l. 868) relate two worlds, and laws are carried between them: commute_laws, Reorders.laws, Reorders.totals and reorder_premises. `Footprinted.converse` (l. 2254): a world r₂ that takes r's exchanges at π i, touches the same relata, shows touched relata after each step as r does, keeps the order of joined exchanges and starts alike agrees with some reordering of r over the stretch. `acting_of_shows` / `taking_of_shows` / `transmits_of_shows` (ll. 1617-1646) carry premises along any step-map `back` that matches exchanges and showings. `Precedes.mono` (l. 2296): the order is upward-closed in the footprint.
places.rank: N
places.closed_region: S: `reorder_premises` (l. 1818): each premise (Balanced, Dissipative, Acting, Taking, Dependent, Embodied, Transmitting) is invariant under independent reordering, which is closure under commutation, not under time steps. `Precedes.lt` / `irrefl` / `asymm` (ll. 1274-1281): a strict partial order. `contains_everything` (l. 2311): every world has a containing footprint. N: no largest closed region, kernel or fixed point under steps.
places.forms_change: N for a continuation while what is present changes. S only that arising and ceasing counts are kept under reordering (`World.commute_counts`, l. 841; `Reorders.counts`, l. 1869).
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings read, and the account; lines 1-793 with proofs; from l. 794 signatures and docstrings, with the bodies of SameAt, Unmoved, Contains, Joined, Reindexes and Keeps. All fourteen answered from statements or built cases; none from the account alone.

places.states: For any Footprinted world, the first m steps' exchanges ordered by Precedes form a causal set (exchanges_ordered). Where the footprint contains the exchanges, the numberings given by reorderings are exactly its natural labellings, and exactly the orders of birth of causal-set growth courses from empty (reordering_iff_course), so the laws of presence of Becoming.Presence hold on reorderings (precedes_iff_every_reordering, before_some_reordering, antichain_present_reordering, present_some_reordering, present_every_reordering); these laws are general. Presence on the world as it is implies the persistence of what the earlier exchange touched (persists_of_present); built witnesses (ByDependence, MovedBack, VeeWorld) show persistence without presence, and presence varying with the reordering.
places.moves: S: `Reordering r m ts` (l. 121): a list of commutations within the stretch, each of two exchanges that are not joined. Laws over every or some choice: `every_reordering_iff` / `some_reordering_iff` (ll. 167, 176) carry any stretch-read property between natural labellings and reorderings. `precedes_iff_every_reordering` (l. 404): with Precedes i j decided, i precedes j iff every reordering places i first. `either_order_reordering` (l. 433): two different unrelated exchanges are taken in either order on some reordering. `reordering_nil` (l. 186): if every consecutive pair is joined, the only reordering is []. Also `Run process` of CausalGrowth, in `reordering_iff_course` (l. 198).
places.reading: S: the footprint registers what each step touches. `present_identity_iff` (l. 550): i is present when j is taken on the world as it is iff i precedes j within the stretch and no exchange between is joined to i. `persists_of_present` (l. 565): with Contains, that presence implies every relatum i touches is shown at j as right after i's step. `precedes_decided` (l. 297): joining decided on the stretch decides precedence. `every_reordering_iff` (l. 167) takes as premise a property read on the stretch (agreeing numberings).
places.level: N in a general law. B: `ByDependence.web` / `ByDependence.dependent` (ll. 630, 639): relatum 1 needs relatum 0 to stand at 1, and relatum 0 always stands at 1 or more, so the need is met. No running down.
places.giving: N in a general law. B: `ByDependence` (ll. 615-716): the condition relatum 1 needs is the standing of relatum 0, a relatum of the web touched by the first and last steps; it is not lost.
places.multiplying: N for units leaving units. S only that a reordering's numbering is matched to a causal-set growth course from empty whose configuration at m births relabels the exchanges (`reordering_iff_course`, l. 198; `VeeWorld.one_course_two_numberings`, l. 958); births are in CausalGrowth, not read here.
places.no_return: N
places.both_outcomes: N for going on or ending, or keeping or losing. S of exact characterisations of presence: `present_some_reordering` (l. 505): present on some reordering iff a link below. `present_every_reordering` (l. 517): present on every reordering iff a link below j and below no other exchange of the stretch. B: `VeeWorld.presence_varies` (l. 933): present on reordering [1], not on [].
places.comparison: S: `reordering_iff_course` (l. 198) carries between a world's reorderings and causal-set growth courses. `course_converse` (l. 224): a world r₂ taking r's exchanges in the order of a course agrees with some reordering over the stretch. `persists_of_present_reordering` (l. 584) carries persistence to the reordered world. `keeps_precedes` (l. 132): a renumbering keeping joined pairs keeps every chain.
places.rank: N
places.closed_region: N. S only that `present_unrelated` (l. 443) makes the present (MaximalBorn) of any numbering at a stage an antichain of Precedes, and `exchanges_ordered` (l. 110) makes the stretch a causal set.
places.forms_change: S, partly: the present of a numbering at a stage (MaximalBorn) changes with stage and reordering. `antichain_present_reordering` (l. 450): every Boolean-tested antichain is the present of some reordering at some stage. No statement that a going-on continues while its present changes. B: `VeeWorld.presence_varies` (l. 933). `MovedBack.persists_not_present` (l. 798): what the first exchange touched is moved and moved back by the middle two, and shown as before when the last is taken, though the first is not present.

places.place: Reproduction.lean: number_never_against, Generations.ByNumber.rises_exact_iff, Flow.born_within_stock, Flow.reproducing_within, Flow.lineage_ends, Flow.closed_lineage_lowered, Mutation.rises_iff, Mutation.below_always, Breeding.response, Relay.relay
places.states: The module states general counted laws: the selection term on offspring number is never negative and is zero exactly where offspring numbers are uniform (variation, number_never_against, none_iff_uniform); a counted Cauchy-Schwarz bound puts the additive part at most the whole (bound_sq, additive_le, Breeding.additive_part_le); Fisher's theorem holds counted under exact transmission (ByNumber.rises_exact_iff, Breeding.response); and in a flow, offspring numbers are bounded by what the parent gives and takes, so a lineage within a family that is balanced and dissipated on ends within the family's stock and must have a step at which transmission lowered offspring number (Flow.born_within_stock, Flow.lineage_ends, Flow.closed_lineage_lowered). A two-kind mutation scheme, general in its parameters k m w c d, gives a rise/kept/fall trichotomy, an error threshold and a balance share; built witnesses (Spread, OnePool, Relay, Unrelated, Threshold, Additive, Interaction) attain or bound these.
places.moves: N: no Process, policy, plan or allowed set of steps. Generations (kids : Nat → α → List α) and Flow (present/take/give) are handed-in functions, one course with no choice. `search` (l. 353) is a bounded decision lemma over numbers, not a choice of moves.
places.reading: S: `Generations.ByNumber` (l. 371) reads each member by its offspring number (amount t p = offspringNumber t p). `Breeding.Combination` (l. 1010) and `Breeding.Normal` (l. 1015) make a breeding value from carried amounts, fitted by normal equations (a regression). The read amount decides how its mean moves: `Breeding.response_rises_iff` (l. 1151) says that with d > 0 and exact transmission the mean breeding value never falls and rises exactly where its self-concordance is positive. `Generations.ByNumber.rises_exact_iff` (l. 469) says the mean offspring number rises exactly where 0 < concordAt t. The reading does not decide who leaves offspring: kids are handed in.
places.share: S: the carriers' share c/(c+d), compared by cross-multiplying. `Mutation.rises_iff`/`kept_iff`/`falls_iff` (l. 708-723): with 0 < c, the share rises exactly where c·m + d·w < d·k, and so on. `Mutation.kept_share` (l. 741): the share is kept at s/(s+m). `Mutation.run` (l. 766) sets the next counts from the current counts (c·k, c·m + d·w). The offspring rule itself (k, m, w constant) is a premise, not set again from the share. The mean of a parent's offspring number over offspring is at least the mean over parents (`number_never_against`, l. 235): weighting by number.
places.level: S: `Flow.born_within_stock` (l. 551): across a step where family ds is BalancesOn and DissipatesOn, distinct offspring standing within it, plus the formations taking from it, number at most W.stock ds t. `Flow.reproducing_within` (l. 599): over T such steps, W.stock ds T plus the count of reproducing steps is at most W.stock ds 0. So the stock runs down, and what can still be born is bounded by what is left. `Flow.number_within_take` (l. 529): a parent's offspring number, plus one where it has any, is at most what it takes from the family.
places.giving: S: in `Flow.born_le_given` (l. 516) and `SelectionTerm.Flow.Descended` (used throughout), each offspring's standing is given by its parent, a present member of the lineage. That lineage is a going-on of the model that ends (`Flow.lineage_ends`, l. 613). The family's stock itself is replenished by nothing: the premises BalancesOn and DissipatesOn require each formation to give it less than it takes. The flow L and web W are handed in. B: `Relay.relay` (l. 1404) has two relata giving each other their one unit in turn, losslessly, and so keeping the stock.
places.cost: N: no statement has keeping or giving draw on the giver's own standing. Nearest: `Flow.number_within_take` (l. 529), where a parent's offspring number plus one is bounded by what it takes. `Mutation.lowered_count` (l. 814): carriers lose c·m carrying offspring to mutation (transmission lowers by c·m). That is a loss to the kind, not a cost of keeping.
places.multiplying: S: Generations' family at t+1 is the flatMap of kids (offspring leaving offspring), with size laws `ByNumber.sum_eq` (l. 428: a generation's total offspring number is the next size) and `ByNumber.step` (l. 452). `Mutation.run` (l. 766): carriers become c·k carriers, and c·m + d·w others arise, by a fixed law of the step. One kind gives rise to another (carriers to non-carriers, no back mutation; a modelling choice).
places.no_return: S: `Generations.empty_from` (l. 389): an empty generation leaves every later one empty, concluded from the definition. `Flow.lineage_ends` (l. 613): under Descended, offspring within ds, and BalancesOn and DissipatesOn at every step below W.stock ds 0 + 1, the generation at W.stock ds 0 + 1 is empty. This is concluded, and it is the loss of the units that give (the lineage). `Mutation.never_rises` (l. 727) with k ≤ w: the share never rises at any step. N: no point of no return for a level as such.
places.both_outcomes: S: dichotomies of rising, kept and falling, not of going on and ending. `Mutation.rises_iff`/`kept_iff`/`falls_iff` (l. 708-723) are general in their parameters. `Generations.falls_step_iff` (l. 377). `ByNumber.rises_exact_iff`/`kept_exact_iff` (l. 469, 478). B: ending and going on appear only as two built cases: `OnePool.one_pool` (l. 1322, dissipated, the lineage ends) beside `Relay.relay` (l. 1404, not dissipated, goes on with size 1 at every step). No single exactly-when of going on and ending was found.
places.comparison: S: `Mutation.below_stays`/`above_stays` (l. 752, 759) and `below_always`/`above_always` (l. 771, 785): the step keeps the side of the balance (an order kept by the step). `Breeding.one_amount` (l. 1104) makes one amount the case of the list law. N: no simulation or carrying law between two processes or two starts.
places.rank: S: `Flow.reproducing_within` (l. 599) is a drain: reproducing steps are at most the starting stock. `Flow.lineage_ends` (l. 613): ending within the bound W.stock ds 0 + 1. `Flow.closed_lineage_lowered` (l. 652): some t < W.stock ds 0 at which concordAt + size·raisedAt < size·loweredAt (with ByNumber and 0 < size 1). `Flow.closed_not_exact` (l. 675): transmission is not exact at every step up to the stock.
places.closed_region: S: `Mutation.below_always`/`above_always` (l. 771, 785): the region at or below (at or above) the balance is closed under `run`. `Mutation.kept_share` (l. 741): the balance share is a fixed point. `Generations.empty_from` (l. 389): emptiness is closed. B: `Relay.relay` (l. 1404) is a standing population of size 1 with stock 1 at every step.
places.forms_change: B: `Relay.relay` (l. 1404) / `Relay.family_eq` (l. 1383): each generation is the relatum whose turn it is, alternating true and false, while the lineage goes on at every step. What is present changes while the going-on continues. S: in Generations generally each family is new offspring, and `Mutation.run` shifts the proportion of kinds. N: no widening (more able to go on after).
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings read, the whole module to l. 1517 (a few proof bodies looked at), plus the definitions of DescendsAt, DissipatesOn, BalancesOn, takers and Generations in Evolution, Dissipation, Flow and SelectionTerm. Answered from statements: states, reading, share, level, giving, multiplying, no_return, both_outcomes, comparison, rank, closed_region, forms_change. moves and cost are N, found absent after reading every statement.

places.place: Reserve.lean: Web.Carries, Web.Decays, carries_zero, Flow.carries_of_held, Flow.carries_of_own, Carries.lasts, Carries.ends_within, ended_for_good, late_return_finds_none, Carries.chain_ends, no_unending_chain, lpo_of_ending, redirect_dependent, Famine.living_differs
places.states: The module states general laws, for any Web, of a reserve r that does not rise and falls with activity while a formation is unsupported (Web.Carries, Web.Decays). Dependent is exactly the zero reserve (carries_zero); a held condition is a reserve in a balanced flow (Flow.carries_of_held, carries_of_own); and a reserve defers ending without escaping it (Carries.active_not_recurring, lasts, lasts_within, ends_within, consumed_lasts, coextinct_lasts, chain_ends). It also proves that a final ending stays (ended_for_good, late_return_finds_none), that a bounded rank admits no unending chain of dependence (no_unending_chain), and that an unbounded ending step implies LPO (lpo_of_ending). Built cases attain the bounds: Seed, Viable, Famine, Cascade, ShortCascade, Once, Sleeper, Provisioned, Bridged.
places.moves: N: no Process, policy or allowed set. Web and Flow are given unfoldings with no choice of step. `Web.redirect` (l. 395) is a re-reading of one unfolding, not a move.
places.reading: S: `Web.redirect` (l. 395) reads the same unfolding with each unsupported dependence moved onto the held condition at need one. `redirect_same` (l. 403): levels, activity and drawing are unchanged. `redirect_dependent` (l. 428): where the held condition carries the formations, the redirected reading is Dependent. B: `Famine.living_differs` (l. 815): under the published reading the fox's event at step 1 undermines, and under `transformed` it does not. So which reading is used decides which events count as undermining.
places.share: N: no count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set from one.
places.level: S: `Web.Carries` (l. 91) and `Decays` (l. 97) define the reserve. `Carries.pos` (l. 134): an active, unsupported formation has a positive reserve. `Carries.lasts` (l. 195): r(S+N) plus the count of active steps over steps S..S+N is at most r S. `Carries.ends_within` (l. 319): with decay, the formation is not active at S+n once r S ≤ n. Activity is possible only while the reserve is left. B: `Bridged.bridged` (l. 1160): a reserve of three spans three unsupported steps and the formation is active at every step.
places.giving: S: what keeps support met can be an embodied relatum of the model that ends. `unsupported_after_end` (l. 442): with W.Embodied y (standing iff active), a formation bearing on y at positive need is unsupported once y is inactive from T; the ending of y (`ended`) is a premise. `Flow.carries_of_held` (l. 369): the reserve is the level of a held condition, with nothing giving to it while unsupported (premise `unreplenished`). B: `Seed.no_held`/`Viable.no_held` (l. 626, 675): there the reserve is supplied, and no condition of the web carries it.
places.cost: S: `Flow.carries_of_own` (l. 377): where the holder itself takes part and takes from its held condition at each unsupported active step, that condition carries it (the holder's own use). `Web.Carries` (l. 91): activity while unsupported makes the reserve fall. `CarriesAcross.step` (l. 157): it falls by at least the mark of activity. B: `Famine.carries` (l. 758): the fox burns its fat.
places.multiplying: N: no units leaving units, and no law on their number. `Provisioned.provisioned` (l. 1126) has one parent give a seed its standing, with no count law.
places.no_return: S: `ended_for_good` (l. 295): from the premise `final` (inactive with reserve spent does not arise and the reserve does not rise, from U on), it concludes inactivity at every later step whatever support returns. The irreversibility is supplied by `final` and carried forward. `late_return_finds_none` (l. 308): carried, decaying and unsupported up to S+n with r S ≤ n, plus `final`, gives inactive at every step from S+n. Here the end of the reserve is concluded, and its finality is a premise. `unsupported_after_loss` (l. 326): the loss without return is a premise (`below` for all later t). At the loss of what gives: `Carries.coextinct_lasts` (l. 452) and `Carries.chain_ends` (l. 506): after an embodied relatum depended on ends (premise), the dependents end within their reserves.
places.both_outcomes: N: no single exactly-when of going on and ending. `carries_zero` (l. 123) is an iff, but of Dependent and the zero reserve. Nearest pair: `late_return_finds_none` (l. 308, S, a return after the reserve finds none) beside `Bridged.bridged` (l. 1160, B, a reserve spanning the gap bridges it). These are separate statements.
places.comparison: S: `redirect_supported_at` (l. 410) and `redirect_dependent` (l. 428) carry support from a web where a held condition carries the formations to its redirected reading. `chain_ends_from` (l. 479) carries each link's ending to the next. B: `ShortCascade.unsupported`/`carries` (l. 947, 950): unsupported in ShortCascade implies unsupported in Cascade, so Cascade's reserve law carries over. N: no simulation between two processes in general.
places.rank: S: `Carries.lasts`/`lasts_within` (l. 195, 203): the count of active steps is bounded by the reserve, or by capacity k. `decays_by_on` (l. 226): after n steps the reserve has fallen by n or is spent. `ends_within_on` (l. 267) is a deadline. `chainEnd` (l. 460) with `Carries.chain_ends` (l. 506) bounds each link's end. `no_unending_chain` (l. 559): dependence climbing a rank ρ bounded by K gives False for any infinite chain. Against a bound: `Web.lpo_of_ending` (l. 1034): without decay, a general ending step for never-supported carried formations implies LPO. `Carries.chain_ends_of_em` (l. 542) takes excluded middle and gives no bound.
places.closed_region: S: `ended_for_good` (l. 295): inactive with the reserve spent is a region every step from U keeps (via kept_onward), under `final`. `carries_zero` (l. 123): Dependent is the zero reserve. B: `Sleeper.sleeper` (l. 1066): an unceasing, Dependent relatum standing throughout.
places.forms_change: B: `Famine.transformed` (l. 781) / `transformed_dependent` (l. 786): what the fox depends on changes (source t: the hare at 0, the fat after) while the fox continues active through step 2. `Sleeper.sleeper` (l. 1066): active and dormant alternate, arising is unceasing with nothing given, and the relatum never comes to stand. `Cascade.cascade` (l. 924): relata end in turn, each outliving the one before by one step. `Provisioned.provisioned` (l. 1126): the seed is given standing while dormant and arises later. N: no widening.
places.how_read: All statements and docstrings read, the whole module to l. 1179 (a few proof bodies looked at). Answered from statements: states, reading, level, giving, cost, no_return, comparison, rank, closed_region; forms_change is from built cases only. moves, share, multiplying and both_outcomes are N, found absent after reading every statement.

places.place: Resolution.lean: losses_bound, quantum_bound, Flow.quantum_not_recurring, Flow.taking_not_recurring, Flow.withRefinement, Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement, Flow.refinement_gives_nothing, World.rests_unrefuted_refinement_counted, Flow.uptake_bound, Flow.exchange_bound, World.growth_bound, World.fall_bound, World.not_recurring_at_resolution, Web.CarriesAt.lasts, refinement_feeds_witnesses
places.states: General laws for flows balanced at a unit that may refine (Flow.BalancesAt). The count of steps at which a closed family's stock loses at least a quantum is bounded by a multiple of its stock at T (losses_bound, quantum_bound). Under loss in proportion, the amount taken and given, and the counts of exchange, growth and fall at each size, are bounded by the standing at T, so neither arising nor ceasing at a size recurs (World.not_recurring_at_resolution). With the refinement counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's rest holds at every resolution (World.rests_unrefuted_refinement_counted). Built witnesses (Asymptote, Geometric, Circulation, Emission, Alternation, Dwindle, Trickle) show each premise is needed and that each witness is fed by the refinement.
places.moves: N: a Flow lists the formations present and their take and give at each step as given functions. No process with a choice among steps, no policy and no allowed set occurs in the module.
places.reading: N: no observation, class read alike, or rule made from what is registered occurs. Web.Census (a list of the active relata) is a premise of the World laws, not a reading that decides anything.
places.share: N: Flow.DissipatesBy q (def l. 733) is a proportion, (q+1)·replenishment ≤ q·uptake, of what is given back to what is taken. No count or fraction of one kind among several, and no rule set again from it, occurs.
places.level: S: `losses_bound` (l. 242): if R T = 1, the unit only refines from T on, and q·s(t+1) + k t·R(t+1) ≤ q·(r t·s t) at each step from T on, then the quanta k summed since T are at most q·s T. `Flow.BalancesAt.lowers` (l. 177): balanced at r and dissipated on, a family's stock after the step plus its takers is at most r t times its stock before. `Flow.uptake_bound` (l. 889) and `Flow.replenishment_bound` (l. 899): balanced, dissipative in proportion q, over a family closed from T on, everything taken since T is at most (q+1) times the stock at T and everything given back at most q times. `Web.CarriesAt.lasts` (l. 1358): a reserve lowered by at least 1/p of the unit at each active unsupported step means the formation, unsupported from T on, is active at most p·a T f times. B: in `Geometric` (l. 1574) what is given back each step is q/(q+1) of the whole pool taken, so the return depends on what is left; `amount_sharp` (l. 2457) shows the amount bound is the least.
places.giving: S: `Flow.withRefinement` (def l. 461) counts the refinement as one more formation, `none`, that gives each condition split t·W.level t c and takes nothing. `Web.withRefinement` (l. 474) makes it never active. `Flow.refinement_gives_nothing` (l. 563): if a step is enclosed and dissipative with the refinement counted, the refinement gives nothing across it. Its giving is a function handed in (split), not a going-on that can be lost. In the World laws (growth_bound l. 1198, fall_bound l. 1252) relata are both formations and conditions (World.of R L W with Flow R R), with Embodied as a premise. No statement makes a giver's giving depend on its own standing. B: `Emission.acting` (l. 1866): only the active pool gives and takes.
places.cost: N: dissipation is a loss to the family (what the formations give back falls short of what they take: Flow.DissipatesOn, Flow.LosesAtSize l. 979), not a cost to the formation that keeps or gives. B: `Circulation.loses_one` (l. 1679) is a loss of one unit to the pool per exchange, not to the drawer.
places.multiplying: B: in `Emission` (l. 1716 on), the census alive t = none :: (steps 0 t).map some, and a new relatum arises at every step (`Emission.arises` l. 1857, `arising_recurs` l. 1862), so the number of relata grows by one a step. In `Trickle.flow` (l. 2089) halving t conduits take part across the step from t, so the formations present double at each step. N: no general law of units leaving units or kinds forming kinds.
places.no_return: N: no statement that something once lost is not regained, and no point from which no course keeps it. Nearest, concluded at the level of a closed family's stock or a world's relata: S: `Flow.quantum_not_recurring` (l. 397), `Flow.taking_not_recurring` (l. 416, the unit fixed from T on), `Flow.exchange_not_recurring` (l. 963), `World.growth_not_recurring` (l. 1212), `World.ceasing_not_recurring` (l. 1289). Under their premises, the change named does not happen at arbitrarily late steps (an eventual rest, concluded). `Web.CarriesAt.lasts` (l. 1358) bounds how long an unsupported formation stays active; its end follows from the bound but is not stated as a point of no return.
places.both_outcomes: B: `Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff` (l. 1537): the built flow exchanges at arbitrarily late steps exactly when the unit splits at arbitrarily late steps. S (one direction only): `World.arising_needs_refinement` (l. 711): in a counted, embodied, balanced-at-refinement, dissipative world where arising recurs, no step begins a stretch that is enclosed and in which the refinement gives nothing. `Flow.withRefinement_dissipatesOn_iff` (l. 522) is an exactly-when for dissipation, not for going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement` (l. 506): balance at a unit splitting into split t + 1 is exactly the spine's balance of the flow with the refinement counted, a law carrying between two readings of one flow. `Flow.ClosedAt.of_withRefinement` (l. 539), `Flow.ClosedAt.withRefinement` (l. 545, where the refinement gives nothing) and `Flow.Enclosed.of_withRefinement` (l. 555) carry closure between them. `World.restsFrom_of_after` (l. 649) and `World.rests_unrefuted_of_after` (l. 656) carry rest from the world after T to the world. `Web.Carries.carriesAt` (l. 1335) and `Web.carriesIn_one` (l. 1344) make the spine's reserve a case. No simulation between two different processes.
places.rank: S: `losses_invariant` (l. 214) and `losses_bound` (l. 242): an invariant in which the stock counted in the unit of step T falls by each quantum lost, so the total count is within q·s T. `bounded_not_recurring` (l. 266): a count whose totals stay within a bound is positive at only finitely many steps. `Flow.exchange_bound` (l. 951), `Flow.exchange_bound_of_least_loss` (l. 1046), `World.growth_bound` (l. 1198) and `World.fall_bound` (l. 1252) bound counts by multiples of the stock or standing at T. `Web.CarriesAt.lasts` (l. 1358): at most p·a T f active steps while unsupported.
places.closed_region: S: `losses_invariant` (l. 214) and `refinedSum_invariant` (l. 313) are inequalities kept across every step from T on. Closed families (Flow.ClosedAt) and enclosed steps (Flow.Enclosed) appear only as premises at every step from T on, never concluded. No largest closed region, kernel or fixed point is stated.
places.forms_change: B: `Alternation` (l. 1897): two sides hand one whole unit of step 0 back and forth inside an enclosure, each arising in turn without end (`Alternation.arising_whole` l. 1991, `arising_needs_proportion` l. 2376). `Emission`: a new relatum arises at every step while the pool continues (`arising_needs_quantum` l. 2361). `Trickle`: a whole unit passes in ever more, ever smaller transfers and arises in turn without end (`growth_needs_proportion` l. 2439). `refinement_feeds_witnesses` (l. 2506): in each, what keeps the change going is what the refinement gives.
places.how_read: All declarations' statements and docstrings to the end (l. 2532) and the opening account were read; proof bodies were mostly skipped. level, giving, both_outcomes, comparison, rank, closed_region, no_return and the N answers come from statements; multiplying and forms_change come from built cases.

places.place: Response.lean: Flow.WithinResponse, Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling, Flow.beyond_response_closed, Flow.alike_beyond_response, Flow.not_differs_beyond_response, Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response, Trophic.within_response_iff, Trophic.responsive_comparison, Loop.returns
places.states: A general law: if two flows have the same formations present, balance and start alike where it matters, and everything outside a part responds only through what couples into it (the supplied premise Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling), then the difference between them reaches nothing beyond the part's responsive reach (Flow.not_differs_beyond_response). Their retention and inclusion comparison is then decided within that reach (Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response). Built cases: in Trophic the reach is exactly wolves, deer and forest; in Loop a part's act returns, through the other's response, to the part's own support.
places.moves: N: no Process with a choice of moves. The module compares two given flows; in Loop these are the flow with the act (escalation) and without it (quiet), a counterfactual pair, not a choice among steps.
places.reading: S: `Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling` (def l. 110), a supplied premise: each formation outside the part takes and gives alike in the two flows across the step from t wherever the flows are alike through its couplings (W.AlikeThroughUpTo obs) up to t. So what couples into a formation through obs decides its exchange. `Flow.alike_beyond_response` (l. 200): under balance on coupled conditions, the same formations present, an alike start and that premise, the flows are alike through the couplings of every formation beyond the responsive reach at every step. `Flow.respondsThroughCoupling_withhold` (l. 177): with the part withheld, the premise holds whatever couples in.
places.share: N: no count or fraction of one kind among several occurs.
places.level: N: there is no general law of a level running down with its return depending on what is left. B: `Loop.returns` (l. 607): with the act, the first's condition (ofFirstLevel = profile [2,2] 0) falls and the first is unsupported at step 2 (¬ web.Supported 2 .first), while without the act it is supported.
places.giving: N: levels and exchanges are given functions; no statement makes what supplies a condition a going-on that can be lost. B: in `Loop.escalation` (l. 522) the second formation's response takes from the condition the first requires, so another formation's going-on removes the first's support.
places.cost: B: `Loop.returns` (l. 607): the first's act takes from the condition coupled into the second, the second responds by taking from the first's condition, and the first is unsupported at step 2 although its own exchange with its condition is the same in both flows. The act costs the actor through the return, which shows only in the comparison where the rest responds (¬ escalation.Reaches web firstPart .first, yet Flow.DiffersBefore escalation quiet web 2 .first).
places.multiplying: N: no units leaving units and no kinds forming kinds.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility or point of no return is stated. Loop's profile drops the first's condition to 0 from step 2 on, but the theorem states only that the first is unsupported at step 2.
places.both_outcomes: B: `Loop.returns` (l. 607): for one built model, with the act the first loses support at step 2 and without it keeps support (¬ web.Supported 2 .first ∧ quietWeb.Supported 2 .first). S: `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response` (l. 286) gives iffs (Retains ↔ Includes, ¬ Adds ↔ ¬ Exceeds), but these are not of going on and ending.
places.comparison: S: `Flow.alike_beyond_response` (l. 200), `Flow.exchange_alike_beyond_response` (l. 216), `Flow.totals_alike_beyond_response` (l. 233) and `Flow.not_differs_beyond_response` (l. 258) carry alikeness between two flows to every formation beyond the responsive reach. `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response` (l. 286): two balanced flows with the same formations present, an alike start and RespondsThroughCoupling; for any significance covering every formation not beyond the reach, each flow's levels retain the other's exactly as they include them, and neither adds a significant continuation exactly where neither exceeds the other. `Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response_of_decidable` (l. 303) is the same where membership is decidable. `Flow.withinResponse_iff_coupling` (l. 133): the responsive reach is the dual of the coupling closure.
places.rank: N: no bound on ending, falling variant or deadline.
places.closed_region: S: `Flow.beyond_response_closed` (l. 187): the formations beyond the part's responsive reach form a region closed, in each flow, under being affected through what couples in. `Flow.outside_part_of_beyond_response` (l. 124): it holds no member. B: `Trophic.responsiveReach_closed` (l. 403): wolves, deer and forest are closed under affecting through what couples in.
places.forms_change: N: no relay or alternation, no kinds coming and going, no widening.
places.how_read: The whole module (l. 1–637) was read: the account and every statement and docstring. reading, comparison, closed_region and both_outcomes (in part) come from statements; level, giving and cost from the built Loop case; the rest are N after reading all statements.

places.place: ResponseLearning.lean: send, lesson, learn, send_stock, lesson_stock, send_interface, lesson_interface, learn_through_interface, successor_keeps, every_cohort_holds, queryProcess, trace_iff, course_stock, faithful_loses_distinction, limited_changes_then_stays, execution_stock_succession_blocked, peer_repairs
places.states: A receiver forms a program from a sender's actual responses. Laws stated for every teaching pair: a query and a lesson keep the pair's stock plus drawn (send_stock, lesson_stock), and learning depends only on the teacher's installed program and stock (learn_through_interface). Laws stated for every two-socket program with distinct primitives and seven units: the learner reconstructs it and every generation of succession holds it (reconstructs_program, every_cohort_holds). Renewal implies renewal within one step, and longer cycles include more. Renewal within p implies return, return excludes consumption, consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns (consumed_iff), and a formation renewing over cycles of p neither consumes nor undermines for p. Built cases: LateMet, the seasonal condition renewed within two and not one, Slowing (always returns, no bounded cycle), and Dip.

places.states: General: the two-kind web and flow embed in a one-kind reading that keeps Dependent, renewal, consumption, undermining, arising, balance and dissipation (Web.roles, Flow.roles and their iff lemmas). For a relatum that is Embodied (stands exactly while active), it proves: one that depends on it is active only while it is; under balance it arises only as another active formation gives to it; its arising replenishes its family; under dissipation that arising lowers the family's stock, and arising does not recur in a closed finite world (embodiedArising_not_recurring) or must draw in from beyond the family (embodiedArising_draws_in). Built witnesses Mutualism, Predation, Wilting, Brood, SourceSeed, EmbodiedSource, Shuttle, Throughput, SprayShuttle and Flicker mark each premise.
places.moves: N: not found. No Process, policy or allowed set of steps; webs and flows are given functions of the step.
places.reading: S: the one-kind and two-kind forms are readings of one web. `Web.relabel_dependent` (l.560) and `relabel_undermining` (l.568): relabelling the condition side onto itself keeps Dependent and undermining. B: `Mutualism.apart_relabelled` (l.806): the relabelled web makes each relatum self-bearing while Dependent is unchanged. `Wilting.relabelled_not_embodied` (l.960): relabelling changes embodiment. So what Dependent registers does not decide embodiment or bearing on oneself. These are representational readings, not observations that decide a selection.
places.level: S: `Embodied.ends_when_consumed` (l.448): an embodied relatum consumed below a need of at most one at every step after T is inactive at every step after T. `Embodied.given_of_arises` (l.608): in a balanced flow it is given at least the standing it arises with. `Embodied.arising_lowers_on` (l.650): under dissipation on a family, an embodied member's arising strictly lowers the family's stock. `Dependent.ceases_below` (l.494): a persisting dependence left below its need ends an active formation.
places.giving: S: `Embodied.arises_given` (l.505): in a balanced flow where only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation present gives to it. `Embodied.arises_from_embodied` (l.514): where only embodied relata give (a premise), the giver is embodied and stands while it gives. `Embodied.active_of_bearing` (l.441): under Dependent, a formation depending at a positive need on an embodied relatum is active only while that relatum is. So what gives and what is depended on are relata of the model, which can end. B: `Brood.brood` (l.1019): each generation is given by the one before. `SourceSeed.source_gives` (l.1097): the giver need not be embodied.
places.cost: S: `Embodied.arising_lowers_on` (l.650) and `arising_with_fall` (l.672): under dissipation, an embodied member's arising lowers the family's stock and comes with another member falling across the same step. The cost falls on the family, not on the arising one. B: `Shuttle.next_off` (l.1588): the holder gives its own standing to the other side and stands at nothing after its step. `Throughput` (l.1283): the holder also burns two units of fuel at each step.
places.multiplying: B: `Brood.brood` (l.1019) with `Brood.arises` (l.1012): across each step generation t gives to generation t+1, which arises; each generation stands from its step on, and arising is Unceasing. No general law about the number of units was found.
places.no_return: S: `Embodied.ends_when_consumed` (l.448): once a dependence on an embodied relatum stays below its need (a premise for all t > T), the relatum is inactive at every later step. This is a loss of something others may depend on (`active_of_bearing` l.441). `embodiedArising_not_recurring_from` (l.679) concludes from balance and dissipation on a family from T on that embodied arising does not recur at arbitrarily late steps. `embodiedArising_not_recurring` (l.725) concludes the same in a closed finite world of relata. D: coextinct and the run readings are said to be in Becoming.LabelledRoles, which was not read.
places.both_outcomes: N: no single statement gives both outcomes for one model. The general law `embodiedArising_not_recurring` (l.725) gives the ending of recurring arising. The built cases `Shuttle.shuttle` (l.1262), `Throughput.throughput` (l.1365), `SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle` (l.1519) and `Flicker.flicker` (l.1576) each drop one premise and give unceasing arising: the outcomes are split across models.
places.comparison: S: the two-kind reading is carried into the one-kind reading: `Web.roles_dependent` (l.217), `roles_renewed` (l.223), `roles_consumed` (l.235), `roles_undermining` (l.251), `roles_unceasing` (l.269), `Flow.roles_balances` (l.327), `Flow.roles_dissipative` (l.375). Relabelling keeps Dependent and undermining (`relabel_dependent` l.560, `relabel_undermining` l.568).
places.rank: S: `Embodied.arising_lowers_at` and `arising_lowers_on` (l.643, l.650): each embodied arising in a family dissipated on strictly lowers its stock. From this, `embodiedArising_not_recurring_from` (l.679) says such arising does not recur at arbitrarily late steps. No explicit bound or deadline is stated.
places.closed_region: S: `embodiedArising_opens` (l.695): under balance and dissipation, a finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is ClosedAt from no step on. `embodiedArising_draws_in` (l.717): if enclosed Around from some step on, then at arbitrarily late steps something gives to it and takes from beyond it. B: `Shuttle.shuttle` (l.1262): the family of both sides is ClosedAt at every step. `Mutualism.renewing` (l.783): each relatum renews.
places.forms_change: S: `embodiedArising_needs_replenishment` (l.636): where embodied members of a family arise at arbitrarily late steps, replenishment recurs. `embodiedArising_draws_in` (l.717) is the related law under dissipation. B: `Shuttle.shuttle` (l.1262) is a relay: two sides hand one standing back and forth, each arising again and again, and arising is Unceasing. In `Throughput.draws_in` (l.1401) the relay goes on under dissipation by drawing in a fresh fuel at each step. In `Brood.brood` (l.1019) generation after generation arises. `SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle` (l.1519) and `Flicker.flicker` (l.1576) are further cases.

places.place: RoomNet.lean: net, next, heater, «温有常当且仅当有给», «温不穷当且仅当有给», «平衡守而有终», «给如所取则全守», «给过所取则生守相杂», «开窗以温层如其余乃分», «有给之室以温不可分», toy_branches
places.states: A built family of rooms. Each has a level in whole units; the window's opening is a branch of the net; each step moves the level one unit toward the surroundings, and a heater gives c where the level left is below the set level m. At margin three or at every positive margin, it states the regions of the unheated, matched and overshooting rooms (keeps and ends; 全守; generates and keeps). It also states a conditional law that warmth is a constant class, and that no line of warmth ends, exactly where c ≥ 1, plus testing laws on stages and core classes, all of this one built model.
places.moves: B: `net` (l. 81) is a relation of alternatives: a shut room may stay shut or open its window (`net_shut`, l. 132), and an open window stays open (`net_open`, l. 126). It is not a `Process S A` here. `heated_warm` (l. 171): with m ≥ 1 and c ≥ 1, every successor is warm (every branch keeps warmth). `Unheated.keeps` (l. 238) keeps along the shut branch, while warmth ends along the window's (`Unheated.ends`, l. 243).
places.reading: B: the classes `alike` (warm or not, l. 97) and `sameLevel` (l. 88), and the heater reading the level left (`heater`, l. 70). `«开窗则一层可分»` (l. 716): with the window in the net, the first stage of the level tells the unheated room from every heated one. `«有给之室以温不可分»` (l. 793): warm or not puts two heated rooms in one core class. `«不开窗则同核»` (l. 698): with no window, every room at its set level is one core class at the level class, whatever its heater.
places.level: B: the level of heat runs down by the window's draw of one unit (`cools`, l. 193: with no heater, a room loses one unit a step). What comes back depends on what is left: `heater m c z` gives c only where z < m (l. 70), and `next` (l. 73) is the exchange and then that giving. `warms_open` (l. 115): with the window open, a heated room at its set level loses one unit and the heater gives c.
places.giving: N: the heater is a term `c` of the rule, a function handed in, not an occurrence that can be lost. The opening account says so: a heater is a term of its room's rule, not an occurrence.
places.no_return: B, concluded from the rule: `cold_after` (l. 197): warmth ends at the unheated room's open occurrence at level 1 (its only successor is cold). `cold_step` (l. 202): the cold open occurrence steps only to itself. `cold_rests` (l. 587): it is 全守. `net_open` (l. 126): an open window stays open. The loss is at the low level (level 0), not the loss of something that gives.
places.both_outcomes: B (built family, for all m and c): `«温有常当且仅当有给»` (l. 606): for m ≥ 1, warmth is a constant class under `net m c` iff 1 ≤ c. `«温不穷当且仅当有给»` (l. 632): for m ≥ 2, no line of warmth from the set level ends iff 1 ≤ c. `unended_at_one` (l. 661): at m = 1 none ends either way, so the margin of two is needed.
places.comparison: B: `joint` (l. 685) sets rooms side by side, tagged with their heater. `toy_branches` (l. 874): GrammarTesting's toy branches are steps of the rule at margin one, and from the balanced and held rooms every step of the rule is one the toy lists (a two-way correspondence). `shut_one_class_alike` (l. 710) carries the core class from the level class to warm-or-not by `«核之单调»`. `begins_open_line` (l. 474): beginning on the net gives beginning on `openNet`.
places.rank: B: `cools` (l. 193) loses one unit a step, and `cools_to` (l. 625) reaches level 1 from every open occurrence at j+1. `empties` (l. 769): an unheated room open at j is told from every warm heated occurrence at stage j, because the window empties it in j draws. `«开窗以温层如其余乃分»` (l. 781): at margin n+1, stage n holds and stage n+1 tells them apart. No general variant law.
places.closed_region: B: `Unheated.closed` (l. 225), `Matched.closed` (l. 328: the set level, shut or open, is closed under the matched net), `Overshooting.closed` (l. 413), `Overshooting.closed_open` (l. 504). `shut_rests` (l. 570): with no window, every room at its set level is 全守. `cold_rests` (l. 587). `«给如所取则全守»` (l. 390): the matched thermostat is 全守 at every positive margin.
places.forms_change: B: the overshooting thermostat at margin three. `Overshooting.renewing_steps` (l. 432): after the opening, every step between levels 4 and 3 is a carrying renewal. `Overshooting.generation_strong` (l. 463): 全生成 before and after opening. `«给过所取则生守相杂»` (l. 559): it generates and keeps. `«开窗则平衡新而尽»` (l. 300): the unheated room renews while degenerating. No widening.

places.place: RoomRuns.lean: next_open, window_line, Unheated.window_cold, Matched.window_held, Overshooting.alternation_shifted, Overshooting.holds_one_way, process, line_iff_held, heated_possible_held
places.states: It joins the built rooms to RegimeMargin: with the window open, the rule is RegimeMargin's step (a draw of one, then the heater's giving), so the window's branch is the regime's run. On that run, the unheated room is at level 0 from step m on, the matched room holds its set level, and the overshooting room alternates 3 and 4 (Alternation's run shifted by two), with generation at its moments and no widening for any of them. It also reads a room as a process whose act opens the window: a coarse line is the possible with warmth held, all built.
places.moves: B: `process` (l. 213) is a `Process Occurrence Bool`; the act says whether the window opens. `heated_held` (l. 262): in a heated room with m ≥ 1, every trace from a warm occurrence is made of moves holding warmth. `heated_possible_held` (l. 270): there everything possible is possible with warmth held, so every choice keeps warmth. `Unheated.cold_not_held` (l. 246): at margin three the cold occurrence is possible, but not with warmth held.
places.reading: B: `line_iff_held` (l. 231): what warmth's line reaches from x is what moves holding the class `alike` reach (`Reaching.heldMoves`). `Overshooting.not_widening` (l. 104): nothing read off the overshooting course by any F keeps widening.
places.level: B: `next_open` (l. 40): with the window open, the rule is `RegimeMargin.step (heater m c) 1`, so giving depends on what is left after the draw. `Unheated.window_cold` (l. 70): with no heater, the level is 0 at step m+k for every k (by `RegimeMargin.stays_ended`, giving short of the draw). `Matched.window_held` (l. 89): with c = 1, the level stays m (by `RegimeMargin.holds` with `matched_meets` and `matched_keeps`).
places.giving: N: the heater is a function parameter `heater m c`, not a going-on that can be lost.
places.no_return: B, concluded: `Unheated.window_cold` (l. 70): once the window opens, the unheated room's level is 0 at every step from m on (stays ended). The loss is at a low level (level 0), not the loss of what gives.
places.both_outcomes: N: no single statement gives both outcomes. B, separately: the unheated room goes cold (`Unheated.window_cold`, l. 70), the matched room holds (`Matched.window_held`, l. 89), and the overshooting room stays in [3,4] (`Overshooting.holds_one_way`, l. 148).
places.comparison: B: `Overshooting.alternation_shifted` (l. 187): the overshooting window course equals RegimeMargin.Alternation's run from 1, plus 2 at every step. `Overshooting.in_phase` (l. 170). `steps_of_net` and `net_of_steps` (l. 217, l. 225): the net's steps are exactly the process's.
places.rank: B: `Unheated.window_cold` (l. 70): the condition is gone by step m (the margin), described as gone after as many steps as it stood. No general rank law here.
places.closed_region: B: `Overshooting.holds_one_way` (l. 148): no band holding the set level meets RegimeMargin.holds' conditions (Meets and Keeps fail), yet the course stays within [3,4] at every n. `Matched.window_held` (l. 89): the level is m at every step.
places.forms_change: B: `Overshooting.generation_at_moments` (l. 114): every moment of the overshooting course is 全生成 at the level, because the level changes at every step. Together with `Overshooting.not_widening` (l. 104), this is generation without widening. `Matched.no_generation_at_moments` (l. 125) and `Unheated.no_generation_at_moments` (l. 134): where the level stops changing, no moment is 全生成. No widening: `Unheated.not_widening` (l. 195) and `Matched.not_widening` (l. 203).

places.place: RouteFormation.lean: Apparatus, formationProcess, course_stock, inspect_installed, probe_identifies_route, accepted_transfers, extended_transfers, old_records_admit_duplicate, repair_course_rebuilds
places.states: A built apparatus that forms an operation (two primitives and a route of sockets) by placing sockets, inspecting the wiring against sample records, discarding, developing, adding a demonstration and reconsidering. Its laws: a program accepted on a code's probe records evaluates every expression as the code does where the primitives differ (and for every code once the novel record is added); stock plus drawn is kept by every move and course; the moves form one Process; and example courses, all of this one built model.
places.moves: B: `formationProcess` (l. 570) is a `Process Apparatus FormationMove` with six moves. `trace_iff` (l. 579): courses end where the moves take the start. `course_stock` (l. 594): every course keeps stock plus drawn. `inspection_transfers` (l. 631): an inspection step against a code's probe records, from an unblocked configuration with stock, with a two-socket route and distinct primitives, installs only a program agreeing with the code on every expression.
places.reading: B: `fits` (l. 142), and `inspect_installed` (l. 609): inspection installs a program exactly where it fits the samples, so the records decide the program. `probe_identifies_route` (l. 167): the composite probe identifies the route where the primitives differ. `reversal_unseen` (l. 211): where the primitives are equal, the order changes no value. `old_records_admit_duplicate` (l. 497): the probe records admit a duplicating program that fails the novel expression. `develop_course_unobserved` (l. 727): unobserved, the wrong program stays and answers. `novel_record_separates` (l. 508).
places.level: B: stock is drawn by each move and never replenished. `place` (l. 261) blocks where stock or parts are lacking. `respond` (l. 315) answers only where the stock covers the draw. `formed_short` (l. 474) and `develop_course_short` (l. 711): with 14 units the route is formed but the novel expression cannot be answered.
places.giving: N: stock and parts are supplied numbers, not a going-on of the model.
places.cost: B: every move draws its own stock (`place`, `inspect`, `discard`, `encounter`), and the account is kept: `course_stock` (l. 594), `example_account` (l. 459): drawn 7. `repair_course_account` (l. 754): the repair course keeps the draw of the failure (drawn 16 of 27).
places.no_return: B, as a premise in the definitions: `place` (l. 261), `inspect` (l. 278), `discard` (l. 290) and `encounter` (l. 390) leave a blocked apparatus unchanged, and no theorem concludes that being blocked is permanent. `verdict_not_program` (l. 488): kept verdicts do not replace a removed program. `discrepancy_no_parts` (l. 539): with two parts, the repair records the discrepancy and blocks.
places.both_outcomes: B: `inspect_installed` (l. 609): installed exactly where the program fits, otherwise none. This is not a dichotomy of going on and ending.
places.comparison: B: `programFor_operates` (l. 108): a code's program evaluates every expression as the code does. `accepted_transfers` (l. 176) and `extended_transfers` (l. 216): agreement on the records is carried to every expression. `equal_primitives_repeat` (l. 192).
places.rank: N
places.closed_region: B: conserved quantities. `step_stock` (l. 584) and `course_stock` (l. 594): stock plus drawn is invariant along every course. `place_parts` (l. 332) and `place_step_parts` (l. 602): parts plus used parts.
places.forms_change: B: `develop_course_replaces` (l. 673): a wrong route is tried, rejected and replaced by the right one. `repair_course_rebuilds` (l. 741): a fresh record changes the installed program from the duplicate to the code's own. `repair_course_further` (l. 749): the repaired program answers a further expression no sample holds (more can be answered after).

places.place: Routes.lean: Weights.within, Weights.within_exact, Weights.Hom.within, routeSum_eq_carriedWithin, carried_eq_courses, finite_horizon_iff_no_loop, carried_le_routeSum_add, Routes.SelfLoop.within_eq
places.states: General: any sum over histories, each step's weight split into ground and response parts, expands by order (`Weights.within`). Each order is exact up to its own horizon and can be read through any weight homomorphism; for counting, the orders rise and are bounded by the whole sum. Propagation's carried amount is such a sum over routes back in time (order j is horizon j+1), a finite horizon is exact exactly where no loop lies upstream, and the self-loop's order j is Loops.orderSum, while the whole sum is (1+M)^n.
places.moves: N: moves are summed over as courses (`openSteps`, `courses`). There is no law of what a choice keeps.

places.states: The module states general laws of any two-level paced course (Pace.paced) whose fast step is a selection that does not lower the share under a favouring rule (Raises) and whose rule is read at reading steps as a monotone function of the share alone (ReadsShare). Under these premises a locked configuration stays locked and neither the share nor the rule falls (locked_stays, locked_rises, locked_not_below), the course locks at its first or second reading step (favouring_locks, uniform_locks), a perturbation that keeps the direction is absorbed (perturbation_absorbed), and monotone courses keep their order (order_kept). It also gives a counts model CarrierCounts, stated for all counts, and built witnesses: Alternating, Reversed and Second.
places.moves: N: no Process S A with a choice among steps was found. The course is fixed by f, h and the reading schedule reads : Nat → Bool. S: the laws hold for every schedule: `locked_stays` (l. 182) for any reads, and `CarrierCounts.proportional_locks` (l. 646) 'under every schedule of reading'. A perturbation is a replacement of the rule: `perturbation_absorbed` (l. 258) holds for every favouring g'. These are quantifications over a schedule or a replacement, not over moves.
places.reading: S: `ReadsShare` (l. 150) says the rule read at a share not lower is not lower, whatever rules the two readings meet. `uniform_locks` (l. 294): where the reading favours at every share, Raises and ReadsShare give a course that is Locked at step r'+1, for any reading steps r < r', from any start. `against_not_rising` (l. 402): read against the share (ReadsShare P (reverse M) h), along a course whose rules favour, the rule read at a later reading step is not above the one read earlier. So what the reading registers, the share, decides the lock.
places.share: S: `CarrierCounts.order` (l. 478) is the share order by cross-multiplication. `share_not_lower_counts` (l. 549) ties it to share_not_lower over offspring lists. The rule is set again from the share at each reading step (Pace.turn true applies h). `CarrierCounts.proportional` (l. 579) sets the rule equal to the population's own proportion. `proportional_locks` (l. 646): from a favouring rule not above the population's proportion, neither the carriers' share nor the rule falls at any step. `proportional_locks_down` (l. 661) is the same downward for a disfavouring rule. `margin_course` (l. 632): a margin read monotonically from the share.
places.level: N: no stock or reserve that runs down, and nothing whose return depends on what is left. B: in `Alternating.alternates` (l. 789) the share falls at every even step and the rule falls at every odd step, without end. That is a falling share, not a drawn-down level.
places.giving: N: the offspring each kind leaves is the rule g, a value of type R handed in and re-read by h, not a going-on of the model that can be lost.
places.cost: N: no statement in which favouring or keeping the rule costs the carriers or the rule. The margin a+m against a is an offspring advantage, not a cost.
places.multiplying: S: `CarrierCounts.select` (l. 497): each carrier leaves g.carrier offspring and each other g.other, so the counts become x.carrier*g.carrier and x.other*g.other. `always_step` (l. 700) states this per step. `rises_strictly` (l. 508): a strictly favouring rule with carriers present raises the share strictly. `rises_strictly_along` (l. 557) holds along every course. These are general over all counts but of this one counts model.
places.no_return: S, concluded: `locked_stays` (l. 182): from Raises, ReadsShare and upper (favouring kept by every rule not lower), a configuration Locked at step t is Locked at every t+k. `locked_not_below` (l. 205): share and rule are never again below where they were. B: `Reversed.not_absorbed` (l. 855): a reversing perturbation held one step before the reading locks the course the other way; from step 1 neither share nor rule rises, and the rule after the first reading step is below hi. This is at the level of the share and the rule, not at the loss of something that gives. D: the account (l. 45-50) says only a change of the law, of how the rule reads, or of the selection leaves the lock. No statement says that.
places.both_outcomes: N: no 'exactly when' of going on and ending, or of keeping and losing. S: `proportional_locks` (l. 646) and `proportional_locks_down` (l. 661) are two directional laws, set by whether the starting rule favours or disfavours, not a dichotomy over one condition. B: `Second.second_exact` (l. 886) shows uniform_locks' bound is exact: not locked at step 1, the rule falling across the second reading step, locked at step 2.
places.comparison: S: `order_kept` (l. 426): where selection is monotone in share and rule and the reading is monotone in the share, two courses whose starts are ordered keep that order in share and in rule at every step. `perturbation_keeps_below` (l. 448): a rule lowered at step a keeps its course at no later step above the course without it. `paced_shift` (l. 114): a course read from step a is the course from its configuration there. `CarrierCounts.upper` (l. 523) and `lower` (l. 531): favouring is closed upward and disfavouring downward. `perturbation_keeps_below_counts` (l. 568) is the counts case.
places.rank: N: no falling variant or drain. Through Pace.stays_turned, `locked_stays` (l. 182) makes the locked configurations a region closed under the course. `turn_favours` (l. 278) and `favours_throughout` (l. 311): where the reading favours at every share, favouring rules are closed under turns. `perturbation_invariant` (l. 227) is an invariant from a perturbed favouring rule.

places.states: The module states laws of one built finite protocol, a partial step on State (roster, present, reviews, rule, proposal, adoptions, accepted) over six kinds of Event, made a Process by ofPartial. Only adoption changes the rule (rule_kept as Gated.KeptBy, rule_change_located). Handoff keeps the record and restricts participation without inventing it. Integration is decided by roster, presence and rule, and no function of the coarse counts decides it. Every law is of this one model, holding for all its states. The examples are decide witnesses of one finite history.
places.moves: S: `process : Process State Event := ofPartial step` (l. 124), with events review, enroll, propose, adopt, integrate and handoff as moves. `rule_kept` (l. 204): Gated.KeptBy process adopts State.rule, i.e. every non-adopting step keeps the rule. `rule_inherited` (l. 259): every trace whose moves all have adopts = false keeps the rule. `integrate_enabled_iff` (l. 466): integrating a ballot is enabled exactly where `technical s b = true`. All are of this one built model.
places.reading: S: `same_enacted_relations_same_decision` (l. 298): two states with the same roster, presence and rule give the same technical decision for every ballot. `same_relations_same_integration` (l. 533) says the same of Enabled. `no_count_only_decision` (l. 385): no f : Nat×Nat×Nat → Bool on the summary (roster, present and review lengths) gives technical on both formed and revised, which have equal summaries and different decisions. `counts_no_integration_reading` (l. 551) says the same of Enabled. So a coarse count cannot decide what the enacted relations decide.
places.share: S, partly: `governance` (l. 76) passes where 2·|roster| ≤ 3·|yes voters present on the roster|, with a 14-day wait and no voter on both lists. `technical` (l. 80) passes on a majority, or under timedTwo on two yes voters, no no-voter and 14 days. The rule is set again by `adopt` only where governance passes on the recorded proposal (`adoption_uses_recorded_proposal` l. 175). It is a share of voters on the roster, not a share of kinds under selection, and the rule is not read from it.
places.level: S, partly: presence is a list that only `handoff` changes and only narrows. `handoff_does_not_invent_participation` (l. 277): every member present after a handoff was present before and is in the continuing list. With nobody present, integration fails (`no_participation_no_integration` l. 314, `no_presence_no_integration` l. 540). B: `inherited_rules_change_access` (l. 349): with presence [0,1], integration by twoVote fails under majority and passes under timedTwo. N: no amount drawn down by use, and no return depending on what is left.
places.giving: S, partly: review needs a reviewer on the roster and present (def `step` l. 101). Entry to the roster needs a review and governance (`admitted_requires_review` l. 168). So what lets the roster grow is participation, which a handoff can remove. B: `copied_rule_without_participation_fails` (l. 363): after a handoff to nobody the rule is still timedTwo, but integration by twoVote is none. Participation here is a stored list of identifiers, not a formation of the model.
places.cost: N: no statement in which reviewing, voting, proposing or handing off costs the one who does it.
places.multiplying: N: no units that leave units. The roster grows by one per enroll and accepted by one per integrate. There is no law of multiplication.
places.no_return: S, for one step and for repeated handoffs: `handoff_does_not_invent_participation` (l. 277), `repeated_handoff_inherits` (l. 290) and `handoffs_trace_keeps` (l. 449) keep rule, roster and adoptions. No event in `step` adds to present, but no theorem was found saying presence is never regained along an arbitrary trace. B: `handoff_without_participation` (l. 497): after a handoff to nobody, integration is not enabled. `low_support_infeasible` (l. 417).
places.both_outcomes: S: `integrate_enabled_iff` (l. 466) is an exactly-when, of the enabling of one move, not of going on and ending. `changed_rule_requires_adoption` (l. 234) and `rule_change_located` (l. 264): every change of rule along a trace sits at an adoption step that uses the recorded proposal and passes governance. N: no dichotomy of going on and ending.

B: `common_history_can_branch_with_different_rules` (l. 393).

places.closed_region: S: `rule_kept` (l. 204, Gated.KeptBy) makes the rule an invariant of every non-adopting step. `nonadopting_trace_keeps_rule` (l. 247) and `rule_inherited` (l. 259) carry it along traces. `repeated_handoff_inherits` (l. 290): rule, roster and adoptions are invariant under any list of handoffs. `trace_iff_run` (l. 165): the traces are exactly the completed runs.
places.forms_change: B: `inherited_revision_continues` (l. 358): formation, revision majority→timedTwo, handoff to [0,1] and two integrations run to a state with accepted = 2. `successor_can_revise_inherited_rule` (l. 372): a successor narrowed by handoff to [0,1,2,3] adopts majority again, with adoptions [majority, timedTwo].
