places.place: Weightings.lean: Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive, Weighting.widens_iff_every_increasing, Weighting.weighed_eq_of_unweighted, forced_iff_center, Flow.needsSome_on, Flow.needs_giver_iff_short, Flow.possible_iff_covers, Flow.needs_giver_iff_store_short, Flow.needsSome_without_end, Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below, FeedersInTurn.needs_both, OwnStores.second_spent
places.states: The module's headline laws are general. On finite listed items, one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting, and every order increasing in admission, ranks it higher (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive, Weighting.widens_iff_every_increasing); the step across standpoints forces significance for exactly the standpoints' centers (forced_iff_center). Over the flows read off a web, a consumer drawing past a family's stock needs some giver, and needs a given feeder exactly where the other active members' capacity falls short of a step's demand (Flow.needsSome_on, Flow.needs_giver_iff_short, Flow.needs_iff_through_short); built cases (Copies, Feeders, FeedersInTurn, Capacities, SharedCopies, OwnStores, TwoTiers, Routing, Overlapping, Partial, LevelTransfer, Framed, Interacting) witness each law.
places.moves: S: no Process S A, policy or step-by-step choice; the alternatives are whole courses or flows in an allowed class. `NeedsPart` (l. 1723): on every possible course on which f continues, g takes its part. `Flow.needsSome_on` (l. 1911): every flow in `FedOnlyOn W cs K T n` (balancing on the family, only active formations giving, only members of K giving to it) in which f draws past the stock has some member of K giving within the stretch. `Flow.possible_iff_covers` (l. 3704): some flow with capacities lets f draw past the stock exactly when the class's capacity covers each step's demand. `Flow.needs_giver_iff_alone` (l. 2194): a member's giving is needed in every allowed flow exactly when, at some step calling for giving, it is the only active member.
places.reading: S: `Weighting.ReadsSetsOn` (l. 780) is a ranking of presentations that ranks two plans, each way, as an order ranks the courses they keep. `Weighting.reads_increasingAt` (l. 796): read right, an order increasing at the added item ranks the wider plan above and never the narrower. `Weighting.reads_increment` (l. 861): read right, a sign measured apart decides the verdict exactly where it is the sign of the joint increment. `Weighting.weighed_eq_of_unweighted` (l. 673): where every item a admits beyond the b it includes weighs zero, the two weigh the same, so a weighting that does not count an item does not rank a widening by that item. B: `Framed.framing_alone` (l. 6402), a ranking by wording that does not read the sets; `Interacting.not_net` (l. 6452), an order whose increment depends on context.
places.share: N: there are counts, `Weighting.size` (l. 537, the number of listed items a course admits) and `Weighting.level` (l. 6190, how many of a formation's items a course admits), used by `neutral_ranks_by_number` (l. 1158) and `prior` (l. 6207). But no rule or favouring is set again from a share, and no fraction of one kind among several is updated by a step.
places.level: S: a family's stock `W.stock cs T` and `Flow.DrawsPast` (l. 1892): stock below n while f takes at every step of n. `Flow.needsSome_on` (l. 1911): what is taken beyond the stock was given. `Flow.passed_le_supply` (l. 3010): a supply's stock after a step, with what it passed on, is at most its stock before with what it was given. `Flow.passed_le_drop` (l. 3016): an unfed supply passes on at most what it loses. `Flow.passed_zero_of_exhausted` (l. 3023): an unfed supply at stock zero passes on nothing. `Flow.needsSome_without_end` (l. 3735): after every step N some member gives within the next `stock N + 1` steps, so the window depends on what is left. B: `OwnStores.second_spent` (l. 5479).
places.giving: S, in part. A feeder's capacity can be read off its own store, a condition of the web that falls: `Flow.FedFromStores` (l. 3136), `Flow.take_le_storeFall` (l. 3145), `Flow.fedFromStores_within` (l. 3158), `Flow.needs_giver_iff_store_short` (l. 3344). The store's levels and the feeder's activity (`W.active`) are handed in with the web, not concluded, and no law of the step makes a giver lost. `Flow.needs_iff_none_of_inactive` (l. 4850): a formation inactive across the stretch is needed only vacuously. The giving family's ending is concluded only through the import in `Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below` (l. 6125), from `GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless`. B: `OwnStores` (l. 5398-5508), where the second store runs out and its feeder gives nothing.
places.cost: S: `Flow.FedFromStores` (l. 3136) is a premise class in which each feeder gives the family at most what it takes from its own store, which nothing feeds. `Flow.take_le_storeFall` (l. 3145): what it takes is at most what its own store falls, so giving draws down the giver's own store. `Flow.PassesOn` (l. 2995) and `Flow.replenishment_le_uptake` (l. 3000) state the same for a supply. `Flow.least_giving_from_stores` (l. 3924): the least a feeder gives is the sum of its shortfalls. B: `OwnStores.first_in_degree` (l. 5578). No offspring forgone and no act spent.
places.multiplying: S, only through an imported premise: `Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below` (l. 6125) takes generations of descent (`SelectionTerm.Generations`, `SelectionTerm.Flow.Descended`). Under balance, acting, dependence, giving gated on the family at need m, uptake exceeding replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m, and every member of later generations depending on the family at need at least m, it concludes that no generation after T + n has a member. Otherwise N: no units leave units by a law stated in this module.
places.no_return: S: `Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below` (l. 6125) concludes, from its premises, that no generation after T + n has a member: an ending at the loss of the family of conditions that gives, via GroupEnding. `Flow.passed_zero_of_exhausted` (l. 3023) concludes nothing is passed on at one step from the premises unfed and stock zero: a low level, one step, not stated as never regained. `Weighting.ended_below` (l. 6108) takes as a premise a course admitting nothing marked late. B: `OwnStores.second_spent` (l. 5479), given store levels. `Weighting.WidensOn.not_reverse` (l. 485) is the order's asymmetry, not one in time.
places.both_outcomes: S, general. `Flow.possible_iff_covers` (l. 3704): some flow lets f, outside the class, draw past the stock exactly when, at every step of the stretch, the active members' capacity covers the step's demand; otherwise every need is vacuous (`Flow.needs_of_class_short`, l. 3688). `Flow.needs_giver_iff_short` (l. 2965), `Flow.needs_giver_iff_shortfalls_pos` (l. 3593) and `Flow.needs_iff_through_short` (l. 4775) give need exactly when there is a shortfall. `Flow.feedsAlone_iff` (l. 2518) gives feeding alone exactly when the member is active and its capacity covers the demand. B: `Capacities.second_alone_first_not` (l. 5131), `SharedCopies.none_needed` (l. 5306).
places.comparison: S: carried between two courses by inclusion. `Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive` (l. 1129) and `Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class` (l. 1185): a widens b exactly when every order of any class from the positive weightings to the orders increasing in admission ranks a higher. On a web, `Web.widens_iff_every_weighting` (l. 1277) and `Web.widens_iff_every_of_class` (l. 1302). `Weighting.every_increasingInOwn_iff_includes` (l. 6076): self-concern ranks a above b exactly when b keeps nothing beyond a. `Weighting.increment_transfer` (l. 755) and `ranksNet_increment_alike` (l. 765) carry an increment's sign between two pairs. `Flow.fedFromStores_within` (l. 3158) puts one class of flows inside another. No simulation between two processes.
places.rank: S: `Flow.needsSome_without_end` (l. 3735) is a deadline: drawing at every step from T, some member of K gives within the next `stock N + 1` steps after every N. `Flow.needsSome_on` (l. 1911): drawing for more steps than the stock needs giving within the stretch. `Flow.uptake_le_tiers` (l. 3069): what is drawn from the bottom of a hierarchy is at most what it held plus what was given to its top. `Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below` (l. 6125) bounds the ending at T + n from the excess over n steps and a stock below n + m. No falling variant is named.
places.closed_region: S, only along relations: `forced_iff_within` (l. 1375): what every significance meeting p's presupposition at f's closure forces is exactly what lies within the closure. `withinClosure_needs_iff` (l. 1780): need is its own closure. `CentersWithin` (l. 1636) and `ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff_centersWithin` (l. 1648): invariant exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures. `standpointInvariant_iff_shared` (l. 1522). N for a region closed under a flow's or a process's steps, a kernel, or a standing population.
places.forms_change: S: `Flow.drawnAcross` (l. 2014) takes a giver `pick : Nat → F` that may differ at each step. `Flow.needs_giver_iff_alone` (l. 2194) builds such a flow with `firstActiveOther` to show a feeder is not needed where another is active at every step calling for giving. B: `FeedersInTurn` (l. 5047-5092, 5542-5570): two copies active in turn, the user drawing across both steps, both needed, and `FeedersInTurn.possible` (l. 5553) with `turn` (l. 5547). `Overlapping.closure_overreaches` (l. 5992): three formations overlapping in turn, each fed by the next. Widening as more admitted is ranked higher (`Weighting.weighed_lt_of_widens`, l. 663), but no statement that more can go on after.

places.place: WholeAmounts.lean: Amounts.no_whole_reading, not_falls_ever, falls_by_steps, Halving.new_without_gain, Dyadic.half_return
places.states: Generally, for any amounts M with an endless strict fall, no map into the whole numbers takes every strict fall to a strict fall (Amounts.no_whole_reading), because no whole number falls at every step (not_falls_ever). The rest are of one built model, the dyadic amounts: they have no such reading, the halving stock is new at every step without rising, and a return of strength one half rises but stays below double.
places.moves: N: no process with a choice among steps was found; every statement is about a given sequence or a given order of amounts.
places.reading: S: `Amounts.no_whole_reading` (l. 52): where M.EndlessFall holds, there is no φ : A → Nat with φ b < φ a whenever b is strictly below a. Here a reading is a map that represents the order, not an observation, and the law says that no such reading exists. B: `Halving.no_whole_reading` (l. 62), the same for Dyadic.amounts.
places.share: N: no share or fraction of a kind was found, and no rule set again from one.
places.level: S: `falls_by_steps` (l. 36): if f : Nat → Nat falls strictly at every step, then f t + t ≤ f 0. `not_falls_ever` (l. 42): no such f exists. B: `Halving.new_without_gain` (l. 74): the halving stock never rises and stays at most one. `Dyadic.half_return` (l. 91): for positive a, a plus half of a is not at most a, and a plus a is not at most a plus half of a. So what is added depends on what is there, in this built case only.
places.giving: N: nothing that gives is a formation or unit of the model. Amounts and stocks are handed in as functions.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility or point of no return was found. not_falls_ever rules out an endless fall; it is not a loss that cannot be regained.
places.both_outcomes: N: no statement with both outcomes of going on and ending, or of keeping and losing, was found.
places.comparison: S: `Amounts.no_whole_reading` (l. 52) denies that any map carries M's strict order into the order of Nat. That is the only law here that relates two orders, and it is a non-existence.
places.rank: S: `falls_by_steps` (l. 36) and `not_falls_ever` (l. 42): a whole-number variant that falls at each step falls by at least t by step t, so it cannot fall forever. `Amounts.no_whole_reading` (l. 52): where an amount falls without end, no whole-number variant tracks the fall. B: `Halving.no_whole_reading` (l. 62).
places.closed_region: N: not found.
places.forms_change: B: `Halving.new_without_gain` (l. 74): the halving stock is new at every step (for i < j, stock i is not at most stock j), never rises, and stays at most one. This is novelty at every step without gain, in one built model. N for any general statement.

places.place: Wholes.lean: Whole.family_excess_ends, Whole.needs_arising, Whole.needs_new, Listed.end_without_arising, Whole.ends_without_arising, AllWhole.ends_of_part, Whole.persists_from, Grade.across_step, WholeExceeding.drawn
places.states: Generally, for any Web, a whole of some parts (active exactly while some part is) arises and ceases only as a part does. If its parts each end and the active ones are listed, it persists only through parts arising at arbitrarily late steps, and new ones outside any finite list (Whole.needs_arising, Whole.needs_new); it ends where none arises (Whole.ends_without_arising). With a Flow, it ends after n steps of a gated family's uptake exceeding replenishment from a stock below n+m (Whole.family_excess_ends). A whole of every part ends with any one part, and a grade counts active listed parts by a census. Built witnesses (Generations, Shifts, Immortal, Countless, Gaps, Layered, WholeExceeding, WholeWithin, WholeUnending, WholeUngated, Rafters) show that the premises are needed and that the bounds are attained.
places.moves: N: no choice among steps. The Web, and the Flow with its present, take and give, are handed in as one course.
places.reading: N: no reading in the sense of an observation, or a rule made from what is registered, was found. D: the account (l. 104-109) says that which formations are parts, and which whole a whole is read as, are representational choices.
places.share: S: `Web.Grade` (l. 476) is the count of active listed parts. `Grade.across_step` (l. 509): grade after the step plus what ceased equals grade before plus what arose. `Grade.arises_of_lt` and `Grade.ceases_of_lt` (l. 514, 531): a rise needs an arising and a fall needs a ceasing. N for any rule or favouring set again from the count.
places.level: S: `Whole.family_excess_ends` (l. 323) states the run-down. Premises: Balances, Acting, Dependent, gated renewal (each present giver with positive give to a member of ds depends on some member e of ds at need at least m), and parts arising only where they then depend on some member at need at least m. If replenishment is below uptake for n steps from T and W.stock ds T < n+m, then no part arises from T+n on and the whole Ends. `Whole.joint_excess_ends` (l. 346) is the one-condition case. B: `WholeExceeding.drawn` (l. 1095): the level stands at 2, then 1, then 0; the lineage takes 2 and members give 1.
places.giving: S: in `Whole.family_excess_ends` (l. 323), giving is L.give t f d by formations f present in the flow. The premise Acting has only active formations giving, and the gated premise ties a giver's giving to its depending on the family. So what gives is formations of the model, but the law does not conclude that the givers are lost; it concludes that the parts stop arising. B: `WholeExceeding.flow` (l. 963): the members, which are the parts, are the givers, one each, and they end (`WholeExceeding.ends`, l. 1072).
places.cost: N: no statement in which giving or keeping costs the giver was found. B: WholeExceeding has the lineage taking while members give; no cost to a giver is stated.
places.multiplying: N for a law of the step that sets how many units or kinds there are. S: `Whole.needs_new` (l. 292) requires ever new parts to arise but gives no count. B: `Generations.generations` (l. 704): a new member arises at every step, and two are active at each step.
places.no_return: S, concluded. `Whole.ends_without_arising` (l. 301): with parts ending and listed and none arising from N, the whole Ends, meaning from some step it is never active. `Whole.family_excess_ends` (l. 323): from excess and the start below n+m, it is concluded that no part arises from T+n on and the whole Ends; the loss is of the arising through which the whole goes on. `AllWhole.ends_of_part` (l. 393): a whole of every part ends as soon as one part ends. B: `Rafters.taken` (l. 1336): the house ceases with the first rafter and the remains stand.
places.both_outcomes: S: `AllWhole.persists_iff` (l. 401): a whole of every part is active at every step from T exactly where every part is. `Grade.diminished_iff` and `diminished_iff` (l. 609, 620): diminished exactly where the whole of some is active and the whole of every one is not. `Whole.same_iff_inStep` (l. 426). The general sufficient condition `Whole.persists_from` (l. 272: parts arising within every d steps and each lasting d carry the whole from T+d) and the necessary ones (needs_arising, ends_without_arising) are not joined into one 'exactly when' for a whole of some part. B: `WholeExceeding.drawn` (ends) against `WholeWithin.kept` (l. 1160, persists), two models that differ in the excess.
places.comparison: S: `Whole.same_iff_inStep` (l. 426): the whole of some part and the whole of every part of the same parts are active at the same steps exactly where the parts are in step. `AtLeastWhole.whole` and `AtLeastWhole.allWhole` (l. 564, 577), with their converses where activity is decided (l. 570, 585), relate the at-least-j wholes. N for a law carrying something between two processes or two starts.
places.rank: S: `Whole.family_excess_ends` (l. 323) bounds the ending: no part arises from T+n on, n being the length of the excess. `Covered.arises_within` and `Whole.arises_within` (l. 194, 249): with parts brief for d, a part arises within every d consecutive steps. `Ends.all` (l. 172): finitely many ending formations all end by one step M. B: `Shifts.shifts` (l. 744) attains the bound d = 2.
places.closed_region: S, as a lemma only: `active_back` (l. 183). Its docstring says it rests on a region every step keeps (kept_onward): with no part arising across k steps from S, a part active at S+k was not inactive at S. N for a headline law of a closed region, invariant or standing population.
places.forms_change: S: `Whole.needs_new` (l. 292): a whole active at every step from T, of ending listed parts, has parts outside every finite list arising at arbitrarily late steps; it goes on while its parts are replaced. `Whole.persists_of_arising` and `Whole.persists_from` (l. 258, 272): arising and lasting parts carry the whole. B: `Generations.generations` (l. 704): the lineage is active at every step and never arises, while member t+1 arises at every step. `Layered.arise_again` (l. 915): under brevity, the same two members arise again. `Countless.countless` (l. 816) and `Immortal.immortal` (l. 769): the whole persists with nothing arising when a premise fails.

places.place: WideningOnTheMap.lean: Steps.KeepsWideningFrom, Steps.generation_includes_iff, Steps.generation_iff_keepsWidening, Steps.keepsWidening_iff_generation_losing_nothing, Steps.buqiong_includes_iff, Steps.forward_iff_wem, Steps.back_iff_em, Web.keepsWidening_itself_iff
places.states: Generally, for any chain of predicates Q : Nat → X → Prop on the moments: keeping widening from N means nothing held is lost across any stretch from N, and after every step something not held there is held later. Under two premises (each point at each moment refuted or unrefuted, and something new found after each step that is not an inclusion backwards) it is the same as 全生成 at (nothing lost, the same possible). That generation is in turn 全生成 under (一, the same possible) together with nothing lost (Steps.generation_includes_iff). The premises are calibrated exactly as weak excluded middle, excluded middle and Markov's principle. Built witnesses (Moving, Growing, Arriving, Dawning, marked) and Web corollaries carry this to the World's keeping widening along a formation continuing itself.
places.moves: N: no choice among steps. The course is the line of moments with Steps.next.
places.reading: S: `Steps.includes` and `Steps.same` (l. 93, 96) are relations on moments made from what is held. `Steps.begins_iff` (l. 120): a line under a class E begins at step t+1 exactly where E does not relate t and t+1. So whether generation begins is decided by what the class tells apart. `Steps.same_class` (l. 106) and `Steps.same_includes` (l. 110).
places.level: N: no level that runs down. In the Web corollaries, W.Admits (l t) t f reads admission at levels l, but nothing runs down.
places.giving: N: not found.
places.no_return: N: no irreversibility was found. B: `Steps.Moving.not_keepsWidening` (l. 321): the moving possible loses each point at the next step and keeps widening from no moment. That is loss, not a stated point of no return.
places.both_outcomes: S: `Steps.buqiong_includes_iff` (l. 137): the line of nothing lost goes on from N exactly while nothing is lost at each step from N. `Steps.generation_iff_keepsWidening` (l. 220) and `Steps.keepsWidening_iff_generation_losing_nothing` (l. 228): exactly-when statements under the premises wdec and found. `Web.keepsWidening_byName_iff_generation` (l. 499).
places.comparison: S: `Steps.keepsWideningFrom_iff_shift` (l. 276): keeping widening from T is 07's chain form of the chain shifted by T. `Steps.keepsWidening_iff_from_zero` (l. 263). N for a law carrying something between two processes. D: the account (l. 79-80) says that the comparison of two courses is not derived.
places.rank: N: no ending within a bound and no falling variant was found.
places.closed_region: S: `Steps.includesFrom_iff` (l. 144): nothing lost across any stretch from N exactly where nothing is lost at each step; inclusion is kept step by step. `Web.kept_by_name_and_generation_on_moments` (l. 513): each formation admitted from T on is 全守 under continuationStep itself, and none is 全生成, given keeping widening by name.
places.forms_change: S: `Steps.KeepsWideningFrom` (l. 100) is the widening, more held later and nothing lost. `Web.keepsWidening_itself_iff` (l. 482): the World's keeping widening along itself is this chain's, read on what levels admit. B: `Steps.Growing.keepsWidening` and `Steps.Growing.generation` (l. 328, 333): gains a point every step and loses none. `Steps.Moving.generation` (l. 311): what is held changes at every step, 全生成 under 一, yet no widening.

places.place: WindowedWaiting.lean: keeps_split, restores_and_answers_iff, pairKeepsInclusion_table_iff, answersWithin, window_withheld_kept, withholder_answered, gives_unless_errs, errs_answered, Pair.echo, Pair.not_absorbs_and_answers_spaced, course_rel
places.states: Over every one-step law f : Bool → Bool → Bool of a pair with f true true = true: keeping inclusion holds for exactly five tables (pairKeepsInclusion_table_iff), and keeping it forces never restoring after one withholding or never answering a constant withholder (keeps_split). Restoring and answering together hold exactly for agreement (restores_and_answers_iff), which does not keep inclusion. Generally, for any α and waiting relation, answering within a window (answersWithin) keeps inclusion, keeps total withholding (window_withheld_kept), answers a constant withholder by T+(w+1) (withholder_answered), and, with errors folded in as a clock, gives exactly where it does not err when errors are spaced (gives_unless_errs).
